19

No "AI relay stations" reselling offshore model APIs at low prices: a Shanghai station operator was criminally detained

Grade CValue: highMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

AI relay stations resell offshore model APIs cheaply. One Shanghai operator was criminally detained 37 days; released on bail, he said conviction was certain and restitution paid. The state security ministry has warned many relays lack operating credentials and ship user data offshore without authorization.

Cost
Free. The price: passing on a low-barrier, nice-looking side income. Genuinely doing model aggregation means the legitimate road — licensing and officially authorized models, real money and time.
Benefit
The MSS's June 2026 risk notice: AI relay stations are proxy layers between users and vendors' official services; some lack operating credentials; some, without data-export compliance or security assessment, transmit user inputs to offshore servers; some let users bypass network access, licensing, and cross-border-transfer restrictions. China Newsweek's June 2026 report: in May 2026, a Shanghai station operator posted a shutdown notice in a tech forum — criminally detained 37 days over illegally obtaining model APIs, now on bail; "I will certainly be sentenced," restitution and confiscation paid, fines pending. The report describes relays batch-registering or buying offshore model subscriptions, hop-scotching through offshore servers, and reselling cheaply domestically (national / Shanghai)
Note
This case rests on media reporting and the party's own account — no judgment, no police notice, no official charge; circulating charge-and-sentence specifics come from lawyers' articles, uncited here. So it's not "relays always criminal" — it's "someone was already criminally detained for it." Legitimate aggregation: charging needs a license (Section 26, item 2); public generative AI needs filing (item 17); exporting user data has statutory conditions (Section 26, item 10). Risks for relay users: Section 14, item 10. Beneficiary: you.
Sources (4 references)
国家安全部 (2026). 「AI中转站」，风险要防范. https://www.szzg.gov.cn/2026/xwzx/szkx/202606/t20260608_533…（数字中国建设峰会官网转载国家安全部微信公众号）；中国新闻周刊 (2026-06-22). AI中转站，面临整治「风暴」（记者孟倩）. https://www.chinanews.com/cj/2026/06-22/10644787.shtml（网页存档 https://web.archive.org/web/20261005042903/https://www.chin…）

12. Starting a business: don't bet the family savings

24 entries

This section counts money and legal liability, not lifespan. Opening a shop or founding a company — which steps drag your own money, the family's money, and your spouse's money down together? What does the law say, and can it be ring-fenced in advance? Entries that most easily sink the family savings and are cheapest to avoid come first — hence signing entries up front, DIY methods later; experience-only, literature-free entries carry Grade C. Entries in this section are grouped by theme, with item numbers in parentheses. Before opening, don't stake the household: start only with money you can lose (item 1), no personal guarantees on company loans (item 2), choose the right entity (item 3), never a nominee shareholder (item 4), check franchise filing first (item 5), ask before paying shop-agency operators (item 24). Registration and licenses: fix name and business scope before registering (item 6), no opening before the license arrives (item 7). Making food: find your food tier first (item 8), prepackaged-food labels (item 9), ordinary food may not claim to cure (item 10), food's criminal lines (item 11). Tax and invoices: file zero returns even without revenue (item 12), invoice only real transactions (item 13), anyone claiming to be the tax bureau demanding money is a scammer (item 14). Contracts and staffing: earnest money, not "reservation money" (item 15), contracts within the first month of employment (item 16), wages per contract and law (item 17), follow procedures on the job (item 22). Product and sourcing: sell first, then build (item 18), samples before mass-production lists (item 19), keep invoices and supplier info (item 20), make or license your designs (item 21). Exit: losing means exiting by procedure (item 23).

1

Start a business only with money you can afford to lose — never the household's, never borrowed

Grade BValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Sole-proprietor debts are repaid from your own assets — and if it can't be separated from a family business, from the family's. Companies aren't safe either: when the company can't pay, the capital you subscribed but haven't paid in gets called early. So size the investment by "fully lost, mortgage and medical care unaffected."

Cost
Free. Before starting, set your number: an amount whose total loss still leaves the mortgage, the children, and medical care intact. Beyond that, don't invest. Family members' money and borrowed money don't count toward the number. The hard part: not adding more just as the business looks promising.
Benefit
Losing means more than money gone. A sole proprietor's debts, if the business is run alone, are repaid from personal property; if run by the family or inseparably, from family property. Debts signed by both spouses are joint; one spouse's after-the-fact nod counts too; a loan in one name that the lender proves funded the couple's joint business is joint as well. Companies carry their own claw: when the company can't pay due debts, the shareholder's subscribed-but-unpaid capital can be demanded early (national)
Note
"Affordable to lose" means: fully lost, you sell nothing and borrow from nobody. Official survival-rate and lifespan statistics weren't verifiable on the statistics and market-regulation sites this round — no numbers, legal consequences only, hence B.
Sources (2 references)
全国人大 (2020). 民法典（第五十六、一千零六十四条）. https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml；全国人大常委会 (2023). 公司法（2023 年修订，第四十七、五十四条）. https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202312/content_6923395.htm
2

Never sign personal guarantees on company loans — spouses least of all

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Signing "joint and several guarantee" means the creditor can skip the company and come straight for you. "Ordinary guarantee" means suing the company first, executing its assets, and only the shortfall reaching you. A spouse's signature stakes the household — the "limited" of limited company stops counting for you personally.

Cost
Free. When the bank, supplier, or landlord demands a "shareholder joint personal guarantee" or "spouse's signature," pause. Signing that page waives, in your own hand, the "company debts don't reach the individual" shield (limited liability). Don't sign if avoidable; unavoidable, sign only "ordinary guarantee" with a capped amount. The hard part: withstanding "no signature, no loan."
Benefit
The sentence on the guarantee means "if the debtor doesn't pay, you do." Under "joint and several," the creditor may bypass the company and knock on your door. Under "ordinary," the creditor must sue or arbitrate first and have the company's assets forcibly sold; only the remainder reaches you. Debts signed by both spouses are joint; one spouse's ratification counts; a signed spouse means the household stakes together (national, since 2021)
Note
Small-business bank loans almost always demand shareholder joint guarantees. Borrow you still may — just know what the page waives, and keep the guaranteed amount inside item 1's affordable-loss number. Guarantees generally: Section 8, item 18.
Sources (1 references)
全国人大 (2020). 民法典（第六百八十一、六百八十七、六百八十八、一千零六十四条）. https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml
3

Choose the right entity before opening: sole proprietors and general partners pay to the end; only the limited company is "limited"

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Sole proprietors and general partners pay to the end — every debt, however long it takes. A limited company's shareholders pay only what they subscribed. But subscribed means genuinely paid within 5 years: writing 1 million is a potential 1-million debt. Mixing company and personal accounts voids the "limited."

Cost
Registration runs on the local government-services site, hours once. A limited company then means monthly bookkeeping and tax filing — a permanent cost: your time or paid agency, priced locally.
Benefit
Sole proprietors' debts run against personal or family property. General partners bear unlimited joint liability for partnership debts — every debt, and creditors may seize any one partner for the whole. Limited partnerships differ: limited partners lose only their subscribed capital, as do limited-company shareholders. But "limited" fails in three ways: subscribed capital must be paid in within 5 years of formation, callable early on default; withdrawn capital must return; and the company-as-shell — including a single-shareholder company unable to prove separate books — makes you jointly liable personally (national, since July 2024)
Note
"Limited" presupposes clean separation: no mixing company and personal accounts, no company money for household spending, complete books. Don't inflate registered capital for looks: subscribed means paid within 5 years, and 1 million written is 1 million owed.
Sources (3 references)
全国人大 (2020). 民法典（第五十六条）. https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml；全国人大常委会 (2006). 合伙企业法（2006 年修订，第二条）. http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2006/content_413955.htm；全国人大常委会 (2023). 公司法（2023 年修订，第四、二十三、四十七、五十三、五十四条）. https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202312/content_6923395.htm
4

Never be a nominee shareholder, never hold shares for others

Grade AValue: very highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Your name on the register makes you the legal shareholder. The subscribed capital must arrive on schedule; shortfall means making it up plus compensating the company. Other founders' unpaid capital at founding becomes your joint debt for the gap. They run the business; the debts land on you.

Cost
Free. "Lend your ID for a shareholder seat" or "park the shares under your name" — refuse both.
Benefit
Registered shareholders are legal shareholders: subscribed capital must be paid in full per the articles' schedule; late payment means makeup plus damages to the company. Founding shareholders' unpaid capital draws the other founders into joint liability for the gap. On the company's default, creditors can demand the unpaid balance early. The real operator stays off the register; the debts stay on yours (national, since July 2024)
Note
Nominee agreements bind between the parties absent invalidity grounds. But the real investor's name swap needs majority-shareholder consent; a nominee selling or pledging the shares routes through good-faith acquisition — an unknowing buyer at fair price with registration done keeps the shares, leaving the investor to sue the nominee. A new interpretation's draft appeared September 2025, repealing this one upon effect — the 2020 text governs as of 2026-09. Nominee legal representatives: Section 8, item 28.
Sources (3 references)
全国人大常委会 (2023). 公司法（2023 年修订，第四十七、四十九、五十、五十四条）. https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202312/content_6923395.htm；最高人民法院 (2020 修正). 关于适用《中华人民共和国公司法》若干问题的规定（三）（法释〔2011〕3 号，2014 年法释〔2014〕2 号、2020 年法释〔2020〕18 号两次修正，第二十四、二十五条）：「如无法律规定的无效情形，人民法院应当认定该合同有效」「实际出资人未经公司其他股东半数以上同意，请求公司变更股东……人民法院不予支持」「名义股东处分股权造成实际出资人损失，实际出资人请求名义股东承担赔偿责任的，人民法院应予支持」. https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181799def980179ac07a9…（国家法律法规数据库）；最高人民法院 (2025). 关于适用《中华人民共和国公司法》若干问题的解释（征求意见稿）第九十条. https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/477881.html
5

Before franchising, check the commerce ministry's filing, get written disclosure, and write a "cooling-off" into the contract

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

The brand must run 2 of its own stores for 1+ year, and file with commerce authorities within 15 days of first signing. Before signing, it must hand you 12 items in writing — fee structure, deposit refunds, how existing stores perform. No filing, no disclosure, or "pay first, then read the contract" — walk away.

Cost
Free. Check the brand's filing on MOFCOM's commercial-franchise information system, then demand the written disclosure and contract before signing. Hours.
Benefit
The regulation requires the franchisor to operate at least 2 directly owned stores for over 1 year, and file within 15 days of the first franchise contract. Non-filing: 10,000–50,000 yuan fines; overdue, 50,000–100,000 plus public notice. Pre-signing, it must deliver 12 written items, including which fees and amounts, deposit-refund conditions, store counts and performance, 2 years of audited summaries, and 5 years of litigation and arbitration. The contract must state the franchisee's unilateral withdrawal window; concealment or false information makes the contract rescindable (national, since May 2007)
Note
No filing, no disclosure documents, pay-before-reading — walk. The cooling-off is the post-signing unilateral-exit window; its length is contractual, the regulation saying only "a certain period," so negotiate the days in. Question the sources of "average sales, gross, and net" figures — the disclosure rules require sourcing. "Operation agency" and "shop-opening training" fee models: item 24.
Sources (3 references)

Before registering: fix the name, premises, business scope, and registered capital — complete documents mean the license on the spot

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Registration costs nothing — fees stopped in 2015. Five items only: application, identity or qualification proof, premises documents, articles or partnership agreement (sole proprietors exempt), plus any legally named extras. Complete documents issue the license on the spot; otherwise within 3 working days. Any fee you're charged is mostly an agent's errand fee.

Cost
Registration itself is free — enterprise and sole-proprietor registration fees stopped 2015-01-01. File on the local government-services site or at the hall, hours once. Seal carving, bookkeeping agency, and registered-address hosting are market services, not government fees.
Benefit
The regulation fixes five items: "(1) application; (2) applicant qualification documents or natural-person identity; (3) domicile or main business-premises documents; (4) articles of association for companies, non-company legal persons, and specialized farmer cooperatives, or partnership agreements; (5) other materials required by law, administrative regulation, and the market-regulation department." In plain words: application; who-you-are papers; premises proof; articles or partnership agreement; legal extras. Companies additionally file appointments and IDs of the legal representative, directors, supervisors, and management. Sole proprietors skip articles. Names are "independently declared by applicants" — your own. Registered capital uses the subscription system: write the promise, pay later. Business scope picks from the registry's published categories. Complete and correct documents: "confirmed and registered on the spot"; otherwise "within 3 working days," extendable 3 more for complexity. "The license issuance date is the market entity's founding date" (national, since March 2022)
Note
Registration itself is free; charged fees are mostly agent errands. Seal prices are market-set — the State Council forbids designating seal makers, so "must carve at the designated shop" needn't be accepted. Registered capital sets your liability ceiling, payable within 5 years — item 3. Licensed scope items: no opening before the license — item 7.

Businesses needing licenses don't open before the license arrives

Grade AValue: highMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Opening unlicensed draws, at the light end, closure orders, confiscation of earnings, and up to 10,000 yuan. Trading in state-monopolized goods or running securities, futures, insurance, or payment settlement without approval, serious, constitutes the illegal-business crime from 5 years down. "Renovate first, license later" and "soft opening before the license" are the commonest stumble.

Cost
Free. Before opening, check whether your trade needs a license. Food service and food sales need the food-operation license; selling only others' fully packaged food needs no license — filing instead. Open after the license lands.
Benefit
Operating without the required license draws enforcement by the designated authority. Operating without a business license where the law sets no specific penalty: shutdown, confiscation of illegal gains, plus up to 10,000 yuan. Heavier: dealing in law-designated monopoly or restricted goods without permission, or running securities, futures, insurance, or payment settlement unapproved — serious cases constitute the illegal-business crime: up to 5 years or custody plus fines of 1–5× gains; especially serious, 5+ (national)
Note
Finance, medical, and education licensing have their own statutes — this entry verifies the general enforcement rules and the criminal clause only. Tea and snack shops are food service needing the food-operation license. Renovate-first and soft-opening are the common traps. Food tiers and whether raw meat and vegetables need papers: item 8.

Making food: find your tier first — production and catering need licenses, packaged-only resale needs filing, raw meat and vegetables need none

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Making food to sell — snack shops, braised goods, baking, homemade sauces — needs a license. Selling only others' packaged food needs none, just filing with county-level-plus market regulators. Raw meat and vegetables need nothing. Operating without: minimum 50,000–100,000 yuan, more than many small businesses' capital.

Cost
The license itself is free, but premises and facilities must qualify — inspection plus processing takes weeks. Meat sellers keep quarantine certificates and quality-inspection passes per batch.
Benefit
Food Safety Law: food business requires a license first — production, sales, catering. "However, selling edible agricultural products and selling only prepackaged food require no license; prepackaged-only sellers shall file with the county-level-or-above food regulator." Edible agricultural products are unprocessed raw meat and vegetables; prepackaged food is others' finished products sold in packaging. Workshops and street vendors follow provincial rules. Unlicensed food business: confiscation of gains, food, tools, equipment, and materials; goods value under 10,000 yuan adds 50,000–100,000 yuan; over 10,000, 10–20× the goods value. Pig Slaughter Regulations: pigs are slaughtered only at state-designated plants with centralized official quarantine — "apart from rural self-slaughter for self-consumption, no unit or individual may slaughter pigs without designation," and "pork sold, processed, or served must come from designated plants passing quarantine and quality inspection." Private slaughter: shutdown, confiscation of pigs, tools, and earnings, fined as unlicensed food business. Animal Epidemic Prevention Law: animal products sold or shipped carry quarantine certificates and marks; absence draws correction plus fines up to one times the goods value of compliant equivalents. Judicial interpretation: workshop and vendor food below safety standards draws court-supported 10× punitive damages (national)
Note
Workshop, small-catering, and vendor thresholds are provincial — no numbers here; search your province's regulator site for its "small workshops and vendors" regulation. Selling homemade food online doesn't shed the license. Beyond licensing, this section's general rules apply: entity and license in items 6–7. Buyer compensation: Section 5, item 31.

Bagged for sale means prepackaged: labels carry production date, shelf life, ingredient list — nothing optional

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Food packed for sale is prepackaged food: the label is mandatory, with nine items — production date and shelf life among them. Bulk food still needs name, date, and seller's name and address. Missing mandatory items: under 10,000 yuan value, 5,000–50,000; over, 5–10× goods value.

Cost
Labels run a few cents to a few mao each; each batch's dates and ingredients take time.
Benefit
Food Safety Law: prepackaged-food packaging must carry labels stating name, specification, net content, production date, ingredients, producer's name, address, and contact, shelf life, product-standard code, storage conditions, additive generic names, and production-license number — plus anything else law or standard requires. Bulk food (unpackaged, weighed) containers and wrappers state name, production date or batch, shelf life, and the operator's name, address, and contact. Label-less or noncompliant prepackaged food: confiscation of gains and food; goods value under 10,000 yuan adds 5,000–50,000; over, 5–10× value; serious, production suspension up to license revocation. Pure blemishes — typos, irregular type — that neither affect safety nor mislead: correction first, refusal drawing up to 2,000 yuan. The new General Rules for Prepackaged Food Labeling, GB 7718-2025, published 2025-03-16, effective 2027-03-16 with a two-year transition, requires a dedicated area displaying production date and expiry together, high-contrast legible type, and year-month-day ordering (national)
Note
Label defects come in two kinds, setting both fine and damages. Blemishes — typos, irregular type — that neither affect safety nor mislead: correction first, up to 2,000 on refusal, no 10× damages. Missing mandatory items — no production date, no shelf life — are expressly not blemishes: fines by goods value (5,000–50,000 under 10,000; 5–10× over), plus the buyer's 10× price claim, minimum 1,000 yuan (Section 5, item 31). GB 7718-2025's clause-by-clause requirements were verified only to the notice and official readings; the standard text governs.

Ordinary food may not claim to cure: labels, instructions, ads, and livestream scripts all count

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Ordinary food's labels, instructions, and ads may not claim disease prevention or treatment. Save for medical, drug, and device ads, no advertisement may claim cures or use drug-sounding words. Fines run 1–3× advertising costs, or 100,000–200,000 when costs can't be computed; serious cases can lose the business license.

Cost
Free. Run through your copy, product pages, and livestream scripts. The hard part: resisting "lowers the three highs" and "cures constipation."
Benefit
Food Safety Law: "labels and instructions of food and food additives shall contain no false content and shall not involve disease prevention or treatment functions; producers and traders are responsible for their content," and "food advertising content shall be truthful and lawful, containing no false content and involving no disease prevention or treatment." The Advertising Law adds: "apart from advertisements for medical treatment, drugs, and medical devices, all other advertisements are prohibited from involving disease-treatment functions and may not use medical terminology or terms likely to confuse the promoted goods with drugs or devices." Violations: ad termination, publisher's public clarification within the published scope, fines of 1–3× advertising costs; costs incomputable or obviously understated, 100,000–200,000 yuan; serious, 3–5× or 200,000–1 million, plus possible license revocation (national)
Note
"Health functions" are off-limits to ordinary food too: health-food function claims must come from the state catalog with registration or filing — a step ordinary food never passes. Spotting such scripts as a buyer: Section 6, item 10. Detail pages, livestream scripts, and social posts all count as advertising, and posting leaves traces.

Food has criminal lines: selling diseased meat or over-limit goods convicts; toxic non-food additives start at five years regardless of amount

Grade AValue: very highMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

The earlier items fine money; this one takes people. Selling diseased or failed-inspection meat, or goods with pesticide, veterinary, or heavy-metal excess, convicts on "sufficiency" to cause serious poisoning — nobody need actually fall ill — up to 3 years. Mixing toxic non-food raw materials in starts at up to 5 years, amounts irrelevant.

Cost
Free. Follow item 8's routine: keep quarantine certificates and purchase receipts; put only approval-numbered items in the recipe.
Benefit
Criminal Law Article 143: producing or selling food below safety standards, "sufficient to cause serious food-poisoning accidents or other serious foodborne disease," convicts — up to 3 years or custody plus fines; serious harm or circumstances, 3–7; especially grave consequences, 7+ to life plus fines or full property confiscation. Article 144: mixing toxic, harmful non-food raw materials into food, or knowingly selling such — up to 5 years plus fines; serious harm, 5–10; death or especially grave, per Article 141 (10+, life, or death). The two-supreme interpretation lists "sufficient" situations: pathogenic microorganisms, pesticide, veterinary-drug, biotoxin, and heavy-metal pollutants "seriously exceeding standard limits"; meat and products from diseased, unexplained-death, or failed-inspection livestock, poultry, game, and aquatic animals; goods the state bans for disease control; and infant and special-medical foods with nutrients seriously below standards. Additives overdosed or misapplied to the same effect charge under Article 143. What counts as "toxic, harmful non-food raw material" isn't yours to define: legally banned substances and ministry-listed items — banned pesticides, drugs barred from food animals. "Other serious circumstances" include sales of 100,000–200,000 yuan; locations at schools, kindergartens, and elder-care facilities and their surroundings; and sales targeting minors or the elderly. Private pig slaughter off designated plants, serious, charges as illegal business — 100,000+ yuan or 50,000+ gains counting as "serious" (national)
Note
The dividing line from the earlier three: whether food safety itself is touched. Missing licenses, labels, or cure-claims cost money; diseased meat, over-limit goods, misused additives, and non-food materials enter criminal process. The cheapest defense remains item 8's routine: meat only from designated plants, batch certificates kept, only approval-numbered ingredients — "cheap offal" and "mystery trim" are the recurring sources. The Supreme Court Gazette original returned 502; two provincial reprints cited, verified identical word for word.

A license starts the filing obligation: zero returns on schedule even with no revenue

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Licensed means scheduled filing. Zero revenue still files — just all zeros. Non-filing draws up to 2,000 yuan, serious 2,000–10,000; three consecutive all-tax non-filings flip you to "abnormal status" automatically, freezing invoices.

Cost
Free. File yourself on the e-tax bureau monthly or quarterly, minutes each. Bookkeeping agency is a separate market expense. With employees, social-insurance registration within 30 days of founding. The hard part: filing in dead months.
Benefit
"Taxpayers with no tax payable in a period shall still file per regulations" — no tax due, return still due. Late filing: correction order plus up to 2,000 yuan, serious 2,000–10,000. Non-filing plus underpayment: back taxes, daily late fees of 0.05%, plus fines of 50%–5× the underpaid tax. "Three consecutive months of non-filing across all taxes: the system automatically flags abnormal status and suspends the invoice book and invoice use" — resume by filing and accepting penalty. Employers "shall, within 30 days of founding, apply for social-insurance registration" (national)
Note
Under multi-license integration, no separate tax registration — log into the e-tax bureau with the unified credit code, confirm registration, and file your applicable taxes. Sole proprietors and single-owner enterprises pay business-income personal income tax: prepay "within 15 days of month- or quarter-end," then annual reconciliation "by March 31 of the following year." Not-yet-open still files; zero filing is filing. Three idle months means abnormal status, frozen invoices, and no simple deregistration — item 23.

Invoice only real transactions; small-scale taxpayers use the exemption fully

Grade AValue: very highMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

As a simplified-tax small-scale taxpayer, monthly sales under 100,000 or quarterly under 300,000 yuan exempt VAT; the 3% rate drops to 1% in the same window. Conversely, "finding invoices to offset costs" is false invoicing — from up to 3 years plus 20,000–200,000 yuan.

Cost
Free. Buy no invoices, sell none, run no accounts for others. Invoice and file per real business.
Benefit
Small-scale taxpayers are the simplified-method tier. "Sales below the threshold are exempt from VAT." From 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31, the threshold runs 100,000 yuan monthly, 300,000 quarterly, 1,000 per transaction — below, no VAT; the 3% rate reduces to 1% in the same period (real-estate sales, leases, and land-use-right transfers excepted). Conversely: issuing VAT special invoices or other deduction-eligible invoices without real transactions — up to 3 years or custody plus 20,000–200,000 yuan; issuing for others, self-issuing, having others issue for you, and brokering all count; larger tax amounts, 3–10 years; huge, 10+ or life (national)
Note
The VAT law took effect 2026-01-01; the prior small-scale relief notices (2023 Nos. 19 and 1) lapsed or repealed. Amounts unchanged, basis switched — updated here. The criminal text page is the 1997 edition; Article 205's bands were since adjusted, so only verified, unamended bands appear. VAT exemption ≠ income-tax exemption. "Finding invoices to offset costs" is false invoicing, not tax planning.

Anyone claiming to be the tax bureau demanding payment is a scammer: tax goes through the e-tax bureau and 12366 only

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

The tax authorities never phone for card passwords, payment passwords, or SMS codes, and never hand you an account to pay into. Real audits show inspection notices and credentials. Hang up, verify via 12366. Already transferred: call 110 or 96110 for a payment stop immediately.

Cost
Free. On "tax inspection," "account abnormality," or "file or be fined" calls, texts, or friend requests: hang up, don't reply, then verify via 12366 or the governing office's landline.
Benefit
The STA's own notice: "tax authorities will not, via WeChat mini-programs, phone, or SMS, ask for bank-card passwords, payment passwords, account balances, or SMS verification codes related to bank receipts and payments"; "some criminals impersonate tax officers offering 'assisted filing,' 'tax-benefit agency,' or 'policy guidance'"; verify via "12366 or the governing office's landline." On-site audits "must present an inspection notice and inspection credentials"; "taxes are paid only through the e-tax bureau or the service hall — tax authorities provide no designated account." Intermediaries extorting in the authorities' name face fines by severity. Impersonating state functionaries for fraud: 10–15 days plus up to 1,000 yuan; where both fraud and impersonation qualify, "punish under the heavier provision" (national)
Note
These scams target freshly registered proprietors and small companies: "system shows you haven't filed; today or fines," then funnel to their own mini-program for a few hundred yuan — for a filing that's free and takes minutes. Collecting money, write "earnest money" not "deposit-vague"; liquidated damages in figures; vet credit terms like lending

Grade AValue: very highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Only "earnest money" (定金) carries the double rule: your breach forfeits it; their breach returns double. The portion above 20% doesn't count. The homophone "订金" carries no such rule. Credit terms are interest-free loans — a collapsed buyer is a bad debt.

Cost
Free. Write the two characters for earnest money, capped at 20% of contract value. Collect before shipping. Before granting payment terms, vet the counterparty.
Benefit
Earnest money forms on actual delivery. The payer's breach forfeits; the receiver's breach returns the amount plus an equal sum (double return). The portion exceeding the main contract's value by 20% isn't earnest money. Liquidated damages grossly above or below actual loss can be adjusted downward or upward on request. Contract containing both: choose one remedy, never both (national, since 2021)
Note
The homophone carries no Civil Code rule and is generally treated as prepayment — practitioner convention, no verified precedent here. Credit terms lend your money free; before granting, check the counterparty on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System for suits.

Sign the written contract within the first month of employment; register social insurance within 30 days

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: highTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

A month of work without a written contract means double wages monthly from month two, running to a year. Social insurance registers within 30 days of employment; failure fines 1–3× the contributions. "Employee voluntarily waives social insurance" doesn't legally exist.

Cost
The employer share of social insurance runs indefinitely, locally rated. The contract itself is free — use the local HR bureau's template.
Benefit
One month to a year without a written contract: double wages monthly. Social-insurance registration within 30 days of day one; failure draws correction first, then 1–3× contribution fines, handlers 500–3,000 yuan. Late or short contributions accrue 0.05% daily; overdue, another 1–3×. Units self-declare and pay in full; only statutory force majeure defers or reduces. No "voluntary waiver" exists (national)
Note
Double wages run from month two to the year mark — the longer the delay, the dearer. An unsigned, uninsured employee who suffers a work injury or files arbitration brings back-pay, fines, and damages exceeding anything saved.
Sources (2 references)

17

Wages per contract and law; raises, loans, bonuses all in writing

Grade CValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Wages go out on time and in full per contract and law; arrears let employees seek a court payment order directly. Verbal raises and bonuses lose to whoever lacks evidence. Personal loans to employees need written IOUs with amount, interest, and repayment date.

Cost
Free. Write wages into the contract. Raises, bonuses, advances, loans: signed paper, no verbal promises, no wages from your own pocket. The hard part: holding the rule with familiar faces.
Benefit
Labor contracts must state wage arrangements and social insurance; units pay fully and on time per contract and state rules; arrears let employees apply directly for a court payment order. A boss lending personal money creates a loan contract — written save for natural-person-to-natural-person exceptions, stating amount, interest, term, and method. Verbal bonuses lose to the evidence-less party (national)
Note
Not refusing help — routing help through the system. Off-system favors, once habitual, breed disputes when stopped. Personal loans mixed with company books land as your own bad debts when the company bleeds. Statutes verified; the advice is experience, hence C.

Sell first, then build: validate buyers with presales and small orders before investing in production

Grade BValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: large

A year tracking 116 Italian startups: founders who hypothesized first and tested against market feedback performed better, pivoted sooner — and quit no earlier. So: nobody prepaying, nobody ordering small, means don't believe "build it and they will come."

Cost
Tens to hundreds of yuan for a sample or page, then dozens of real customers prepaying or placing small orders. Weeks slower than building first. The hard part: not producing first.
Benefit
A randomized controlled trial followed 116 Italian startups about a year — randomization meaning one group trained, one not, outcomes compared. Trained founders practicing "hypothesize first, test rigorously against market feedback" performed better, pivoted to alternatives more readily, and did not abandon earlier. The authors' reading: the practice cuts spending on false-positive projects (Italy, published 2020)
Note
One study, small sample, Italian — hence B. Title, venue, and abstract verified via Crossref and Semantic Scholar; full-text effect figures unverified. Operationally: no prepayments and no small orders means no faith in "they'll buy once it exists."

Run the sample through a mass-production checklist before starting

Grade CValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: large

One sample versus a thousand differs in where the money sits. Yield sets true cost; minimums and terms set your fronting; inventory sets when money returns. Products in the compulsory-certification catalog can't leave the factory or sell without certification and marks.

Cost
A few hundred yuan for a small pilot batch, then hours computing: yield (sellable units per 100), supplier minimums and payment terms, inventory lockup, packaging and logistics, certification, trademark. The hard part: not skipping ahead.
Benefit
One sample versus a thousand differs in where the money sits. Yield — the share of a batch sellable — sets true cost. Supplier minimums and payment terms set how much you front. Inventory sets when money returns. Catalog products must pass certification and carry the mark before leaving the factory or selling; violations punish under the certification regulations. Catering and food sales need the food-operation license (national)
Note
The checklist itself is method; the statutes verified. Before production, search the CNIPA trademark system for near-matches, then file your own. Using others' marks and art: items 20–21. The certification catalog follows the regulator's latest publication.

20

Keep receipts and supplier records per batch; don't buy at prices obviously below market: employee-bought counterfeits convict the boss

Grade AValue: highMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Selling counterfeits with 30,000 yuan gains or 50,000 yuan sales convicts — up to 3 years. Warehoused unsold counts too. "Didn't know" isn't yours to claim: obviously-below-market purchases without explanation establish knowledge. Receipts and supplier records are the only exemption path.

Cost
Free. Keep per batch: purchase contract, invoices, payment records, supplier's license and authorization. One internal rule: whoever buys signs, and obviously-below-market prices are refused. The hard part: passing up lucrative-looking cheap goods.
Benefit
Selling goods knowingly bearing counterfeit registered marks, gains of 30,000 or sales of 50,000 yuan, crosses the threshold — up to 3 years plus or instead of fines; ten times those numbers, 3–10 years. Unsold warehouse stock counts: goods value at three times the sales threshold likewise convicts. "Knowingly" needs no confession: the 2025 two-supreme interpretation lists five presumptions (rebuttable by proof of genuine ignorance): knowing marks were altered, swapped, or covered; forged or altered authorization documents; prior criminal or administrative punishment for counterfeit sales of the same kind; purchases or sales at obviously below-market prices without justification; and destroying or concealing infringing goods and books, or providing false proof, after discovery. Corporate violations: "fine the unit, and punish the directly responsible managers and other directly liable persons" under the same article — company fined, decision-makers and handlers convicted. Goods bought by employees convict the one who decided. Conversely, the Trademark Law leaves one exit: sellers genuinely unaware of infringement who "can prove the goods were lawfully obtained and identify the supplier bear no compensation liability" — an exit that exists only on paper trails (national; interpretation since 2025-04-26)
Note
Cosmetics, liquor, mother-and-baby, electronics, and apparel are the hot categories, sharing wide price spreads. "Channel goods," "tail orders," and "overseas duty-free" replace no receipts. Beyond prison: administrative confiscation of goods and tools, plus up to 5× fines on 50,000+ operating amounts. Goods already in stock turning wrong: stop selling, seal, contact the brand or regulator — never keep selling or destroy goods and books; destruction fits presumption five exactly. Others' designs: item 21. One scam hunts this entry: strangers offering free pens or trinkets "sell first, settle later" — days later a buyer purchases, notarizes on the spot, and sues for infringement. Free goods lack all three exemption elements: no contract or payment record, no true supplier, obviously abnormal pricing — "lawfully obtained and supplier identified" fails entirely. Unsolicited deliveries with no receipts and only a WeChat ID never reach the shelf. Genuine consignment: written consignment contract, ID and license copies, allocation of infringement risk in writing.

Artwork on products, packaging, tags, and promo images: make it yourself or license it — recoloring and adding icons isn't "changed"

Grade AValue: highMetric: freedomMoney: lowTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Recoloring, re-grounding, or icon-stamping someone's image is still unlicensed use. Reproducing art for profit — 30,000 yuan gained, 50,000 in business, or 500 copies — is the copyright crime, up to 3 years. On trademarks, "confusingly similar" is itself infringement.

Cost
Stock licenses run from tens of yuan per image; original design, hundreds to thousands. Keep a license record per used image. The hard part: not grabbing web-searched images.
Benefit
The copyright law lists "using works by adaptation, translation, or annotation without permission" alongside copying as infringement — so recoloring, re-grounding, and icon-stamping remain unlicensed use. Criminal thresholds: reproducing and selling art without the copyright holder's permission for profit — gains of 30,000 yuan, business volume of 50,000, or 500 cumulative copies — any one suffices, up to 3 years plus or instead of fines; ten times, 3–10. Merely selling others' infringing copies — gains of 50,000 or sales of 100,000 — the selling-infringing-copies crime, up to 5 years. Trademarks likewise: using a similar mark on identical goods, or identical or similar marks on similar goods, "likely to cause confusion" is itself infringement — "similar" being a statutory infringement situation; light modification still infringes (national; interpretation since 2025-04-26)
Note
Three common traps: web-searched cartoon characters and celebrity photos printed on shirts, mugs, and cases; fonts — commercial fonts mostly need separate licensing, free preview ≠ free commercial use; and unauthorized material embedded in commissioned designs — liability stays with the seller. Simplest: commercially licensed stock with saved license pages, or contract clauses assigning素材 sourcing and liability to the designer. Beyond prison: civil damages and administrative confiscation plus 1–5× fines on public-interest harm. Pre-production trademark checks: item 19. Your own images used by others: same rules in reverse. On the job, follow procedures; before off-procedure favors, work out who answers

Free. Work by the system, the orders, the flow; decide nothing beyond your authority; before helping, ask who bears it. The hard part: withstanding "just this once."

Nurses, per regulation: on critical conditions, notify the physician immediately; in emergencies, necessary first aid may precede; on unlawful orders or protocol violations, raise them with the physician and, if necessary, the department head. Losing means exiting by procedure: simple deregistration where possible, bankruptcy when insolvent, never abandonment

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: large

No debts, no unpaid wages, taxes, or insurance: all investors sign a commitment, 20 days' unopposed publication, simple deregistration. Simple deregistration is self-serve: 20 days' publication on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System. With debts outstanding: settle first — collect and repay ("liquidation"). Bankruptcy petitions the court, months. The hard part: facing the loss instead of drifting.

Neither owing nor owed, or all settled; no wage, insurance, or tax arrears; all investors' written commitment: 20 days' unopposed publication enables simple deregistration. Before paying shop-agency operators, store-opening courses, or "no-inventory" schemes: ask what more it will cost and where sales come from

13. Emergencies: what to do first

44 entries

This section covers what to do first, then next, and what never to do. First-aid and wilderness entries count specific causes of death and survival rates; threats and scams count money and personal freedom — the two are never converted into each other. Entries run by "how common × how many lives turn on doing it right" descending. These entries serve first you and your spouse and immediate family — 79.2% of cardiac arrests happen at home, and the person you're most likely to save is family. Friends and colleagues second. Strangers last — lowest benefit tier, with extortion and entanglement risks — so self-protection steps and liability clauses come first. Only minutes-scale actions belong here. Spotting scams and being squeezed over held leverage take days — see Section 8, item 3 (hard anti-fraud rules) and item 32 (leverage extortion). Money already transferred: call 110 or 96110 for a payment stop — Section 8, item 2. Entries in this section are grouped by theme, with item numbers in parentheses. CPR and choking: someone down and not breathing (item 1), elders fallen — don't rush to lift (item 2), choking and unable to speak (item 26), infants choking soundlessly (item 43), infant CPR (item 44). Sudden illness: sudden facial droop, one-sided weakness (item 3), spinning dizziness and unsteadiness (item 4), one eye gone black (item 5), one eye swollen and aching (item 6), crushing chest pain (item 7), tearing pain (item 8), worst-ever headache (item 9), elder dullness weeks after head bump (item 10), one leg suddenly swollen (item 11), anaphylaxis (item 15), someone seizing (item 16), diabetic suddenly trembling (item 17). Trauma and burns: major bleeding — press first (item 12), dog and cat bites (item 13), burns — cool water (item 14), embedded objects — don't pull (item 40), suspected fracture — immobilize (item 41). Poisoning, fire, accidents: electric shock — cut power first (item 18), CO alarm sounding (item 19), swallowed cleaners, pesticides, medication (item 20), chemicals on skin (item 21), heat dizziness without sweat (item 22), heatstroke — weak salt water (item 23), fire — crawl low (item 24), someone drowning (item 25), earthquake — check the building first (item 30). Wilderness: lost in remote country — stay put (item 27), shivering and slurred speech — hypothermia (item 28), snakebite — no cutting, no sucking (item 29), bears, boars, wild dogs (item 31), thunderstorms outdoors (item 32), altitude — climb slowly (item 33), tick bites (item 34), wild water — boil first (item 35). Conflict and after helping: robbed in the wild (item 36), stumbling into a brawl (item 37), injured or out-of-pocket from helping (item 39). Sexual assault and HIV exposure: possible HIV exposure (item 38), after sexual assault (item 42).

1

Someone down and not breathing: press hard on the chest immediately; have a bystander call 120 and fetch the AED

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

The person you press is most likely family — 79.2% of cardiac arrests happen at home. With compressions, survival-to-discharge rises from 3.9% to 16.1%. Unresponsive and not breathing: press. Midpoint between nipples, stacked hands, twice a second, no stopping. Have a second person call 120 and get the AED; your hands don't stop.

Cost
Free. A Red Cross or hospital CPR course, half a day to a day, lasts years. Untrained works too: stack your hands on the midpoint between the nipples and press hard about twice a second, without stopping.
Benefit
Pooling 79 studies, 142,740 people (meta-analysis): out-of-hospital cardiac arrest survival-to-discharge totals just 7.6%. Bystander CPR raises it from 3.9% to 16.1%. Witnessed onset covered 53%; actual bystander compression, only 32%. China's BASIC-OHCA registry logged 38,227 emergency cases, of which 30,282 (79.2%) arrested at home; bystander compression 20.3%, survival-to-discharge 1.2%. The order: compress first, then have the second person call and fetch the AED. When the machine powers on, follow its voice
Note
Children under 1 take a different technique with breaths — item 44. No philtrum-pinching, no hunting family first, no filming. And don't go gentle for fear of breaking ribs. Civil Code Article 184: voluntary emergency aid that injures the rescued owes no compensation.
Sources (3 references)
Sasson C et al. (2010). Predictors of survival from out-of-hospital cardiac arrest: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Circulation: Cardiovascular Quality and Outcomes. https://doi.org/10.1161/CIRCOUTCOMES.109.889576 ; Zheng J et al. (2023). Incidence, process of care, and outcomes of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest in China: a prospective study of the BASIC-OHCA registry. The Lancet Public Health. https://doi.org/10.1016/S2468-2667(23)00173-1 ; 全国人大 (2020). 民法典（第一百八十四条）. https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml
2

Elder fallen, someone down: kneel, call to them, dial 120 — don't rush to lift; for strangers, walking away is lawful in China, and stopping means never manhandling

Grade BValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

This entry's main line is your own elders and acquaintances. Check breathing first; absent, compress per item 1. Breathing: don't lift them either — the fall may follow a stroke or faint, and hoisting worsens it. Kneel, call, ask whether they remember falling. Back pain or anything fracture-like: move nothing, call 120 in place.

Cost
Free. Kneeling, asking, calling: minutes. The hard part: resisting the helping hand. With strangers, add the account: 120 logs your number, callbacks and one questioning session possible; family pursuit means months of litigation with attorney fees yours even on winning.
Benefit
The health ministry's fall-intervention guide states two sentences: "falls are the leading cause of injury death among Chinese over 65" and "on finding an elder fallen, do not rush to lift — handle by situation." Unconscious: call emergency immediately. Vomiting: head to the side, clear mouth and nose. Breathing and pulse stopped: chest compressions. "If moving is needed, keep it smooth, lying flat as far as possible." Conscious: ask about memory of the fall — "if unable to recall, possibly syncope or cerebrovascular accident." Severe headache, facial droop, slurred speech, limb weakness: "lifting immediately may aggravate cerebral hemorrhage or ischemia." Fracture signs, back pain, incontinence: "without relevant expertise, do not move." All such cases: call emergency. Elders wanting to rise: assist slowly, then "rest sitting or lying and observe, leaving only after confirming no harm." On the extortion fear, the law: the Supreme Court's civil-procedure interpretation, Article 90 — parties prove the facts their claims rest on, and the burdened party bears adverse consequences when evidence fails. Civil Code Article 1198: operators and managers of hotels, malls, banks, stations, airports, stadiums, and entertainment venues, and mass-activity organizers, bear tort liability for harm from unmet safety duties. Article 184: "voluntary emergency aid causing harm to the aided bears no civil liability." The Supreme Court's published typical case: a pharmacy owner's CPR broke the rescued person's ribs — 18 days hospitalized, 9,000-odd yuan claimed — the court held the rescuer free of liability
Note
Grade B: the guide states handling without lives-saved numbers. Article 184 covers harm from the rescue itself — voluntary, emergent. "Loading them into your own car" isn't covered; waiting for 120 is safer. After dialing, stay on the line and follow the dispatcher. This judgment framework is for family and acquaintances first. For a stranger on the street, walking away is lawful and cheapest — Chinese law imposes no duty to rescue. Abroad differs: in Germany, failing to help at an accident when you can without great danger to yourself is itself a crime, up to 1 year or fine. Overseas, follow local law. Stopping carries layered bills: time, logged numbers, family pursuit, litigation, workplace fallout, being filmed and posted — see [docs/遇到陌生人出事该不该停.md](../docs/遇到陌生人出事该不该停.md). If you do stop, the one absolute is never manhandle — medically, hoisting can worsen cerebral hemorrhage or spinal injury. One exception: if you operate or manage the venue, or organized the event, walking away can itself be liability — Article 1198's safety duty. Fall prevention: Section 1, item 13. Delayed symptoms after head bumps: item 10 here. The costs of helping: item 39. Online-mobbing evidence: Section 8, item 16.

Sudden facial droop, one-sided arm weakness, slurred speech: call 120 immediately — no waiting, no driving yourself

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Droop, arm weakness, slurred speech: call 120. Clot-busting within 3 hours makes functional independence about 1.75 times as likely as no drug; by 3–4.5 hours, 1.26; past 4.5, no measurable difference. Note the exact onset time. No water, no pills, no self-driving.

Cost
Free. Three moves, learned in a glance: have them smile, raise both arms, say a full sentence.
Benefit
Pooling individual data from 16 thrombolysis trials, 6,756 patients (meta-analysis). Intravenous thrombolysis — drugs reopening the blocked vessel — within 3 hours: odds ratio 1.75 for modified Rankin 0–1 (functionally independent), 95% CI 1.35–2.27; at 3–4.5 hours, 1.26 (1.05–1.51); past 4.5, 1.15 (0.95–1.40) — statistically indistinguishable
Note
Earlier is better; past 4.5 hours, essentially useless. Call 120 rather than drive: ambulances route to stroke centers with advance notice. Record the exact onset time — physicians need it for the thrombolysis decision. No water, no pills, no "rest and see."
Sources (1 references)
Emberson J, Lees KR, Lyden P, et al. (2014). Effect of treatment delay, age, and stroke severity on the effects of intravenous thrombolysis with alteplase for acute ischaemic stroke: a meta-analysis of individual patient data from randomised trials. Lancet, 384(9958), 1929-1935. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(14)60584-5
4

Sudden spinning dizziness with unsteadiness, double vision, one eye darkened, or finger-to-nose misses: treat as stroke, call 120

Grade BValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Face-arms-speech alone misses one-in-ten-odd strokes — some begin without droop or weakness. Adding unsteadiness, double vision, and field gaps cuts misses to 4.4%. Sudden spinning unsteadiness, doubled vision, finger missing the nose: same 120, same time-logging.

Cost
Free. Beyond face-arms-speech (item 3), add two: have them stand with eyes closed and check swaying, diplopia, or field gaps; and self-test pointing finger to nose, eyes closed.
Benefit
A Kentucky stroke center reviewed 736 acute ischemic strokes (vessel-blockage strokes): 14.1% presented with none of facial droop, arm weakness, or slurred speech (FAST). Adding gait instability, leg weakness, and visual symptoms cut misses from 14.1% to 4.4%
Note
Cerebellar and brainstem (posterior-circulation) blockages often show no droop or weakness — just spinning dizziness, veering gait, diplopia, and choking on water and food, most easily misread as cervical spondylosis, low blood sugar, or BPPV. Finger-miss and eyes-closed sway mark cerebellar involvement. But no maneuver excludes stroke: sudden onset without relief means 120 and exact-time logging. Single-hospital chart review; the authors call for validation.
Sources (1 references)
Aroor S, Singh R, Goldstein LB (2017). BE-FAST (Balance, Eyes, Face, Arm, Speech, Time): Reducing the Proportion of Strokes Missed Using the FAST Mnemonic. Stroke, 48(2), 479-481. https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.116.015169
5

One eye blacks out like a curtain drawn — even if it clears in minutes: same-day emergency as stroke

Grade BValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

One eye's curtain-blackout is the retinal supply blocked — the longer the block, the less retina savable. It's also cerebral ischemia, with stroke risk peaking in the following days. Same-day assessment and treatment cut 90-day stroke recurrence from 10.3% to 2.1%. Same-day emergency at a stroke center — not next week's ophthalmology clinic.

Cost
Free. Emergency evaluation and vascular imaging take half a day to a day.
Benefit
The American Heart Association's 2021 statement on central retinal artery occlusion (the retina's main vessel blocked) states it plainly: "acute central retinal artery occlusion is an emergency," to be triaged as such; the longer the ischemia, the less recoverable retina. Oxford's EXPRESS study covered minor stroke and transient ischemic attack (self-resolving brain ischemia): switching to same-day assessment and treatment cut 90-day stroke recurrence from 10.3% (32/310) to 2.1% (6/281)
Note
Grade B: EXPRESS wasn't randomized — before/after periods in one population, other conditions possibly shifting. Minutes-long monocular blackout is most often dismissed as fatigue or low sugar; it's a transient ischemic attack with the stroke window open right after. Painless, non-red, non-tearing monocular vision loss especially. Skip next-day ophthalmology — straight to a stroke-center emergency department.
Sources (2 references)
Mac Grory B, Schrag M, Biousse V, et al. (2021). Management of Central Retinal Artery Occlusion: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association. Effect of urgent treatment of transient ischaemic attack and minor stroke on early recurrent stroke (EXPRESS study): a prospective population-based sequential comparison. Lancet, 370(9596), 1432-1442. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(07)61448-2

One eye swollen, aching, red, halos around lights, with headache, nausea, vomiting: same-day ophthalmic emergency

Grade BValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

This is acute angle-closure glaucoma: the eye's fluid can't drain and pressure spikes. The longer the delay, the more optic nerve crushed — permanently. During Wuhan's lockdown, patients averaged 241 hours to treatment with 21.87% blinded; the next year, 121 hours and 7.84%.

Cost
Free. Emergency tonometry and anterior-chamber exam take half a day.
Benefit
A Wuhan eye hospital compared two periods of acute primary angle-closure glaucoma: lockdown 2020, 54 patients/64 eyes; same period 2021, 46/51, demographically similar. Symptom-to-treatment: 241.84±211.95 hours versus 121.53±96.12 (P=0.001). Presentation intraocular pressure: 52.63±12.45 versus 45.16±9.79 mmHg (P=0.001). Blindness: 21.87% versus 7.84%. Glaucomatous optic neuropathy: 20/64 eyes (31.25%) versus 7/51 (13.73%) (P=0.03). A Korean hospital reviewed 50 eyes post-episode post-lens-extraction: one year on, 25 (50%) retained visual-field defects; longer symptom-to-pressure-control predicted defects (P=0.005). A prospective study sat 43 shallow-chamber people prone in a dark room for an hour: both eyes' pressures rose significantly (P<0.01) — the habitually used eye by a median 3.60 mmHg, the other 2.70 (P<0.05)
Note
Grade B twice over: the Wuhan comparison is retrospective with lockdown confounds inseparable from delay, and the Korean series is 50 eyes, retrospective. The triggers aren't screens but two things stacked: dark-room pupil dilation plus long head-down posture pushing the lens forward. Shallow anterior chambers are the vulnerability — hence the truly high-risk are over 50, hyperopic, with family history of angle closure. All-night gaming rarely triggers this. The commonest misreads: gastroenteritis, migraine, or hypertension — headache and vomiting outshine the eye. Painless non-red monocular blindness is another matter: item 5. Blue-light glasses: Section 6, item 16.

Seminars in Ophthalmology, 40(4), 325-331. https://doi.org/10.1080/08820538.2024.2443972
7

Crushing chest pain, tightness, pressure over 15 minutes unrelieved: call 120 — no toughing it out, no driving

Grade BValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Crushing pain, tightness, pressure beyond 15 minutes: call 120. Vessel reopened within 55 minutes of arrival: 2.8% dead at 30 days; beyond 55 minutes, 9.7%. Every delay kills more heart muscle. No self-driving — losing consciousness en route is a second accident.

Cost
Free.
Benefit
A national Israeli acute-coronary-syndrome survey analyzed ST-elevation myocardial infarction, measuring door-to-balloon (arrival to reopening the blocked vessel by balloon). Intervals ≤55 minutes: 30-day death 5/178 (2.8%); >55 minutes: 15/155 (9.7%)
Note
The study measures in-hospital delay, not onset-to-door — but the logic is identical: every minute kills more muscle. Pain may sit in the upper abdomen, back, or jaw, or present as left-arm numbness. Diabetics and the elderly may feel no pain, only breathlessness. No self-driving.
Sources (1 references)
Karkabi B, Meir G, Zafrir B, et al. (2021). Door-to-balloon time and mortality in patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction. European Heart Journal - Quality of Care and Clinical Outcomes. https://doi.org/10.1093/ehjqcco/qcaa037
8

Sudden tearing pain migrating from chest to back to waist: call 120 and say "the pain is moving"

Grade BValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Tearing pain marching from chest to back to waist: on the 120 call, say "like being ripped open, and it's moving downward." Untreated, drug-only mortality runs 58%. Its management is the opposite of heart attack: only if the physician suspects it do they order contrast CT instead of anticoagulation and thrombolysis. Mention greatly differing arm blood pressures or a missing pulse on one side.

Cost
Free.
Benefit
The International Registry of Acute Aortic Dissection (IRAD) enrolled 464 cases across 12 centers. Among first-reported symptoms, sudden severe sharp pain predominated. In-hospital mortality 27.4% overall; type-A dissection managed on drugs alone, 58% mortality
Note
Dissection and infarction manage oppositely: infarction wants blood thinners and clot-busters, which feed the dissection tear. So volunteer "tearing, moving downward" to steer the physician toward contrast CT. Divergent arm pressures and a missing pulse are hints. Poorly controlled hypertension, Marfan syndrome, and family history of aortic aneurysm or dissection raise the risk. Again: no driving, no waiting until tomorrow.
Sources (1 references)
Hagan PG, Nienaber CA, Isselbacher EM, et al. (2000). The International Registry of Acute Aortic Dissection (IRAD): new insights into an old disease. JAMA, 283(7), 897-903. https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.283.7.897
9

Sudden "worst headache of my life," peaking within an hour: straight to emergency head CT

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

What matters is how fast it peaked. Severe headache peaking within an hour: about 6% is a ruptured surface-brain vessel. Over 40, neck pain or stiffness, witnessed loss of consciousness, onset during activity, instantaneous explosion, or inability to flex the neck forward — any one, go for head CT. Most checked will be fine; one missed rebleed is death.

Cost
Emergency care itself costs little; head CT runs a few hundred yuan.
Benefit
Ten Canadian emergency departments prospectively followed 2,131 thunderclap headaches — peaking within an hour — with predefined criteria. 132 (6.2%) were subarachnoid hemorrhage (surface-brain vessel rupture). The Ottawa SAH rule has six criteria: age 40+, neck pain or stiffness, witnessed syncope, onset during exertion, instantaneous explosion, and limited neck flexion on exam. Any one triggers workup. The rule caught every hemorrhage — sensitivity 100%, 95% CI 97.2%–100.0% — at the price of excluding only 15.3% of non-bleeders (specificity 15.3%)
Note
Not "how bad" but "how fast to worst" — seconds-to-a-minute explosions are the danger sign; slow-building migraines aren't. Vomiting, neck stiffness, photophobia, brief fainting heighten it. Specificity 15.3% means most workups clear — but a missed rebleed is death; worth checking. Don't swallow a painkiller and sleep it off.
Sources (1 references)
Perry JJ, Stiell IG, Sivilotti MLA, et al. (2013). Clinical decision rules to rule out subarachnoid hemorrhage for acute headache. JAMA, 310(12), 1248-1255. https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2013.278018

Elder unsteady, dull, sleepy, or one-sided weak two weeks to months after a head bump: get a head CT

Grade BValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

After an elder's head bump, the blood typically accumulates by the third week — the moment of impact can be entirely uneventful, even unremembered. Post-surgery recurrence reaches 33%, fatality 32%. Sudden confusion, unsteady gait, constant sleepiness, one weak hand: first ask about falls in the past two or three months, then CT.

Cost
Head CT runs 200–300 yuan.
Benefit
The Chinese Neurosurgical Society's expert consensus on chronic subdural hematoma — blood slowly pooling between the meninges, technically a chronic collection between arachnoid and dura — states it "typically forms in the third week after head trauma," predominating in elders. Post-surgery recurrence up to 33%, fatality up to 32%; among patients over 90, only 24% recover well overall. Systematic review: global incidence 3.39–39.1 per 100,000 yearly, rising with age and tripling past 80. Commonest causes: trauma and falls, then chronic alcohol misuse, anticoagulants, and assault. Geriatric review: presentation "typically includes confusion, cognitive decline, gait disturbance, or drowsiness, potentially resembling other geriatric syndromes"
Note
The impact can be uneventful and unremembered. So on finding sudden confusion, unsteadiness, sleepiness, or a weak hand, first ask back two to three months for falls or head bumps, then CT. Don't file it under dementia or old-stroke residuals — misfiling delays. Aspirin, clopidogrel, warfarin, or DOAC users run higher risk, as do heavy drinkers. Fall prevention: Section 1, item 13.

One leg suddenly swollen, tight, tender: care promptly; add sudden breathlessness or chest pain: call 120

Grade BValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

One leg suddenly swollen, a ring bigger than the other, tender: get a leg vein ultrasound promptly. Then sudden breathlessness, chest pain on deep breath, racing heart, faintness — the clot may have reached the lungs: call 120. Diagnosed pulmonary embolism kills 17.4% within 3 months. Sitting over 4 hours roughly doubles the risk — still very low per person.

Cost
Leg venous ultrasound runs 100–200 yuan.
Benefit
The International Cooperative Pulmonary Embolism Registry (ICOPER) enrolled 2,454 confirmed acute pulmonary embolism patients across 52 hospitals in 7 countries — pulmonary embolism being a clot blocking the lung artery. All-cause 3-month mortality: 17.4% (426/2454). WHO's WRIGHT project: travel over 4 consecutive hours roughly doubles venous thromboembolism risk — but per-person probability stays very low, sitting immobile over 4 hours "about one in six thousand"
Note
Both legs swelling together usually means heart, liver, kidney, or venous-valve trouble. One leg suddenly swollen a ring bigger than the other is the classic deep-vein thrombosis picture. Risk clusters: long car and plane rides, bed rest after surgery or fracture, casts, pregnancy and postpartum, cancer, oral contraceptives. A clot breaking loose and blocking the lung artery is pulmonary embolism: sudden breathlessness, worse chest pain on deep breath, racing heart, faintness, coughing blood — at that stage, call 120 directly. The 17.4% is mortality among diagnosed pulmonary embolism, not "leg swelling carries this risk" — don't frighten yourself with the number.
Sources (2 references)
Goldhaber SZ, Visani L, De Rosa M (1999). Acute pulmonary embolism: clinical outcomes in the International Cooperative Pulmonary Embolism Registry (ICOPER). Study results released on travel and blood clots. https://www.who.int/news/item/29-06-2007-study-results-rele…

Major bleeding: press hard on the wound with your hands; limbs that resist pressure get the tourniquet — while calling 120

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Press hard with hands or cloth first; uncontrolled limb bleeding gets the tourniquet; then 120 — once on, never loosen. Among battlefield casualties, tourniquets before shock survived nine in ten; after shock, one in ten; the five who needed but lacked them all died. Place above the wound, twist until bleeding stops, write the time. No shoelaces or cords. Neck and torso get pressure only, never tourniquets.

Cost
A windlass tourniquet runs tens to 100-odd yuan — car and first-aid kit. Learning "above the wound, twist until bleeding stops, note the time" takes minutes.
Benefit
Eleven Texas level-1 trauma centers admitted 1,026 limb-vascular injuries over 6 years; 181 (17.6%) arrived with prehospital tourniquets. Unadjusted: 3.9% death with tourniquet, 5.2% without. After multivariable adjustment, tourniquets remained independently associated with survival — adjusted OR 5.86, 95% CI 1.41 to 24.47. A Baghdad field hospital's 232 casualties: tourniquet before shock, 90% survival; after shock, 10%; the five needing-but-lacking all died, the applied surviving 87%. Order: direct pressure with cloth or towel → uncontrolled limb bleeding, tourniquet → 120 → don't loosen
Note
No thin cords or shoelaces — they neither occlude arteries nor spare skin. Once on, no periodic loosening "to let blood through." Neck and torso: pressure only. In the battlefield data, the tourniquets themselves caused no amputations; transient nerve palsy appeared in 4. China's emergency-physician consensus agrees: once applied prehospital, don't loosen absent definitive hemostasis. Upper-arm bleeding: upper third; thigh bleeding: the groin. Never forearm, calf, elbow, or knee. Aim for under 2 hours total to hospital, but unreachable with no alternative means: keep it on until proper rescue. Belt, tie, or sleeve tourniquets alone rarely hold; add a stick to wind tight.

Bitten or scratched by dog or cat: alternate soap and running water for 15 minutes, vaccinate the same day

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Rabies is nearly 100% fatal once it declares itself — washing plus vaccine is the only road. Alternate soap and flowing water for 15 minutes, vaccinate the same day. Punctured bites or licks on broken skin are category III, adding passive immunization. "It's a family pet, vaccinated" changes nothing: grading follows the wound, not the dog's résumé.

Cost
Washing is free; the full vaccine course runs a few hundred yuan; category-III exposure adds passive immunization (ready-made antibodies injected) at hundreds to a thousand-odd.
Benefit
The 2023 national handling standard, verbatim: "rabies case fatality approaches 100%." Management is "alternately and thoroughly flushing all bites and scratches with soap (or other weak alkaline cleanser) and pressurized running water for about 15 minutes." Light bites on unbroken skin or non-bleeding scratches are category II — vaccinate. Penetrating bites or licks on broken skin are category III — "treat the wound and inject rabies passive immunization and vaccine." WHO: about 59,000 rabies deaths yearly worldwide, 99% dog-transmitted
Note
Never skip care because "family pet, vaccinated" — the standard reads the wound's grade, not the animal's origin. Don't bandage yourself. The ten-day observation decides only whether to stop the series, never whether to start. Wild-animal and bat bites: same handling. Dog owners: vaccinate and leash — Section 8, item 30.

Burns: cool running water for 20 minutes immediately — no toothpaste, no soy sauce

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Twenty minutes of cool running water within 3 hours cuts later graft needs to about 60% of uncooled. Cool, not ice — ice packs deepen injury. Clothing stuck to the wound: don't tear; after cooling, cover with clean cloth and go. No toothpaste, soy sauce, sesame oil, or flour. Remembered late? Cooling within 3 hours still counts.

Cost
Free. 20 minutes.
Benefit
An Australian cohort followed 2,495 burned children: 20 minutes of cool running water within 3 hours ran an odds ratio of 0.6 for grafting (95% CI 0.4–0.8) — about 60% of the uncooled rate. A pooled analysis of 7 studies concurred: "20 minutes of cool running water within three hours significantly reduced the need for grafting and surgical intervention"
Note
Cool water, not ice — ice worsens the injury. Stuck clothing: don't tear; cool, cover with clean cloth, go. No toothpaste, soy sauce, oil, or flour — they obscure depth assessment and invite infection. Late cooling within 3 hours still works.
Sources (2 references)

Sudden whole-body hives plus breathlessness or faintness: treat as anaphylaxis — call 120 and say so explicitly

Grade BValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Whole-body hives plus breathlessness or faintness: treat as anaphylaxis. Call 120, say "suspected anaphylaxis" so the crew brings epinephrine. Antihistamines and steroids act too slowly to substitute. After one episode, get an auto-injector prescribed — mid-outer thigh, through clothing if need be.

Cost
Free. Known severe allergies carry the cost of an epinephrine auto-injector — prescription-only.
Benefit
Epinephrine is the first-line drug for grade-II-and-above anaphylaxis, strongly recommended by guidelines; antihistamines and steroids act too slowly to stand in
Note
The EAACI guideline itself states the field's evidence "remains at a very low level" — the strong recommendation reflects benefit far exceeding risk, not large trials. Epinephrine is prescription-only domestically; most people hold none. What you can do: call 120, say "suspected anaphylaxis," and let the crew bring the drug. After one severe reaction, get the auto-injector prescribed and learn the mid-outer thigh injection (anterolateral), through clothing if necessary.

(2022). EAACI guidelines: Anaphylaxis (2021 update). Allergy. https://doi.org/10.1111/all.15032
16

Someone seizing and falling: clear the surroundings, roll them on their side, time it — put nothing in the mouth

Grade BValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Move hard objects away, roll them on their side, mouth down, watch the clock. Don't restrain, don't pry the mouth, put nothing inside — that only breaks teeth and jaws. Over 5 minutes, recurrence soon after, unarousable or breathing poorly afterward, seizure in water, or first-ever seizure: ambulance. Water only once fully alert.

Cost
Free.
Benefit
Avoid the tooth and jaw injuries of pried mouths and forced objects; avoid restraint fractures. Over 5 minutes is the red line demanding an ambulance
Note
The same page lists the other ambulance triggers: quick recurrence, unarousable or breathing poorly afterward, injury during the seizure, seizure in water, first-ever seizure. Afterward: side-lying, mouth down, water only when fully alert. Households with epilepsy patients use this most; the same moves on strangers return less benefit to you but carry no liability (Civil Code Article 184 — item 2 here, don't rush to lift).

Diabetic suddenly trembling, cold-sweating, slurring: give 15 grams of sugar, recheck in 15 minutes

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

15 grams of sugar — cubes or a small juice box. Recheck at 15 minutes; still low, repeat. Below 3.0 mmol/L is clinically significant hypoglycemia; the point of needing another's help can kill. The unconscious get nothing by mouth — aspiration — straight to 120.

Cost
Free. Carry sugar cubes or a small juice box.
Benefit
Glucose below 3.0 mmol/L is clinically meaningful hypoglycemia; altered consciousness or mobility requiring another's assistance is severe hypoglycemia, potentially fatal
Note
The unconscious get nothing by mouth — aspiration; call 120. The same standard prescribes glucagon for all insulin users and hypoglycemia-prone patients — "All individuals treated with insulin or who are at high risk of hypoglycemia...should be prescribed glucagon." Nasal and pre-filled injectables beat on-the-spot reconstitution. These practices assume yourself or a household diabetic — the pocket sugar is for them too.

18

Electric shock: cut power first, then sweep the source away with dry wood — never grab with hands

Grade BValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Cut power or sweep the source away with dry wood before touching. Grabbing directly turns one casualty into two. Once free of power and not breathing: compress per item 1 — don't fear the "electrical" label. Downed high-voltage lines and substation vicinity: stand off and wait for the power utility.

Cost
Free.
Benefit
Prevent the rescuer joining the circuit — one casualty becoming two. Free of power and not breathing: CPR per item 1. The US CDC's steps: look first, don't touch, the person may still be connected; cut power if possible, else sweep the source with cardboard, plastic, or wood; once free, no breathing or pulse means immediate CPR. A review notes electrocution-arrest survivors often fare well
Note
"Power off before contact" is pure self-interest: grabbing directly makes you the second casualty. Downed lines and substations: stand off for the utility. Shock-induced arrest takes standard compressions and defibrillation — don't hesitate over the "electrical" label.
