Note
Policy direction, not realized wage numbers — local and enterprise implementation varies widely. The actionable part: prefer skills with national occupational standards and grade ladders; laddered skills can plausibly rise by grade. Skills with neither grades nor entry barriers leave you hunting work alone after learning.

After studying: close the book and test yourself — don't reread

Grade AValue: highMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Rereading feels familiar but doesn't hold. Closing the book and self-testing works clearly better; classroom quizzes lift grades by a medium effect. Among ten common methods ranked, self-testing sits top-tier. After each section, recall the points from memory, then check back.

Cost
Free, no added time — the rereading time becomes recall-and-question time. The hard part: self-testing exposes what you didn't retain, and feels worse than rereading.
Benefit
A meta-analysis of 222 studies, 48,478 students: classroom quizzing lifts achievement at a medium effect (g = 0.499), moderated by the control's method, quiz-exam format match, materials, corrective feedback, repetitions, timing, duration, and design. The ten-method review rates "practice testing" and "distributed practice" top-tier (high utility) — effective across ages and abilities, validated across assessments and classrooms
Note
Self-testing forces retrieval, not grading. Practice: recall section points from memory, then check. Corrective feedback amplifies — read the errors. Benefit "large" by effect size and rating; both sources measure grades, not hours, so no time-threshold conversion. Pairs with item 15, the review's other top-tier method.
Sources (2 references)
Yang C, Luo L, Vadillo MA, Yu R, Shanks DR (2021). Testing (quizzing) boosts classroom learning: A systematic and meta-analytic review. Psychological Bulletin, 147(4), 399–435. https://doi.org/10.1037/bul0000309；Dunlosky J, Rawson KA, Marsh EJ, Nathan MJ, Willingham DT (2013). Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques: Promising Directions From Cognitive and Educational Psychology. Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 14(1), 4–58. https://doi.org/10.1177/1529100612453266

Spread the same time across days — never one sitting

Grade AValue: highMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

The same hours spread over days retain better than crammed — 317 experiments agree. One practical rule: the retention horizon sets the interval — testing tomorrow means reviewing today; a month out means spacing days between passes.

Cost
Free, total time unchanged — 3 hours become 1 hour over 3 days. The hard part: starting days early rather than the final night.
Benefit
A meta-analysis of 184 articles, 317 experiments, 839 assessments compares massed versus spaced study (the spacing effect) and short versus long gaps (the lag effect): retention peaks when the interval matches the retention horizon — the longer the horizon, the longer the optimal gap. The ten-method review rates distributed practice top-tier (high utility)
Note
Best stacked with item 14: distribute the self-tests themselves. Cepeda's materials lean toward word-list recall — complex content gets no universal day-count; "farther test, longer gap" is the review's rule, no calendar. Final-night cramming works on the spot and evaporates after.
Sources (2 references)
Cepeda NJ, Pashler H, Vul E, Wixted JT, Rohrer D (2006). Distributed practice in verbal recall tasks: A review and quantitative synthesis. Psychological Bulletin, 132(3), 354–380. https://doi.org/10.1037/0033-2909.132.3.354；Dunlosky J, Rawson KA, Marsh EJ, Nathan MJ, Willingham DT (2013). Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques. Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 14(1), 4–58. https://doi.org/10.1177/1529100612453266
16

Don't make highlighting, rereading, or summarizing your main methods

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Students most use highlighting and rereading — both bottom-tier among ten methods. Summarizing, keyword mnemonics, and imagery-for-text join them. Not useless, but their working conditions run narrow; the same time buys more as self-testing.

Cost
Free — it saves time. The hard part: these feel easiest and most "studious."
Benefit
The ten-method review grades by generalizability across conditions, students, materials, and assessments. Top-tier: practice testing and distributed practice. Middle: elaborative interrogation, self-explanation, interleaved practice. Bottom five: summarization, highlighting (underlining), keyword mnemonic, imagery for text, rereading — "most students report rereading and highlighting, which do not reliably improve performance and should be replaced, e.g., practice testing in place of rereading"
Note
Highlighting may mark "where I'll self-test later" — the failure is treating the marking itself as learning. Bottom-tier isn't zero, the review notes — narrow conditions, more research needed. Replacements: items 14 and 15.
Sources (1 references)
Dunlosky J, Rawson KA, Marsh EJ, Nathan MJ, Willingham DT (2013). Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques: Promising Directions From Cognitive and Educational Psychology. Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 14(1), 4–58. https://doi.org/10.1177/1529100612453266
17

Interleave problem types — never twenty of one kind in a row

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Massed same-type blocks feel smooth but blur later discrimination of which method applies. Shuffled practice holds better long-term at a medium effect — but it picks materials: strongest for visual categorization, weaker for mathematics, and word learning actually favors blocking.

Cost
Free — reorder the workbook by type into shuffled order. The hard part: interleaving drops in-the-moment accuracy, feeling like regression.
Benefit
A multilevel meta-analysis of 59 studies, 238 effect sizes, 158 samples: interleaved over blocked practice runs a medium overall effect (g = 0.42). By material: painting best (g = 0.67), other visual materials strong; mathematics smaller (g = 0.34); expository texts and taste materials nonsignificant; vocabulary reverses toward blocking (g = −0.39). Regression: the more similar the categories, the less similar within-category items, and the more complex the materials, the bigger interleaving's advantage
Note
Item 16's review graded interleaving middle-tier on thinner evidence then. Combined reading: interleave what requires "recognize the type, pick the method" — math problem types, cases, statute application; block what needs raw memorization — vocabulary, term definitions.
Sources (1 references)
Brunmair M, Richter T (2019). Similarity matters: A meta-analysis of interleaved learning and its moderators. Psychological Bulletin, 145(11), 1029–1052. https://doi.org/10.1037/bul0000209
18

Don't pick study methods by "I'm visual, he's auditory"

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: small

Many believe everyone has a learning style — visual, auditory — and matching teaching to it teaches better. Rigorous tests are few, almost none support it, and several run directly contrary. Preferences exist; evidence that preference-matched teaching learns better doesn't.

Cost
Free — stop selecting materials and courses by the typology, and stop paying for style assessments.
Benefit
A commissioned review: proving "teach to the style" requires grouping students by style, randomizing each group across methods, and testing identically — the valid signature being a crossover interaction where one style's best method isn't another's. "Almost no" such interactions were found; the literature is vast, properly designed studies few, several contradicting the matching hypothesis outright — insufficient evidence for style assessment in education
Note
The review also notes most style theories were never tested at all, let alone refuted. Avoid paying for style assessments and style-matched courses. Selection criteria: items 9 and 13.
Sources (1 references)
Pashler H, McDaniel M, Rohrer D, Bjork R (2008). Learning Styles: Concepts and Evidence. Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 9(3), 105–119. https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1539-6053.2009.01038.x
19

For memorized content, quiz yourself in the form it will be used — never mere verbatim recitation

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Self-testing's benefits travel beyond the exact items. Across 192 comparisons and 10,000-plus people, it works on changed question formats, application, and reasoning — small-to-medium — while two cases nearly fail: reversed cue-and-answer, and material never tested before.

Cost
Free, no extra time — swap recitation for use-form self-quizzing. The hard part: thinking through how it will actually be used.
Benefit
A meta-analysis of 40-plus years — 67 articles, 122 experiments, 192 transfer effects, 10,382 participants: versus re-exposure without testing, test-enhanced learning transfers at d=0.40 (95% CI 0.31 to 0.50). Strongest transfer: changed test format, application and inference questions, medical diagnoses, synonym cues. Weakest: stimulus-response reversal, studied-but-never-tested material, worked examples. Response-format match, retrieval practice with detailed feedback, and first-test success strongly modulate positive transfer. Publication-bias corrections barely moved moderator effects but compressed intercepts: with none of the conditions met, positive transfer often vanishes
Note
"Memorize" blurs two acts: re-exposure (rereading, highlighting) and closed-book retrieval. The first class bottoms the ten-method rankings (item 16); do the second — item 14, distributed per item 15. Practice: work out the future use first — selecting on an exam or judging on-site — and quiz in that form. Reverse-direction quizzing stays worth doing: this meta-analysis found reversal-direction transfer weakest, so train both directions.
Sources (1 references)
Pan SC, Rickard TC (2018). Transfer of test-enhanced learning: meta-analytic review and synthesis. Psychological Bulletin, 144(7), 710-756. https://doi.org/10.1037/bul0000151
20

Professional titles: first your series and level, then the filing channel by employer type

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: small

Titles run 27 national series, each in junior, intermediate, and senior, climbed rung by rung. Employed: the unit reviews, publicizes, and files. Private-enterprise: filing service points, talent agencies, or industry associations. Freelancers: local HR-organized evaluations.

Cost
Free. One read of the province's current notice, half an hour.
Benefit
27 series nationally — economics, engineering, health, publishing — across senior, intermediate, and junior tiers. MOHRSS Order 40 covers enterprises, public institutions, social organizations, individual economic organizations, and freelancers. Applicants file level by level; employers review and publicize no fewer than 5 working days. Private-enterprise and freelance applicants may route through personnel agencies for review, publicity, and recommendation. Localities must run filing service points in science parks, high-tech zones, and the like, or accept filings through talent intermediaries, associations, chambers, and societies. Qualified freelancers join local evaluations by domicile. Verifiable-online materials demand no added certificates; incomplete submissions get one-shot deficiency notices. Private-enterprise staff file at the labor-relationship locality; posted away for a continuous year, filing sits at the posting locality. Retirees may not file; public-institution staff under demerit-plus discipline may not file during the discipline (national)
Note
No national materials list exists; each series and province issues annual notices carrying the checklists, deadlines, and performance conditions — step one is the provincial HR department's site. Papers are no longer universal: the 2016 reform bars papers as a hard bar for applied talent and drops unified foreign-language and computer exams. Skilled workers have a path: qualified high-skill talent may join the engineering series. Civil servants may not file.
Sources (4 references)
人力资源和社会保障部令第 40 号 (2019). 职称评审管理暂行规定. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5437137.htm：第二条、第十三条、第十四条、第十五条、第十六条、第十七条、第十八条；人力资源社会保障部办公厅 (2020). 关于进一步做好民营企业职称工作的通知. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-03/03/content_548…：「在专业技术人才密集的创业孵化基地、高新技术开发区、科技园区等地设立职称申报受理服务点，或通过人才中介服务机构、工商联、行业协会商会、学会等社会组织受理民营企业专业技术人才职称申报」「民营企业专业技术人才被派驻外地连续工作一年以上的，可按有关规定在派驻地申报职称评审」；新华社 (2024). 职称评审进入高峰，信息如何查？有何新变化？ https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202410/content_6978917.htm：「我国共设有经济、工程、卫生、出版等27个职称系列」「符合条件的自由职业者，可根据属地原则申报参加当地人社部门组织的职称评审」；中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅 (2016). 关于深化职称制度改革的意见. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5163445.htm：「不将论文作为评价应用型人才的限制性条件」「对职称外语和计算机应用能力考试不作统一要求」「符合条件的高技能人才，可参加工程系列专业技术人才职称评审」「公务员不得参加专业技术人才职称评审」
21

Junior and intermediate titles like accounting come by national exam — match credentials and years before registering

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: small

Some series' junior and intermediate titles are examined — pass and hold, no separate evaluation. Accounting: assistant accountant needs senior-high-plus; accountant needs 4 years of accounting on a bachelor's, 5 on a diploma. Certain occupational qualifications may directly confer the corresponding title.

Cost
Registration fees by province; months of spare-time preparation.
Benefit
The 2016 reform: fields running unified national exams for junior and intermediate titles hold no corresponding evaluation; where titles and qualifications bind tightly, qualifications confer the title and count toward filing higher. Accounting: assistant accountant and accountant by unified national exam; senior accountant by exam-plus-evaluation, full senior by evaluation. Conditions — assistant: senior-high graduation or above (secondary vocational and technical included). Accountant: doctorate; or master's plus 1 year of accounting; or second bachelor's or graduate-class completion plus 2; or bachelor's plus 4; or diploma plus 5. Accounting master's and doctoral degree holders exam-exempt Financial Management (national)
Note
Whether your series examines, evaluates, or combines sits in its "guidance on deepening ×× title reform," issued series by series and searchable in the policy library. Exam times and subjects follow the year's announcements. Civil servants may sit accounting exams but join no title evaluations.
Sources (3 references)
中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅 (2016). 关于深化职称制度改革的意见. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5163445.htm：「专业技术人才取得职业资格即可认定其具备相应系列和层级的职称，并可作为申报高一级职称的条件。初级、中级职称实行全国统一考试的专业不再进行相应的职称评审或认定。」；人力资源社会保障部、财政部 (2019). 关于深化会计人员职称制度改革的指导意见. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-09/27/content_543…：「助理会计师、会计师实行全国统一的会计专业技术资格考试」「高级会计师采取考试与评审相结合方式，正高级会计师一般采取评审方式」；财政部等 (2024). 关于做好会计专业学位与会计专业技术资格衔接有关工作的通知. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6952602…
22

No agency-filed titles, no ghostwritten papers, no fabricated materials: verified means revocation plus 3 years in the integrity file

Grade AValue: highMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Titles won with false materials, ghostwriting, or plagiarism get revoked on verification; the dishonesty record runs 3 years and enters the national credit platform; false declarations bar refiling for 3 years. HR authorities also pursue agencies' false advertising, counterfeit evaluations, and fake certificates.

Cost
Free. The hard part: resisting "pay to pass" ads.
Benefit
MOHRSS Order 40: titles obtained through false materials, plagiarized works, or other improper means are revoked, recorded in the title-evaluation integrity archive and the national credit-information platform for 3 years. The 2024 supervision measures name applicant violations: false commitments and forged information, paper fraud and ghostwriting, performance fabrication, and favor-seeking. Applicants sign personal commitments; false ones bar filing for 3 years. HR authorities with public security, cyberspace, and market regulation pursue agencies' false websites, advertising, contract traps, counterfeit evaluations, and fake certificates; serious criminal suspicion transfers to the authorities (national)
Note
One authenticity test: properly evaluated titles verify on the national title-verification platform — entry via the 12333 site, the 12333 app, and the MOHRSS portal. Unfiled committees' results never appear. So "guaranteed pass," "no personal attendance," "usable even if unverifiable" almost certainly means trouble. Beneficiary: mainly yourself; benefit sized by avoided revocation and 3-year dishonesty record.
Sources (4 references)
人力资源和社会保障部令第 40 号 (2019). 职称评审管理暂行规定. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5437137.htm：第三十九条；人力资源社会保障部 (2024). 职称评审监管暂行办法. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202408/content_6969436…：第五条、第十五条、第十七条、第二十七条；人力资源社会保障部办公厅 (2022). 关于进一步做好职称评审工作的通知. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-12/24/content_573…：「未经备案的职称评审委员会，评审结果不纳入全国职称评审信息查询验证系统」；新华社 (2024). 职称评审进入高峰，信息如何查？有何新变化？ https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202410/content_6978917.htm：「大家可通过www.12333.gov.cn网页、手机12333客户端、人力资源社会保障部门户网站、"人力资源和社会保障部"微信公众号等多种渠道进行登录」
23

A title isn't a raise: ask whether your employer evaluates within post quotas or evaluates without appointing

Grade BValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: small

Titles ground hiring, assessment, and promotion — but evaluation and appointment are two things. Public institutions usually evaluate within post ratios and mostly appoint; units without post management may separate the two, evaluating without granting the post or pay. Moving units or regions may require re-evaluation or confirmation.

Cost
Free. One question to HR.
Benefit
MOHRSS Order 40, Article 2: evaluation results are an important basis for hiring, assessment, and promotion. The 2016 reform: fully post-managed public institutions generally evaluate within structural post ratios; units without post management, and widely distributed series and emerging occupations, may separate evaluation from appointment. On cross-region or cross-unit mobility, titles re-evaluate or confirm per management authority, save state provisions otherwise (national)
Note
Grade B: the documents state the evaluation-appointment linkage without a national "how much per title" number. Actionable: in public institutions and SOEs, ask HR about post vacancies and appointment rules; in private firms, ask whether the boss honors the certificate and at what price.
Sources (2 references)
人力资源和社会保障部令第 40 号 (2019). 职称评审管理暂行规定. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5437137.htm：第二条、第二十九条；中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅 (2016). 关于深化职称制度改革的意见. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5163445.htm：「对于全面实行岗位管理、专业技术人才学术技术水平与岗位职责密切相关的事业单位，一般应在岗位结构比例内开展职称评审。对于不实行岗位管理的单位，以及通用性强、广泛分布在各社会组织的职称系列和新兴职业，可采用评聘分开方式。」

24. Seeing the doctor: less money, fewer detours

12 entries

Metrics: money and time. This section covers the care path itself — which hospital first, how to move up, where the money saves. Plus emergency triage, and the assessments and certificates after serious injury. What benefits you can claim: Section 7. Chronic disease long-term: Section 16. On-scene emergencies: Section 13. The primary basis is the State Council's April 2026 measures on tiered care — tiering by severity to decide which hospital level first — which ties "start at the base" directly to savings. Local rollout varies; the text states the national rules, and your pooling area's insurance and health authorities govern locally. The pooling area is your enrollment locality, usually a city.

1

Common illnesses start at the community clinic; referral up the ladder keeps the deductible counting once

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Community first, then community-referred hospital admission counts your out-of-pocket deductible once. Direct tertiary admission later stepping down to community rehab may pay it twice. Downward transfers skip re-deductibles within the same disease cycle.

Cost
Free, one community visit first. The hard part: resisting the direct specialist booking.
Benefit
Insured patients referred level-by-level through base institutions get continuous inpatient-deductible counting at upper hospitals — the deductible being the upfront stretch before insurance begins; continuous meaning the two hospitals share one counting, no second outlay. Patients stepped down from upper hospitals carry no new deductible within the same disease cycle
Note
Direct tertiary admission with later step-down may pay the deductible twice; referral counts once. Referral rules sit with provinces, cities, and medical alliances — ask the community first. Stable chronic disease belongs nowhere near big-hospital refills: those clinics shrink while communities dispense 12 weeks at a time — Section 16, item 5.
Sources (1 references)
国务院办公厅 (2026). 关于加快建设分级诊疗体系的若干措施. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031…：「统筹地区内经基层医疗卫生机构逐级转诊的参保患者，在上级医院的住院起付线可连续计算；由上级医院下转至基层医疗卫生机构的住院患者，同一疾病周期内不再另设住院起付线。」
2

Within one pooling area, lower-tier hospitals reimburse more — about 10 percentage points per level

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

The same hospitalization bill reimburses more the lower the tier — localities must spread the tiers about ten points apart. A 10,000-yuan bill dropping from 80% to 70% coverage moves your share from 2,000 to 3,000 yuan. New insurance funds also tilt toward the base.

Cost
Free. The hard part: not running to the big hospital.
Benefit
The document requires localities to spread reimbursement levels across hospital tiers "in principle, tier by tier, gaps of about 10 percentage points." By that gap, each tier up costs about 10% of the reimbursable bill extra out-of-pocket — 10,000 yuan at 80% versus 70% runs 2,000 versus 3,000; the extra 1,000 is a tenth of the total but half again on your share. Actual ratios, deductibles, and caps vary; the 10-point arithmetic is illustrative. Annual incremental funds tilt basic-ward
Note
The same bill at base versus tertiary can differ by thousands out-of-pocket. Base-manageable illnesses stay down — which isn't "everything at the community clinic."
Sources (1 references)
国务院办公厅 (2026). 关于加快建设分级诊疗体系的若干措施. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031…：「因地制宜适当拉开参保人员在不同等级医疗卫生机构的住院报销水平，原则上统筹地区内医疗卫生机构住院报销比例逐级拉开10个百分点左右的差距。」「具备条件的地方，可按分级诊疗导向酌情拉开参保人员在不同等级医疗卫生机构的门诊报销水平。」
3

Needing the big hospital: go through base referral or the hospital's referral center — never scalpers

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Big hospitals reserve slots and beds for base-referred patients and must run referral centers or designated departments by 2027. No slot doesn't mean no path. Scalper tickets cost more and may land you in the wrong department.

Cost
Free, one extra referral step.
Benefit
Lead hospitals of tight medical alliances "reserve a certain proportion of slots and beds for base institutions and promptly treat base-referred patients" — tight alliances being hospitals and community institutions bound into one cooperating group, so referrals draw on separate slots and beds away from the lobby scramble. Institutions must run referral centers or designated departments, full coverage by 2027
Note
Reserved slots exist precisely for referrals — no public slot means the referral route. Scalpers cost more and misplace you. No referral center found: call the hospital's service line.
Sources (1 references)
国务院办公厅 (2026). 关于加快建设分级诊疗体系的若干措施. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031…：「牵头医院要为基层医疗卫生机构预留一定比例的号源和床位，并及时接诊经基层转诊患者。」「医疗机构要强化转诊服务统一管理，设立转诊中心或指定固定部门承担患者转诊服务工作，到2027年实现全覆盖。」
4

Before cross-province care, ask locally first — necessity in principle requires associate-chief-physician-or-above assessment

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Whether to seek care elsewhere is assessed, in principle, by physicians at associate-chief rank or above in secondary and tertiary hospitals. Temporary out-of-town care reimburses differently than same-tier home care, per local rules — asking first beats discovering rejection after arrival.

Cost
Free, one question before departure.
Benefit
Cross-pooling-area and cross-province necessity is assessed, in principle, by physicians of associate-chief rank or above at second- and third-tier hospitals. Temporary cross-province care reimbursement "maintains a reasonable difference" against same-tier home institutions — the same illness away returns less
Note
"Temporary out-of-town care" and "long-term out-of-town residence" are different filings at different rates — filings and direct-settlement diseases: Section 16. Never travel first and think reimbursement after.
Sources (1 references)
国务院办公厅 (2026). 关于加快建设分级诊疗体系的若干措施. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031…：「原则上由二、三级医院副主任医师及以上职称人员评估患者跨统筹地区、跨省异地就医的必要性。」「进一步强化异地就医直接结算管理服务，跨省临时外出就医人员报销水平与参保地同级别医疗机构报销水平保持合理差异。」
5

After every visit: keep your own copy of records, reports, and imaging

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Reading and copying your records is your statutory right — outpatient records, admission notes, lab slips, imaging, surgical and anesthesia records, pathology, and bills. A dedicated window handles it at cost. Changing hospitals, second opinions, commercial insurance, and disputes all run on this stack.

Cost
Free — hospitals may charge published copying costs. The hard part: remembering every time.
Benefit
The regulations list consulting and copying as patient rights, covering outpatient records, admission notes, temperature sheets, orders, lab reports, imaging, consent forms, surgical and anesthesia records, pathology, nursing records, and costs — the full record. Hospital changes, second opinions, insurance claims, and disputes all rest on it
Note
A dedicated window takes requests — no begging physicians. Read the copy list straight from Article 16: outpatient records, admission notes, temperature sheets, orders, labs, imaging; then surgical and anesthesia records, pathology, nursing records, and bills. File chronologically; the crown pieces are discharge summaries, operative reports, pathology, and key imaging. Chronic disease logs: Section 16.
Sources (2 references)
国务院 (2018). 医疗纠纷预防和处理条例（国务院令第 701 号）第十六条：「患者有权查阅、复制其门诊病历、住院志、体温单、医嘱单、化验单（检验报告）、医学影像检查资料、特殊检查同意书、手术同意书、手术及麻醉记录、病理资料、护理记录、医疗费用以及国务院卫生主管部门规定的其他属于病历的全部资料。」「患者要求复制病历资料的，医疗机构应当提供复制服务，并在复制的病历资料上加盖证明印记……可以收取工本费，收费标准应当公开。」「患者死亡的，其近亲属可以依照本条例的规定，查阅、复制病历资料。」第十五条「任何单位和个人不得篡改、伪造、隐匿、毁灭或者抢夺病历资料。」https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-08/31/content_531…；国家卫生计生委、国家中医药管理局 (2013). 医疗机构病历管理规定（2013 年版）：医疗机构「应当指定部门或者专（兼）职人员负责受理复制病历资料的申请」，复制在申请人在场的情况下进行并加盖证明印记. http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2014/content_2600084.htm
6

Questioning the care: demand record sealing on the spot — both parties present, listed, each holding a copy

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Doubting the treatment lets you seal the records: both parties present, inventory listed, signed and stamped, one copy each. Records incomplete seal the completed part. Suspected infusion, transfusion, injection, or medication harm: the bag, vial, and tubing get sealed too.

Cost
Free, pending both parties completing the formality. The hard part: saying it to the physician's face.
Benefit
The regulations: "sealing and unsealing of records in medical disputes shall proceed with both parties present," originals or copies held by the institution; incomplete records seal the completed portion first. Institutions list the sealed items, both parties sign or stamp, each holding a copy. For suspected infusion, transfusion, injection, or medication harm, the parties jointly seal and unseal the physical items; testing goes by joint commission to qualified agencies, or by the county health authority's designation where joint commission fails; suspected transfusion harm brings the blood station's personnel. Hard constraint: "no unit or individual may tamper with, forge, conceal, destroy, or seize medical records." Disputes resolved or 3 years unclaimed let the institution unseal (national; since 2018-10-01)
Note
Sealing and copying are different acts — copying is routine (item 5); sealing fixes evidence against later revision. Suspected infusion or medication harm seals the bag, vial, and tubing with the records — never let them be carried off. Institutions must post dispute channels and run unified complaint departments — take it there, not to the physician on shift.
Sources (1 references)
国务院 (2018). 医疗纠纷预防和处理条例（国务院令第 701 号，第十五、二十四、二十五条）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-08/31/content_531…
7

Acute and serious: straight to emergency triage, never the registration queue

Grade AValue: highMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Emergency ranks by severity in four grades, graded at the entrance triage desk, not registration. Untriaged means unranked in the system — however grave, you shuffle with the queue. Lead with the most dangerous: major bleeding, breathlessness, unconsciousness, impalement, crushing chest pain.

Cost
Free, a few extra steps to the triage desk. State the deadliest symptom in one sentence.
Benefit
The 2024 emergency quality indicators grade triage into four levels: "I critical — immediate treatment"; "II emergent — assessment and treatment concurrently"; "III urgent — treatment within a short time"; "IV non-urgent or sub-acute — routine order." Beijing's standard sets the responses: level 1 "immediate assessment and treatment, resuscitation or rescue room"; level 2 "immediate vital-sign monitoring, treatment within 10 minutes, rescue room"; level 3 "priority over level 4, general area, reassessment past 30 minutes' wait"; level 4 "routine order, reassessment past 4 hours." Triage "adheres to critical-first," with the triage area conspicuously at the emergency entrance (four-level grading national; response times Beijing's)
Note
The four grades are national; per-grade timings are provincial — Beijing's is the verbatim-checkable version. Grading reads pulse, pressure, oxygen, and symptoms, not your felt pain. Level-1 hard markers: heart rate above 180 or below 40; systolic pressure under 70 (the higher number); oxygen under 80%; shock, confirmed infarction, acute consciousness disorders. Feeling under-graded: state the deadliest symptom again; deterioration in the queue means immediate re-triage. Truly critical: 120 beats self-transport — pre-hospital physicians grade on the same scale and pre-notify the hospital (Section 13).
Sources (2 references)
国家卫生健康委办公厅 (2024). 关于印发急诊医学等 6 个专业医疗质量控制指标（2024 年版）的通知（国卫办医政函〔2024〕150 号）附件 1，指标四「急诊分级分诊执行率」. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6951260…；北京市卫生健康委员会 (2019). 北京市加强急诊预检分诊分级工作方案及附件《北京市医院急诊预检分诊分级标准（试行）》：「坚持急危重症优先就诊原则。按照患者病情的严重程度，遵循从重到轻、从病情迅速变化到相对稳定的原则，合理安排患者就诊顺序。」「在急诊科入口的显著位置，设置急诊预检分诊区域」. http://wjw.beijing.gov.cn/zwgk_20040/ylws/201912/t20191216_…
8

No money, no ID, no name — emergency treats you first anyway

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

The disease-emergency-assistance fund pays first aid for two classes: the unidentifiable and the unpaying. Hospitals may not refuse or delay rescue, and ambulance services may not decline over money. So no enduring at home broke, and no skipping the ambulance for fear of bills. The fund covers first aid only — later hospitalization runs on insurance and medical assistance.

Cost
Free.
Benefit
The system covers "patients suffering acute, severe, and critical illness or injury in China needing emergency care whose identity is unclear or who cannot pay." The fund pays "emergency-care costs of patients whose identity cannot be determined" and "outstanding emergency-care costs of identified patients unable to pay." "Medical institutions and their staff must promptly and effectively rescue acute, severe, and critical patients, and may not refuse, shirk, or delay treatment for any reason." Pre-hospital: the national emergency number 120; centers "may not refuse, shirk, or delay pre-hospital services for dispatch reasons" nor "for cost reasons"; transport follows "nearest, most urgent, professionally sufficient, and patient preference considered" (national; since 2013)
Note
The fund pays only the first-aid stretch, after treatment, applied for by the institution — you never collect at a window. The insured still run insurance first; provincial procedures and caps vary. Transport ranks "nearest, most urgent" ahead of preference — ambulances needn't take you to your chosen hospital; the nearest capable one wins when critical. Remaining burdens: medical assistance — Section 7, item 10.
Sources (2 references)
国务院办公厅 (2013). 关于建立疾病应急救助制度的指导意见（国办发〔2013〕15 号）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2013-03/01/content_606…；国家卫生和计划生育委员会 (2014). 院前医疗急救管理办法（委令第 3 号，第十三、二十二、二十三、二十五条）. http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2014/content_2580977.htm
9

Disability assessment waits until treatment concludes — too early under-grades

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: large

Compensation rides on the grade; the grade rides on residual impairment after treatment. The standard mandates assessment "after treatment concludes or clinical effect stabilizes." Assessing with bones unhealed or hardware in place grades that interim state — depressing your own grade. Ordinary fractures healing without functional loss grade nothing.

Cost
Assessment fees run hundreds to 2,000 yuan, advanced by the applicant; waiting for treatment conclusion or stable effect — typically 3–6 months post-injury, sometimes longer. The hard part: waiting while still healing.
Benefit
The Human Injury Disability Grading sets timing "after treatment of the primary injury and its directly associated complications concludes or clinical effect stabilizes," grading disability in 10 levels — level 1 (100% disability rate) to level 10 (10%), each level 10 points apart — judged by structural damage, functional impairment, and dependence on care and nursing, "with appropriate consideration of social-interaction and psychological factors due to disability." Level-10 fracture clauses include "one vertebral compression fracture (compression reaching 1/3) or comminuted fracture," "two-plus pelvic fractures or comminuted fracture with malunion," and "any major limb joint (ankle excepted) losing 25%-plus function." Same-site same-nature disabilities never double-count; multiple disabilities list grades separately (national; since 2017-01-01)
Note
Three disability systems never interchange: assault, traffic, and personal injury run judicial appraisal under the Grading (computing disability compensation — Section 9); work injury runs labor-capacity appraisal under its own ten grades (Section 19); disability policy benefits require the separate disability certificate (item 10). Assemble records, operative notes, and follow-up imaging beforehand (item 5) — missing imaging is the commonest grade-depressor. Old conditions mixing with new injury: the opinion must state the injury's share of the disability — a line that directly moves the money.
Sources (1 references)
最高人民法院、最高人民检察院、公安部、国家安全部、司法部 (2016). 关于发布《人体损伤致残程度分级》的公告（2016 年 4 月 18 日发布，2017 年 1 月 1 日施行），标准第 4.2、4.4、4.5、5.10.6、6.2 条. https://www.moj.gov.cn/pub/sfbgw/zwxxgk/fdzdgknr/fdzdgknrtz…
10

Lasting impairment after treatment: apply for the disability certificate at the county disabled persons' federation of your registration

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: medium

The certificate gates disability benefits — it isn't an injury proof. Seven categories — visual, hearing, speech, physical, intellectual, mental, multiple — each graded 1–4. Process: application, acceptance, designated-agency assessment, publication, review, issuance; valid ten years, renewed free. Failure is failure — connections don't grade.

Cost
The certificate itself is free; assessment and photo fees are yours in principle, waivable for hardship. Bring ID, household register, and three 2-inch white-background photos to the county federation; passing assessment publishes 5 working days in the village or community, with the federation reviewing within 10 working days. The hard part: trips and waiting.
Benefit
The certificate "is the legal credential certifying disability category and grade, and the important basis for disabled persons to enjoy state and local preferential policies," graded under the national standard GB/T 26341-2010. Issuance runs voluntary-application, domicile-managed; county federations accept and issue on provincial designated hospitals' assessment conclusions; passing conclusions publish 5 working days with review within 10; "no certificate cost," assessment and photo costs "in principle self-borne; conditional localities may subsidize; special hardship gets coordinated reduction." Valid ten years, free renewal; category or grade changes support re-assessment; disagreements go to the municipal federation within 10 working days, then the provincial expert committee concludes (national; since 2018-01-01)
Note
Do the math first: the certificate pays nothing directly — it connects the two disability subsidies (Section 7, item 8: living subsidy for dibao-household members, nursing subsidy for grade 1–2 with long-term care needs) and local rehabilitation, assistive-device, tax, employment, and transit benefits, all provincially varied — check the local federation's site before running the trips. It substitutes neither for judicial disability grading nor work-injury appraisal (item 9). Personal use only; lapsed-status certificates cancel with a one-year re-application bar; multiple disabilities grade by the heaviest category.
Sources (1 references)
中国残疾人联合会、国家卫生和计划生育委员会 (2017). 中华人民共和国残疾人证管理办法（2017 年 5 月 27 日发布，2018 年 1 月 1 日施行；第二、三、五、七、九、十七、十九、二十二、二十五条）. https://www.bdpf.org.cn/cms68/web1459/subject/n1/n1459/n150…
11

Thanking the doctor who saved you: thank-you letters, banners, and satisfaction surveys — never red envelopes; the code bans valuables, not gratitude

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Money upfront buys no priority — slots, beds, scarce drugs, and surgical scheduling are all barred from conversion. Thanking afterward is fine, but cigarettes, liquor, and envelopes put the physician in violation. Three thanks actually land: a serious satisfaction survey, a named letter or banner, and keeping follow-up appointments.

Cost
Free. One letter or one survey, a dozen-odd minutes.
Benefit
The Nine Codes of Clean Practice (2021), item 7: "maintain treatment order, do not undermine care equity... strictly prohibited: converting slots, beds, scarce drugs and consumables, or examination and surgical arrangements into benefits." Item 8: "build harmonious relations, accept no 'red envelopes'... strictly prohibited: soliciting or accepting gifts, cash, shopping cards, securities, equity, or other financial products from patients and their families," and "strictly prohibited: attending banquets, travel, fitness, or entertainment arranged or paid by the patient side." Institutions must enforce, supervise, and "resolutely punish violations." Satisfaction surveys feed tertiary public hospitals' performance evaluation (the 2019 State Council opinion): the indicator system spans "medical quality, operating efficiency, sustained development, and satisfaction evaluation," hospital satisfaction comprising patient and staff satisfaction, measured through outpatient, inpatient, and staff surveys, on a nationally unified platform — by March 2019 all tertiary public hospitals entered the national survey platform with results in performance evaluation. Hospitals must also manage complaints (the 2019 Complaint Measures): second-tier-plus institutions run patient-relations offices "uniformly receiving complaints, investigating and verifying, proposing handling, and promptly replying," with staff encouraged to collect opinions (national)
Note
The beneficiaries: you and the person who saved you. Wanting to thank after an all-night rescue is human — only the form changes. Envelopes and liquor transfer risk to the recipient; letters, banners, and surveys are the institutionally recognized forms. A returned gift isn't disdain — it's compliance. Separate the two: physician red envelopes run under industry discipline; gifts to case handlers are criminal bribery — Section 8, item 40. Letters and banners are widely accepted, though "entering personal and department records" is practitioner lore, not written rule; the documented piece is survey results in tertiary performance evaluation. Doubting the care itself: seal records (item 6) and keep copies (item 5).
Sources (3 references)

12

Before dental implants: ask what the bundled price includes, prefer institutions pledging price governance, distrust low-price ads

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

After the 2023 price campaign, a routine implant's total cost fell from an average 15,000 to 6,000–7,000 yuan. Tertiary public hospitals cap single-implant service fees at 4,500 yuan in principle, fixtures and crowns separate. Implants, dentures, and orthodontics stay unreimbursed; fillings and extractions are locally covered.

Cost
Free. One check of the institution list on the NHSA's public account plus an in-person price question, a dozen-odd minutes.
Benefit
The NHSA's January 2024 notice: a routine single-implant total comprises three parts. Service fees bundle "consultation, lab and imaging, implant placement, crown placement, and scan-design modeling — excluding extraction, periodontal scaling, root-canal treatment, bone grafting, and soft-tissue grafts," with tertiary public hospitals capped "in principle at 4,500 yuan" (developed regions up to 20% looser per the 2022 campaign notice). Fixtures: January 2023 national procurement, "winning prices 548–1,855 yuan, averaging 900-odd" — Sichuan's lead announcement: premium imports from a 5,000-yuan median to about 1,850, top-volume brands from about 1,500 to about 770. Crowns: "100–656 yuan, averaging 300-odd." The NHSA's H2-2023 briefing: measures landed by early May, "total implant costs falling from an average of 15,000 to about 6,000–7,000 yuan." Coverage: the 1999 documents list "dentures" and "non-functional cosmetic and orthopedic surgery" as non-payable; the NHSA's 2019 reply: "cosmetic dental items (including tooth restoration and correction) are not covered by the fund; therapeutic dental items are not excluded nationally and are locally covered everywhere" (national; as of October 2026)
Note
The 4,500 line governs public hospitals only; private institutions price freely but may not bait with false "subsidies" or "low prices." Advertised lows usually cover the fixture alone — extractions and grafts ride outside the bundle, so demand an itemized sheet before signing. The pledge-participant list publishes on the NHSA's official account. Missing one or two teeth doesn't mandate implants — fixed and removable prostheses remain, unrepriced; ask which suits. Personal-account payment for implants lacks a national answer — ask locally (family sharing: Section 5, item 13). Why missing teeth get replaced: Section 2, item 10. Benefit "medium": the campaign cut prices by policy; the reader's own step saves the out-of-bundle add-ons and premium institutions — thousands per tooth.

25. What to handle after someone dies

10 entries

Metric: money. Only procedures and collections — the first moves at death, which fees carry checkable lists, which accounts release money, and where close relatives hold standing. The first five entries follow chronology: the scene, the death certificate, the body and cremation, disputing the cause, deregistration. The rest rank by value. The living arrangements — agreed guardianship, wills, accounts — sit in Section 17; work-death's three benefits in Section 19. The funeral part follows the new Funeral Regulations, effective 2026-03-30. Pension funeral grants and survivor pensions are separately regulated by the HR ministry; verbatim originals weren't obtained, so no amounts appear.

1

A death at home or away: first separate natural from non-natural — accident, unknown cause, or found-after-days means police now, scene and body untouched

Grade AValue: highMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Accidental deaths, unknown causes, and solo-living discoveries get death certificates only from the police. A disturbed scene muddles everything and the certificate besides — and without that paper, cremation, deregistration, and insurance claims all stall. Unsure which kind? Call 110 first; the police issue after investigating.

Cost
Free. One phone call.
Benefit
Household Registration Regulations, Article 8(2): "where a citizen dies by accident or of unknown cause, the household head or discoverer shall immediately report to the local police station or township people's committee." The Funeral Regulations, Article 23: "for natural deaths, medical institutions shall promptly issue the death certificate; for non-natural death cases handled by public security without medical treatment, the public security organs issue the death certificate." Natural illness deaths: the treating institution certifies. Untreated, police-handled: the police certify. Non-natural death certificates come only from the police — disturbed scenes both obscure and block. Everything after hangs on that one sheet
Note
Long-bedridden home deaths count as natural — the treating institution, the neighborhood community health center, or the township clinic can certify; whoever treated issues (item 2). Unsure which kind: treat as non-natural, call 110; the police certify after investigating. Tidying before calling leaves nobody able to help. Move nothing — not the body, no washing or changing clothes, no clearing bottles or notes.
Sources (2 references)
全国人大常委会 (1958). 中华人民共和国户口登记条例（第八条）. http://www.gd.gov.cn/zwgk/wjk/zcfgk/content/mpost_2531969.html（广东省人民政府门户网站刊登）；国务院 (2026). 殡葬管理条例（国务院令第 824 号，自 2026 年 3 月 30 日起施行，第二十三条）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169…
2

The death certificate keys everything after: whoever treated issues; home natural deaths go to community health services, issued within a day

Grade AValue: highMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Died in hospital — the treating hospital issues. Died naturally at home — the neighborhood community health institution or township clinic. Clear cause: signed within a day. Deregistration, cremation, housing fund withdrawal, benefits, claims, and inheritance all need it. Copy it several times on receipt.

Cost
Free.
Benefit
The death-registration rules: in-facility deaths are certified "by the treating institution"; natural deaths at home or elsewhere "by the district community health institution or township (subdistrict) clinic." Police- or justice-determined non-natural deaths follow existing police and judicial procedures. The 2026 five-department notice: paper and electronic death certificates "carry equal legal force." Natural deaths with clear cause are issued within one day of death. Lost originals may be reissued once; erroneous information may be re-issued once on documentation
Note
Deregistration, cremation, housing fund, benefits, claims, inheritance — each needs it. Copy repeatedly on receipt; request the electronic certificate too. Reissue comes once — guard the original. Name and ID errors get fixed on the spot; discovered at inheritance time, every window reruns.
Sources (2 references)
国家卫生计生委办公厅 (2014). 人口死亡信息登记管理规范（试行）（国卫办规划发〔2014〕68 号，第九条）. https://mzj.sz.gov.cn/szmz/pc/zwgk/jcxxgk/zcfg/byfw/content…（深圳市民政局转发）；国家卫生健康委、公安部、民政部、国家中医药局、国家疾控局 (2026). 关于加强居民死亡医学证明信息登记和电子证照管理工作的通知（国卫规划发〔2026〕5 号）. https://wjw.fujian.gov.cn/xxgk/fgwj/gjwj/202602/t20260228_7…（福建省卫生健康委员会转发）
3

Body transport, storage, and cremation run only through funeral homes; hospital morgues host no funerals; storage generally caps at 3 days

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Transport, storage, preservation, cosmetology, and cremation belong to funeral homes alone. Hospital morgues park bodies temporarily, nothing more. Storage generally runs 3 days — longer needs extension paperwork. Cremation takes the death certificate and the cremation confirmation; the cremation certificate issued after feeds inheritance and claims.

Cost
Free.
Benefit
Article 25: "body transport, storage, preservation, cosmetology, and cremation services are exclusively provided by funeral homes." Article 24: "hospital morgues may not outsource or conduct funeral services, and may provide convenience parking for bodies." Article 27: "funeral homes generally store bodies no more than 3 days; extensions are handled at the funeral home by the family or transferring party." Article 28: "funeral homes cremate on the death certificate and cremation confirmation, issuing a cremation certificate." Article 29: "in cremation regions, bodies are cremated locally and nearby at funeral homes"
Note
The "one-stop" services swarming hospital deaths are mostly not funeral-home staff. Transport sits on the basic list with set pricing (item 6). Keep the cremation certificate — inheritance, insurance, and ash relocation all need it. Cremation versus burial regions are provincially drawn; minority customs carry Article 9 protection. Cremation-region burial or graves outside cemeteries draw correction orders from civil affairs.
Sources (1 references)
国务院 (2026). 殡葬管理条例（国务院令第 824 号，自 2026 年 3 月 30 日起施行，第八、九、二十四、二十五、二十七、二十八、二十九条）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169…
4

Doubting the cause of death: autopsy within 48 hours, records sealed alongside

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Questioning the cause means proposing autopsy within 48 hours of death — 7 days where the hospital freezes bodies. Autopsy needs close relatives' signed consent; refusal or delay shifts the unclear-cause responsibility onto the refusing or delaying side. Demand record sealing alongside. Cremation ends autopsy forever.

Cost
Free. The hard part: remembering to raise it then.
Benefit
The time limits sit in Article 26 of the medical-dispute regulations: "where the patient dies and the parties dispute the cause, autopsy shall proceed within 48 hours of death; with body-freezing conditions, up to 7 days." The same article: "autopsy requires the close relatives' consent and signature; refusal of signature deems the close relatives unwilling," and "the party refusing or delaying past the deadline, affecting cause determination, bears responsibility." Article 24: sealing and unsealing "proceed with both parties present"
Note
"It always felt wrong" past the deadline flips responsibility onto the delaying side. Cremated bodies never autopsy — settle this before contacting the funeral home. Record sealing: Section 24.
Sources (1 references)
国务院 (2018). 医疗纠纷预防和处理条例（国务院令第 701 号，第二十四、二十六条）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/2018-08/31/content_53180…
5

Deregistration carries statutory deadlines: before burial in cities, within one month in rural areas

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: small

Cities: before burial. Rural: within a month. Death certificate and household register to the station. Delay wedges inheritance transfers, benefits, and refunds against the registration status.

Cost
Free. Death certificate and household register in hand, one trip to the police station.
Benefit
Article 8(1): "on a citizen's death, in cities before burial and in rural areas within one month, the household head, relatives, supporter, or neighbor reports the death registration and cancels the household registration; a death at a temporary residence has the temporary-residence authority notify the permanent-residence authority to cancel." Urban burials precede; rural runs a month. Temporary-residence deaths route by notification
Note
An open registration wedges transfers, benefits, and refunds — every window reads registration status. Pensions still flowing are misappropriated, repayable eventually. At the station, ask how insurance benefits stop and funeral grants file: item 9.
Sources (1 references)
全国人大常委会 (1958). 中华人民共和国户口登记条例（第八条）. http://www.gd.gov.cn/zwgk/wjk/zcfgk/content/mpost_2531969.html（广东省人民政府门户网站刊登）
6

Funeral services split basic and non-basic; the basic list carries lawfully set fees

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Transport, storage, farewell, cremation, ash storage, and ecological burial all sit on the national basic list — government institutions' columbarium interment included. Prices follow regulation, not the funeral home's say-so. Nothing gets added beyond the list. Ask which items are basic and the local rates before anything else.

Cost
Free. Minutes reading the list before setting out.
Benefit
Transport, storage, farewell, cremation, ash storage, and ecological burial sit on the national basic list, government funeral institutions' niche interment included. Fees are set per law — not the funeral home's own pricing. Non-basic lists are set by prefecture-level-plus civil affairs
Note
Provinces may extend the national list. Ask which items are basic and the local rates first; list prices are set, outside-list items optional — separating the two gives the overcharges a leg to stand on. Wanting dignity for the departed is no error; this book urges no austerity — where the money goes stays yours.
Sources (1 references)
国务院 (2026). 殡葬管理条例（国务院令第 824 号，2025 年 11 月 14 日国务院第 72 次常务会议修订通过，「自2026年3月30日起施行」）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169… 第五条：「殡葬服务分为基础项目和非基础项目，收费政策由国务院发展改革部门、财政部门会同国务院民政等部门制定。」「国家制定殡葬服务基础项目清单，将遗体接运、遗体存放、遗体告别、遗体火化、骨灰寄存、生态安葬以及政府举办的殡葬服务机构提供的骨灰格位安葬等纳入清单范围」；第五十条「殡葬服务实行清单化管理并动态调整，禁止在清单之外设立项目、收取费用。」
7

Forced bundling, above-marked pricing, item-splitting fees: record and complain

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

The regulation names these price violations: no posted list, above-list charges, bundled funeral-goods sales, forced third-party services. Splitting one item into several counts as disguised price-raising. Demand the price list, keep receipts and chats; later complaints still work. Prices go to market regulation, funeral services to civil affairs.

Cost
Free. The hard part: insisting at that moment.
Benefit
The regulation lists five violation classes, four reproduced here: unposted prices or above-mark charges; buy-this-or-no-that bundling with unreasonable conditions; forced acceptance of third-party paid services; renamed extra charges as disguised rate-raising. Also banned: "splitting items and expanding scope to disguise fee increases" — splitting one service into several billable pieces or widening the billing scope
Note
Price violations go to market regulation, funeral services to civil affairs. Demand the list, keep receipts and chats — later complaints still work.
Sources (1 references)
国务院 (2026). 殡葬管理条例（国务院令第 824 号，2025 年 11 月 14 日国务院第 72 次常务会议修订通过，「自2026年3月30日起施行」）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169… 第四十二条：「殡葬服务机构不得违反有关规定擅自设立收费项目，或者采取分解项目、扩大范围收费等形式变相提高收费标准。」第四十三条列举的价格违法行为含「（一）不按规定明码标价，或者在标价之外加价或者收取未标明的费用」「（三）采取捆绑、附加不合理条件或者不合理限制等方式，强制或者变相强制销售丧葬用品、提供殡葬相关服务并收取费用」「（四）强制或者变相强制丧属接受第三方的有偿服务，或者利用相关服务网点重复收取费用」；第五十一条要求民政部门与政务服务便民热线建立信息共享监督机制，「对丧属反映的殡葬服务问题，应当会同有关部门及时予以处理并将处理结果告知丧属」
8

Funeral agents, goods brokers, ceremony planners: county civil-affairs filing required

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Agency, goods procurement, planning-and-hosting, and information-consulting intermediaries must file with county civil affairs. Unfiled outfits sit outside the funeral-service information system. Verification varies locally — calling the county office is safest. Deceptive charging and trading in the deceased's information get lawfully disposed of.

Cost
Free. One question: filed or not.
Benefit
Unfiled intermediaries sit outside the civil-affairs funeral-service system; deceptive fee collection, induced extravagance, forced services, and trading the deceased's information draw lawful disposal, system annotation, and public disclosure — visible to all
Note
"Trading the deceased's information" is the trade's commonest trap — telemarketing swarms right after procedures mean the data moved. Online memorial platforms fall under the same regime: Article 45 bars induced spending and unlawful handling of the deceased's information.
Sources (1 references)
国务院 (2026). 殡葬管理条例（国务院令第 824 号，2025 年 11 月 14 日国务院第 72 次常务会议修订通过，「自2026年3月30日起施行」）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169… 第四十一条：「除殡葬服务机构外，从事殡葬服务代理、用品代购、策划主持、信息咨询等殡葬相关服务活动的组织和个人，应当向县级人民政府民政部门备案。」「对存在以欺骗等手段违规收费、诱导大操大办、强迫接受服务、倒卖逝者信息等损害丧属权益行为的依法处置，并在殡葬服务信息系统中进行标注，向社会公开。」
9

Scattered money gets collected one window at a time: housing fund balance, social-insurance benefits, work-injury benefits

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

The housing fund balance is inheritable and withdrawable — outside bank accounts, the easiest to forget. Pension personal-account balances inherit too. Illness deaths add funeral grants and 3–24 months' survivor pension; work deaths add the three work-injury sums.

Cost
Free, several windows. Death certificate and kinship proof in hand.
Benefit
Housing fund balances: heirs and legatees may withdraw; legatees being those named in wills. Work deaths add the three sums (Section 19). Pension personal-account balances inherit by statute. Employee-insurance illness deaths add funeral grants and survivor pensions — the survivor benefits — under a nationally uniform enterprise formula: funeral grant at 2× the province's prior-year urban monthly per-capita disposable income; survivor pension on that base by contribution years — under 5 years, 3 months; 5–10, 6; 10–15, 9; past 15, one month per year, capped at 24; retirees drop one month per year drawn, floored at 9
Note
The housing fund gets forgotten most — outside bank accounts, never auto-entering the estate. Pension balances and survivor benefits compute and pay separately; handle both at the enrollment window. Documents vary locally. Under 5 years' contributions, combined survivor benefits cap at the deceased's own contributions. The formula covers enterprise employees — public institutions and resident insurance ask at the window. Wills and inheritance forms: Section 17.

10

The deceased's accounts and personal information: close relatives may demand viewing, copying, correction, and deletion

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

After death, close relatives — for their own lawful, legitimate interests — may demand platforms view, copy, correct, or delete the deceased's personal information. Refusals require stated reasons; courts hear the suits. One exception: the deceased's own arrangements — account inheritors or explicit wishes — govern instead.

Cost
Free. Uncooperative platforms mean complaints or suit.
Benefit
The law states it: on a natural person's death, close relatives may, for their own lawful and legitimate interests, exercise the chapter's viewing, copying, correction, and deletion rights over the deceased's personal information
Note
The clause "save where the deceased arranged otherwise" — account inheritors and explicit wishes govern. So while lucid, writing down where accounts and passwords go is worth it (Section 17). Account cancellation and information deletion are two things (Section 14).
Sources (1 references)
全国人大常委会 (2021). 个人信息保护法. 中国人大网. http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202108/t20210820_313088… 第四十九条：「自然人死亡的，其近亲属为了自身的合法、正当利益，可以对死者的相关个人信息行使本章规定的查阅、复制、更正、删除等权利；死者生前另有安排的除外。」；第五十条「个人信息处理者应当建立便捷的个人行使权利的申请受理和处理机制。拒绝个人行使权利的请求的，应当说明理由」「个人可以依法向人民法院提起诉讼」

26. Building a website or platform: licenses, filing, and servers

11 entries

You want to build a site or app. This section answers four things: which business it is legally, which license it needs, where the servers sit, and who answers for user content and money. Metrics: personal freedom and money. Ordering: prison-risk first, license-first second, daily platform duties next, and last the server-choice judgment, which offers judgment but no numbers. Employed as a technical worker: Section 11's red lines. Company registration and taxes: Section 12. The license comparison table and server decision table: [docs/做平台要办哪些证.md](../docs/做平台要办哪些证.md).

1

Never pool buyer money through the platform — route settlements through licensed payment institutions directly

Grade AValue: highMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Buyer money entering your account then forwarding to sellers is payment business — requiring central-bank approval and a genuinely injected 100 million yuan of capital. Unapproved, expect shutdown, confiscation, and fines, with the boss and handlers fined separately; serious cases bring prison. One safe design exists: the money never touches your account.

Cost
Free. Time to integrate a licensed payment institution — a company holding a PBOC payment license — using its split-settlement or escrow features so buyer money settles straight to sellers, never entering platform accounts.
Benefit
Payment business means "transferring monetary funds per electronic payment instructions submitted by payers or payees" — moving money on others' instructions. The business "requires People's Bank of China approval and a payment-business license," with minimum registered capital of 100 million yuan in paid-in currency. "Unapproved establishment of non-bank payment institutions or engagement, direct or disguised, in payment business is banned by the PBOC, with illegal gains confiscated." Unapproved operation: shutdown and confiscation; gains of 500,000-plus add 1–5× fines; none or under 500,000, 500,000–2 million; legal representatives and responsible persons fined another 100,000–500,000. Criminal law counts "illegally conducting funds payment and settlement" as illegal business — serious, up to 5 years; especially serious, 5-plus. The two-supreme threshold: 5-million-plus business volume or 100,000-plus gains (national; since May 2024)
Note
Designing money never to enter your account is the only safe route. The market calls this collection-and-disbursement "second settlement" (二清), a term absent from official documents; the implementation rules say "disguised engagement in payment business." The two-supreme interpretation lists only three scenarios — fabricated cash-outs, corporate-account cash-outs, check cash-outs — without naming platform collection, so platform collection "necessarily constitutes crime" cannot be claimed.
Sources (4 references)
国务院 (2023). 非银行支付机构监督管理条例（国务院令第 768 号，第二、六、八、二十七、四十七条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11086/202401/content_… ; 中国人民银行 (2024). 非银行支付机构监督管理条例实施细则（中国人民银行令〔2024〕第 4 号，第六十八条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11546/202408/content_… ; 全国人大 (1997). 刑法（第二百二十五条第三项）. https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml ; 最高人民法院、最高人民检察院 (2019). 关于办理非法从事资金支付结算业务、非法买卖外汇刑事案件适用法律若干问题的解释（第一、三、四条）. https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/201901/t20190131_407161.…
2

Charging websites mostly need a license; self-run sales without third-party merchants don't; matchmaking needs another class; free sites only file

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: highTime: highWillpower: noneBenefit: large

User-charging sites mostly need the value-added telecom license, unavailable to individuals. Selling your own goods on your own site without third-party merchants needs none; mini-programs and marketplace shops need none. Operating unlicensed: confiscation plus fines, serious cases closure.

Cost
Filing is free; the value-added telecom license costs — it governs "whether a user-charging site may open." A company is prerequisite: 1 million yuan registered capital in-province, 10 million cross-province; 60-day review, 5-year validity.
Benefit
The regulation: "the state implements a licensing system for commercial internet information services and a filing system for non-commercial services; without license or filing, no internet information service." Charging means licensing, free means filing. "Commercial" means "providing information or webpage-production services to users for payment through the internet." The matchmaking class is online data processing and transaction processing — EDI in the trade — defined as "providing users online data processing and transaction/affair processing via data and transaction platforms connected to public networks," including "transaction processing, electronic data interchange, and network/electronic-device data processing." Unlicensed or out-of-scope operation: confiscation plus 3–5× gains; under 50,000 or none, 100,000–1 million; serious, closure (national). Charging doesn't always mean licensing: Guangdong's communications authority (October 2025, per MIIT) lists three exemptions — enterprises "directly selling their own or other enterprises' goods or services in self-operated fashion" on their own sites without third-party storefronts; enterprises publishing only their own information; and enterprises operating solely on WeChat/Alipay mini-programs, official accounts, video channels, or marketplace shops "with no other independently operated platform." Admitting merchants or user publishing exits all three
Note
Whether yours is EDI — match the Telecommunications Business Classification Catalog's definitions yourself; no official sentence says "marketplaces with matchmaking and funds processing must hold EDI." The MIIT guide says only "apply for the corresponding telecom license per the business definition." Individuals can't hold the license — only companies. The three self-run exemptions come from Guangdong's Q&A citing MIIT requirements; no other province publishes the same text. Unsure: call your local communications authority. The same Q&A notes no agent needed — file on MIIT's telecom market management system, free of charge.
Sources (5 references)
广东省通信管理局 (2025). 关于办理增值电信业务经营许可证的常见问题解答（2025 年 10 月 17 日，第一项）. https://gdca.miit.gov.cn/bsfw/bszn/jyxk/tzgg/art/2025/art_6… ; 国务院 (2000). 互联网信息服务管理办法（国务院令第 292 号，2024 年 12 月 6 日第二次修订，第三、四、七、十九条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1860864.htm ; 国务院 (2024). 关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定（国务院令第 797 号，第十八项）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2025/issue_11786/202501/content_… ; 国务院 (2000). 电信条例（2016 年第二次修订，第七、九、十三、六十九条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2016/content_5139478.htm ; 工业和信息化部 (2017). 电信业务经营许可管理办法（工信部令第 42 号，第六、九、十一、十四条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5240090.htm
3

Livestreaming needs the network-culture license; the audiovisual-program license is effectively beyond private companies

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: highTime: highWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Livestreaming and game commentary need the provincial network-culture license with network performance in scope; 20-day decisions, 3-year terms; broadcast videos self-kept 60 days minimum. Unlicensed opening draws suspension, warning, and up to 30,000 yuan; persisting enters the blacklist.

Cost
The network-culture license governs "whether you may monetize livestreaming and game commentary" — provincial culture authority approval, decided within 20 days of acceptance, 3-year validity, renewal 30 days before expiry. The audiovisual-program license governs "whether you may publish programs online" and requires state-sole or state-controlled applicants.
Benefit
Network-performance units must first license: "apply to the provincial culture administration for the Network Culture Business License, with network performance expressly in scope." Game-playing commentary runs "managed by reference to these measures." All network-performance video materials "shall be preserved no less than 60 days." Unlicensed commercial internet-culture activity: suspension, warning, plus up to 30,000 yuan; continued defiance enters the culture-market blacklist. Publishing programs online is another license — the Audiovisual Program Transmission License — applicants "with legal-person status, state-sole or state-controlled," effectively beyond private companies; unlicensed operation draws warnings, correction orders, up to 30,000 yuan, and serious cases, broadcast-regulation penalties (national)
Note
Which license matches which business — the seven-department document is clearest: monetized livestream platforms need the network-culture license plus ICP filing; program publishing needs the audiovisual license or completed registration; news needs the internet-news license. The gov.cn reprint of the Interim Culture Provisions carries the 2011 unrevised text — cite the current Ministry of Culture and Tourism version.
Sources (4 references)
文化部 (2016). 网络表演经营活动管理办法（文市发〔2016〕33 号，第二、四、六、十三、二十条）. https://zwgk.mct.gov.cn/zfxxgkml/scgl/202012/t20201206_9181… ; 文化部 (2011). 互联网文化管理暂行规定（文化部令第 51 号，2017 年经文化部令第 57 号修订，第七、八、九、十六、二十一、二十八条）. https://zwgk.mct.gov.cn/zfxxgkml/zcfg/bmgz/202012/t20201204… ; 广电总局、信息产业部 (2007). 互联网视听节目服务管理规定（第 56 号令，2015 年修订，第二、七、八、二十四条）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2022-08/23/content_5722664.htm ; 国家网信办等七部门 (2021). 关于加强网络直播规范管理工作的指导意见（国信办发文〔2021〕3 号，第 9 项）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-02/10/content_558…
4

Domestic servers mean filing; the access provider must itself hold the value-added telecom license

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Domestic servers file before opening — free, through the provider, days to weeks. Unfiled: correction order plus 10,000 yuan, refusal closing the site; missing homepage filing numbers add 5,000–50,000.

Cost
Filing is free, submitted through the provider alongside the server, days to weeks. One credential check, ten minutes.
Benefit
"Without filing, no non-commercial internet information service within the People's Republic." Free-to-user sites on domestic servers still file. Unfiled: correction plus 10,000 yuan; refusal, closure. Providers are regulated too: they "may not provide internet access services for unfiled organizations or individuals conducting non-commercial services," and collecting providers "may not provide access or fee-collection services to units or individuals without licenses or filings" — no legitimate provider connects unlicensed, unfiled sites. Data-center hosting and cloud hosts constitute the internet data-center business and broadband access the internet access business — both licensed, so the provider itself must hold licenses. Homepage filing-number omission: correction plus 5,000–50,000 yuan (national)
Note
Check credentials before negotiating prices — licenses via MIIT's tsm.miit.gov.cn by company name or number, site filings via beian.miit.gov.cn. An unlicensed "data center" leaves you no one to appeal to on failure day. Offshore hosting skips filing — but users and money domestic keep items 5–10's duties intact, adding data-export costs.
Sources (3 references)
信息产业部 (2005). 非经营性互联网信息服务备案管理办法（信产部令第 33 号，2024 年经工信部令第 68 号修订，第五、十三、十八、二十二条）. https://www.miit.gov.cn/gyhxxhb/jgsj/cyzcyfgs/bmgz/xxtxl/ar… ; 工业和信息化部 (2017). 电信业务经营许可管理办法（工信部令第 42 号，第二十、二十四条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5240090.htm ; 工业和信息化部 (2015). 电信业务分类目录（2015 年版，B11、B14、B21、B25）. https://www.miit.gov.cn/zwgk/zcwj/wjfb/tg/art/2020/art_e984…
5

Letting users sell on your platform means verification, registration, reporting, and 3-year retention

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: highWillpower: someBenefit: large

Merchants on your platform get identity, address, contact, and license verified and registered; re-verified at least every six months. Identities report to market regulation, tax situations quarterly to tax; goods and transaction records keep three years. Misses draw correction, then 20,000–100,000 yuan.

Cost
Free, but backend seller verification and a registration archive, quarterly tax-information reporting, 3-year transaction retention. The hard part: a permanent duty, not a one-time task.
Benefit
The law's requirements: "require operators applying to sell goods or services on the platform to submit true identity, address, contact, and administrative-license information, verify, register, establish registration files, and periodically verify and update" — "at least once every six months" per the departmental rules. You report platform merchants' identity information to market regulation and, "per tax collection laws and regulations, report platform merchants' identity and tax-related information to the tax authorities." Goods, services, and transaction information "preserved no less than three years from transaction completion." Failures: correction; overdue, 20,000–100,000; serious, suspension plus 100,000–500,000. Tax information reports "within the month following quarter-end," with the same penalties for lateness (national)
Note
Merchants handle their own market-entity registration, with statutory exemptions for "self-produced agricultural and sideline products, family handicrafts, licensed-free convenience services, and sporadic small transactions" — "sporadic small" set at 100,000 yuan annual by the network-transactions rules. Two more platform duties: flag registered versus unregistered merchants, and never delete consumer reviews.

6

User content is yours to manage: review systems, report entrances, immediate takedown and reporting on violations

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: lowTime: highWillpower: yesBenefit: large

User-posted trouble lands on the platform. Build the system: registration, posting review, comment review, daily patrol, incident handling. A conspicuous report entrance. On illegal information: immediate transmission stop, records kept, authorities reported. Failures: 50,000–500,000 yuan, graver, more.

Cost
Paid reviewers — the platform's largest permanent expense — plus logged report entrances and every handling. The hard part: someone watching daily; one idle day breeds trouble.
Benefit
Platforms "bear principal responsibility for information-content management," with systems covering "user registration, account management, information-publication review, comment review, page ecology management, real-time patrol, emergency response, and rumor and black-market information handling," and "conspicuous and convenient complaint and report entrances." On discovering illegal information: "immediately take disposal measures per law, preserve records, and report to the competent authorities." The Network Security Law: "on discovering information prohibited by law or regulation from publication or transmission, immediately stop transmission, take elimination measures, prevent diffusion, preserve records, and report to competent authorities." Failures: correction, warning, circular, plus 50,000–500,000; refusal or severity, 500,000–2 million, possible suspension, closure, or license revocation; responsible persons another 50,000–200,000 (national)
Note
Review rules need no invention — Article 15 of the information-services measures lists the nine banned content classes. Livestreaming adds three: "a livestream content-review platform," the capacity to cut any live feed instantly ("immediate blocking"), and 60-day retention of livestream content and logs; performance videos likewise 60 days.

7

Information-publishing or instant-messaging services must demand true identity information

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Posting or chatting on your site means demanding true identity at service opening; refusers get nothing. Store real names backstage, nicknames displayed as users choose, verification by phone number. Skipping real names: correction; refusal, 50,000–500,000 and possible closure.

Cost
A real-name verification channel, per-call priced. Design "backstage real-name, front-stage voluntary": real names stored backstage, nicknames displayed.
Benefit
The law: "network operators providing network access, domain registration, fixed or mobile phone procedures, or information-publishing or instant-messaging services shall, when contracting or confirming service, require users to provide true identity information; without it, no related service." Failures to demand or serving the unidentified: correction; refusal or severity, 50,000–500,000, possible suspension, closure, or revocation, with responsible persons fined another 10,000–100,000. Livestreaming runs "backstage real-name, front-stage voluntary" with "mobile-phone-number-based true-identity authentication"; livestream commerce demands more — "identity-document and unified-social-credit-code authentication," the code being the business-license number (national)
Note
The numbering moved — the 2025 amendment (effective 2026-01-01) shifted real-name from Article 24 to 26 and the penalties from 61 to 64, wording unchanged; update stale citations.

全国人大常委会 (2025). 网络安全法（2025 年修正，2026 年 1 月 1 日施行，第二十六、六十四条；2016 年文本为第二十四、六十一条）. https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-12/29/c_1768735112911946.htm ; 国家互联网信息办公室 (2016). 互联网直播服务管理规定（第十二、十六条）. https://www.cac.gov.cn/2016-11/04/c_1119847629.htm ; 国家网信办等七部门 (2021). 网络直播营销管理办法（试行）（国信办发文〔2021〕5 号，第八条）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-04/23/content_560…
8

No broadcaster accounts under 16; tipping runs age-banded

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Under-16s get no broadcaster accounts; 16-plus get identity verification plus parental or guardian consent. Tipping runs three bands: under 8, none; 8–16, guardian consent; over 16, guardian consent or income proof. Unauthorized tips by minors get court-ordered refunded on guardian demand.

Cost
Free. Two flows added — registration and payment: age gate plus guardian consent confirmation.
Benefit
The law: "livestream providers may not provide broadcaster account registration to minors under sixteen; for those sixteen and above, identity authentication and parental or guardian consent are required." The regulations add a "dynamic true-identity verification mechanism for broadcasters" and require "reasonable limits on per-transaction and per-day cumulative spending by minors at different age stages." Tipping bands: "no tipping services to minors under eight; to minors eight to sixteen, guardian consent; to minors over sixteen, guardian consent or income-document verification." And: guardians' demands for return of unauthorized tips from persons with limited civil capacity get court support — limited capacity being minors not fully self-determining (national)
Note
Refund disputes resolve toward the minor's best interest. The rule has shifted: the 2022 four-department opinion and the 2020 broadcast notice said all minors tip-free; the April 2026 notice re-bands at 8 and 16 without voiding the earlier texts or explaining the transition — so "minors uniformly banned from tipping" is no longer accurate.
Sources (4 references)
