全国人大常委会 (2020). 未成年人保护法（第七十四、七十六条）. https://www.cac.gov.cn/2020-10/22/c_1604928959588622.htm ; 国务院 (2023). 未成年人网络保护条例（国务院令第 766 号，第三十一、四十四条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2023/issue_10806/202311/content_… ; 中央网信办秘书局 (2026). 关于加强网络直播打赏规范管理的通知（第 7 项）. https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-04/13/c_1777815804150225.htm ; 最高人民法院 (2020). 关于依法妥善审理涉新冠肺炎疫情民事案件若干问题的指导意见（二）（法发〔2020〕17 号，第九条）. https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/230181.html
9

Infringement notices: act timely; 15 days of silence after forwarding counter-statements means restoration

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

An infringement notice with preliminary evidence means timely deletion, blocking, or link-cutting, plus forwarding to the merchant. Delay makes you jointly liable for the expanded harm. On the merchant's counter-statement, forward it and wait 15 days; neither complaint nor suit means restoring.

Cost
Free. A fixed pipeline: receive, forward to merchant, receive defense, publicize outcomes — every step logged.
Benefit
Rights-holders "may notify e-commerce platform operators to take necessary measures — deletion, blocking, link-cutting, termination of transactions and services — with notices including preliminary infringement evidence." One-line claims don't qualify. On notice, platforms "shall timely take necessary measures and forward the notice to in-platform operators; failure to act timely bears joint liability for the expanded harm." On counter-statement, "fifteen days after the statement reaches the rights-holder without complaint or suit notice, the platform shall promptly terminate the measures." Knowing or should-have-known infringement unhandled: joint liability with infringers; IP authorities may order correction, with overdue fines of 50,000–500,000, serious 500,000–2 million. Conversely, "malicious false notices causing in-platform operators' losses bear doubled liability" (national)
Note
Not an e-commerce platform — a general site runs the Civil Code's notice-and-takedown, the difference being the wait: the E-Commerce Law fixes 15 days, the Code says only "reasonable period." Publicizing notices, counter-statements, and outcomes is Article 44's express requirement. Platforms organizing piracy themselves or knowingly hosting it find notice-takedown no shield — Section 9, item 24.
Sources (2 references)
全国人大常委会 (2018). 电子商务法（第四十二、四十三、四十四、四十五、八十四条）. https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf8af… ; 全国人大 (2020). 民法典（第一千一百九十五、一千一百九十六、一千一百九十七条）. https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/233181.html
10

User information doesn't casually leave the country — export carries statutory conditions and volume thresholds

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Transmitting domestic users' data to offshore machines is export — offshore servers don't mean no export. Export takes one of four roads: cyberspace-administration security assessment, professional certification, standard-contract filing, or other statutory conditions — plus telling users who receives abroad, for what, and asking their separate consent.

Cost
Free. Cheapest: keep user data domestic. Genuine export: standard contracts or certification.
Benefit
Providing domestic users' information to offshore companies or machines legally "requires" one of: security assessment organized by the cyberspace authority; personal-information protection certification by a professional body; the standard contract with the offshore recipient; or other statutory conditions — with users told the recipient's name, contact, purposes, methods, information types, and rights exercise, and "separate consent" obtained. Thresholds by cumulative count: ordinary enterprises — data processors outside critical-information-infrastructure operators — clear one line: "cumulative provision abroad of under 100,000 persons' personal information (sensitive information excluded) since January 1 of the year" waives assessment, contract, and certification. From 100,000 to under 1 million: standard contract or certification. Over 1 million, or sensitive information over 10,000: security assessment (national; since March 2024)
Note
Offshore servers don't mean no export — domestic users' data on offshore machines is export. One class skips all three roads: cross-border shopping, delivery, and travel bookings, "necessary for concluding or performing contracts to which the individual is a party." Counting runs "cumulative since January 1 of the year," not a trailing twelve months.
Sources (3 references)
全国人大常委会 (2021). 个人信息保护法（第三十八、三十九、四十条）. https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202108/t20210820_527244.shtml ; 国家互联网信息办公室 (2024). 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定（网信办令第 16 号，第三、四、五、七、八条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11366/202405/content_… ; 国家互联网信息办公室 (2022). 数据出境安全评估办法（网信办令第 11 号，第四条）. https://www.cac.gov.cn/2022-07/07/c_1658811536396503.htm
11

Server choice: outage tolerance first, operations staff second, price last

Grade CValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

The three tiers differ not in price but in what you hold on failure day. Big clouds carry filing channels, public credentials, incident notices, compensation clauses, and reachable humans; small providers halve the price but leave you no appeal on overselling, absconding, or upstream termination. Static sites without user data run fine on tens-of-yuan VPSes.

Cost
Mainstream cloud hosts run hundreds to thousands monthly; small-provider VPSes from tens — a VPS being a small virtual server; dedicated colocation from thousands yearly with hardware bought separately.
Benefit
The tiers differ in what you hold on failure day: mainstream clouds offer filing channels, public credentials, incident bulletins, contractual compensation, and reachable people; small providers halve prices but leave no appeal on overselling, absconding, or upstream cutoffs — so check their value-added telecom license in the MIIT system before negotiating. Dedicated colocation pays only when both hold: bandwidth or hardware distinctly cheaper, and your own operations staff. Choosing: static, no-user-data sites take the cheapest VPS; sites with registration and transactions take elastically scalable, snapshot-capable cloud hosts with backups in at least two places
Note
Judgment without literature; the single checkable thing is the provider's license. Save on configuration and bandwidth, never on credentials.
Sources
作者经验，无直接文献；服务商资质与备案的法定要求见本节第 4 条，日志留存 6 个月和等级保护义务见第 11 节第 16 条

27. Pregnancy and childbirth: from finding out to discharge paperwork

17 entries

The first half counts death risk for mother and fetus; the second half counts money and errand time — never converted into each other. Content covers only "what to do when." Prenatal nutrition and fetal education without hard evidence or with tiny effects don't appear. Maternity allowances, leave, and child-rearing accounts: Section 18; newborn care: Section 20; emergencies: Section 13. WHO's figures: in 2023, about 260,000 women died of pregnancy and childbirth worldwide, roughly 75% of them from five causes — postpartum hemorrhage, infection, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (including preeclampsia and eclampsia), delivery complications, and unsafe abortion. WHO also states "most maternal deaths are preventable, since the medical means to prevent and manage complications are known." This section's highest-yield entries intercept exactly these.

1

Planning pregnancy: start 0.4 mg folic acid daily, through the first 3 months

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Daily folic acid before and early in pregnancy cuts neural-tube defects — anencephaly, spina bifida — by about 70%. After one affected child, recurrence falls to roughly a third.

Cost
Tens of yuan a bottle; rural women get it free from the national supplementation program. One daily pill — the hard part is remembering daily.
Benefit
A Cochrane review pooling 5 trials, 6,708 births, high-quality evidence: periconceptional folate runs neural-tube-defect RR 0.31 (95% CI 0.17 to 0.58, the confidence range) — about 70% lower; prior affected pregnancy, RR 0.34 (95% CI 0.18 to 0.64), about a third. By population, 0.4 mg and higher doses don't differ; folate alone equals multivitamins
Note
The key is "starting before pregnancy": the neural tube closes within 28 days of conception — by the time you test positive, most of that window has passed. Planning a child means starting 3 months ahead. The same review found no clear effect on cleft lip and palate, congenital heart disease, or miscarriage — expect nothing else of it. Vegan mothers add daily B12 — Section 20, item 14.
Sources (1 references)
De-Regil LM, Peña-Rosas JP, Fernández-Gaxiola AC, Rayco-Solon P (2015). Effects and safety of periconceptional oral folate supplementation for preventing birth defects. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, (12), CD007950. https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD007950.pub3
2

Before 13 weeks: register the Maternal-Child Health Handbook at the community center and use the free prenatal visits

Grade AValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

At least five prenatal visits plus postpartum home visit and the 42-day check come state-paid — claimed by registering the handbook before 13 weeks. Unregistered, the free visits slip by.

Cost
Free — a national basic public-health service; several visits by gestational week.
Benefit
The national service standards cover resident pregnant women: one first-trimester check, two second-trimester, two third-trimester, one postpartum visit, one 42-day check. Register before 13 weeks with the first prenatal visit; mid-trimester visits at 16–20 and 21–24 weeks; late-trimester at 28–36 and 37–40. Local published lists add the first-visit lab panel and postpartum-depression screening
Note
The five free visits are a floor, not the whole of prenatal care — hospitals add ultrasounds, glucose testing, and fetal monitoring at your cost. Earlier registration means earlier pregnancy-risk grading, which routes high-risk mothers to capable hospitals sooner. Living in another district: register where you live, not where your hukou sits.
Sources (2 references)
国家卫生计生委 (2017). 国家基本公共卫生服务规范（第三版）. https://www.nhc.gov.cn/ewebeditor/uploadfile/2017/04/201704…；靖江市人民政府. 国家基本公共卫生服务项目——孕产妇健康管理服务（地方服务清单公开）. https://www.jingjiang.gov.cn/xxgk/zdlyxxgk/wsjk/art/2023/ar…
3

First prenatal visit: test HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B — positives carry free blocking

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Test all three at the first visit, free. A positive is not a dead end: the state supplies free medication and protocols blocking mother-to-child transmission.

Cost
Free testing under the prevention-of-mother-to-child-transmission program.
Benefit
The 2020 work standards require informing patients at the first visit and "providing appropriate, standardized free testing," with post-test counseling or referral. Positives carry the way out: the AIDS regulations, Article 44, "free prevention-of-mother-to-child-transmission treatment and counseling for HIV-infected pregnant women"; Article 43 requires blocking, treatment, postpartum visits, and infant follow-up and testing. HBsAg-positive mothers' newborns receive both vaccine and immunoglobulin at birth (Section 20, item 2)
Note
Earlier is more useful — blocking and treatment need time. Article 3 bars discrimination and protects marriage, work, care, and schooling rights. General prevention and testing: Section 1; post-exposure blocking: Section 13.
Sources (2 references)
国家卫生健康委办公厅 (2020). 预防艾滋病、梅毒和乙肝母婴传播工作规范（2020 年版）. https://wjw.xinjiang.gov.cn/hfpc/zhgl6/202012/08b7de496f0b4…（新疆维吾尔自治区卫生健康委员会转载）；国务院 (2006). 艾滋病防治条例（第四十三、四十四条）. https://wjw.beijing.gov.cn/zwgk_20040/zcwj2022/flfg/202304/…（北京市卫生健康委员会转载）
4

All pregnancy: not one cigarette, not one drink — and no indoor smoking at home

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: yesBenefit: large

Smoking in pregnancy raises prematurity, small-for-dates birth, and cleft defects; abnormal bleeding risk in pregnancy and delivery doubles; sudden-infant-death risk rises. Household indoor smoking counts equally. Quitting any time still helps.

Cost
Free, saving the tobacco and alcohol money. The hard part: household co-quitting.
Benefit
The CDC: pregnancy smoking means babies "may be born too small even at term" and "may be born preterm"; it "doubles the risk of abnormal bleeding during pregnancy and delivery," raises cleft-lip and palate risks, and "harms the developing lungs and brain, harm that can last into childhood." Infants of smoking mothers and smoke-exposed infants run higher SIDS risk. The official advice: "quitting before pregnancy is best, but quitting during pregnancy still helps" — "it's never too late"
Note
Others' indoor smoke counts for the fetus too — cohabitants smoke outdoors. Alcohol likewise: no known safe amount; the simplest rule is none. Tobacco and alcohol on your own account: Section 2.
Sources (1 references)
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Smoking During Pregnancy. https://www.cdc.gov/tobacco/campaign/tips/diseases/pregnanc…
5

Preeclampsia risk factors: low-dose aspirin daily from 12 weeks

Grade AValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Preeclampsia is pregnancy hypertension. High-risk: prior preeclampsia, multiples, chronic hypertension, pre-pregnancy diabetes, kidney or autoimmune disease. Daily low-dose aspirin from 12 weeks cuts preeclampsia about 15% and preterm birth and perinatal death about 20%. Others don't self-medicate.

Cost
Tens of yuan, one daily tablet to delivery. The hard part: never forgetting.
Benefit
USPSTF grade B: high-risk women start low-dose aspirin (81 mg/day) after 12 weeks. Pooled results (95% CIs the confidence ranges): preeclampsia RR 0.85 (0.75 to 0.95, 16 studies), about 15% lower; preterm birth RR 0.80 (0.67 to 0.95, 13 studies), about 20%; perinatal death RR 0.79 (0.66 to 0.96, 11 studies), about 21% — perinatal meaning death around delivery; small-for-gestational-age/intrauterine growth restriction RR 0.82 (0.68 to 0.99, 16 studies), about 18%
Note
High-risk markers: prior preeclampsia, twins or more, chronic hypertension, pre-pregnancy type 1 or 2 diabetes, kidney disease, and lupus or antiphospholipid syndrome. Outside these classes, don't self-medicate. Prescription required — state the history at prenatal visits and let the doctor judge. Domestic stock runs mostly 100 mg enteric tablets; follow orders.
Sources (1 references)
US Preventive Services Task Force (2021). Aspirin Use to Prevent Preeclampsia and Related Morbidity and Mortality: Preventive Medication. https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recomm…
6

At 24 weeks and after: the gestational-diabetes screen — don't skip the sugar drink

Grade AValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Gestational diabetes is high glucose appearing in pregnancy. Half a morning at 24-plus weeks — one sugar drink, several draws — catches it. Unmanaged, macrosomia, difficult labor, a surgical delivery, preeclampsia, and neonatal hypoglycemia all rise.

Cost
Tens to 100-odd yuan; fasting, several draws, half a morning.
Benefit
USPSTF grade B: screen asymptomatic pregnant women at 24 weeks and after for gestational diabetes; single screens sit at 24-plus weeks. Screening before 24 weeks: evidence insufficient (I). Unmanaged gestational diabetes raises macrosomia, difficult labor, cesarean, preeclampsia, and neonatal hypoglycemia
Note
Most diagnosed women control glucose by diet and exercise; insulin stays the minority. Fear of needles is no reason to skip. Postpartum recheck: gestational diabetes sharply raises later type-2 risk.
Sources (1 references)
US Preventive Services Task Force (2021). Gestational Diabetes: Screening. https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recomm…
7

Memorize the "hospital now" list — it runs through one year postpartum

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Any one means hospital today, never waiting a night. Persistent or worsening headache, vision changes, fever at 38 °C; severe hand or face swelling, breathlessness, chest pain or racing heart; unrelenting severe abdominal pain, stopped or markedly reduced fetal movement, vaginal bleeding or fluid; one arm or leg swollen and painful, thoughts of harming self or child — all count within a year postpartum.

Cost
Free. Five minutes to memorize; teach cohabitants too.
Benefit
The CDC's urgent maternal warning signs: persistent or worsening headache, dizziness or fainting, vision changes, 38 °C-plus fever; severe hand or face swelling, thoughts of self-harm or harming the baby, breathing difficulty, chest pain or racing heart; severe nausea and vomiting, unrelenting severe abdominal pain, stopped or markedly reduced fetal movement; vaginal bleeding or fluid loss in pregnancy, postpartum bleeding or abnormal discharge; one arm or leg severely swollen, red, or painful. These arise up to a year postpartum — "past the confinement month" isn't safe
Note
The list separates "endure" from "go now." Headache plus visual changes plus upper-abdominal pain points to preeclampsia; a swollen painful calf points to deep-vein thrombosis (Section 13). Postpartum hemorrhage, per WHO, can take a healthy woman's life within hours. Any one sign means direct hospital, never a night at home.
Sources (2 references)
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Hear Her — Urgent Maternal Warning Signs. https://www.cdc.gov/hearher/maternal-warning-signs/index.html；World Health Organization. Maternal mortality fact sheet. https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/maternal-m…
8

Water breaks: lie flat where you are, hips raised, call 120 — no walking, no bathing

Grade BValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Ruptured membranes aren't a slow pack-and-go. Lie down at once, raise the hips, call 120. Standing and walking drains amniotic fluid faster and can carry the cord down — cord prolapse, a fetal emergency.

Cost
Free.
Benefit
Beijing's health commission: on rupture, "immediately lie flat somewhere, preventing amniotic-fluid loss," "no casual walking," and "immediately dial 120." Waiting, notify family to meet at the hospital. Institutional explanations add why: standing drains fluid faster and the umbilical cord may prolapse — a fetus-endangering emergency — hence lying with hips raised, left side acceptable
Note
Labor's three signs: regular contractions, bloody show, rupture. The first two allow unhurried packing; rupture alone means lie down and call at once. Bathing, squatting toilets, and self-driving are the classic errors. Record the time and fluid color for the doctor: yellow-green or meconium-flecked fluid signals fetal distress. With regular contractions, markedly reduced movement, or fever with chills, stress the emergency.
Sources (2 references)
北京市卫生健康委员会. 每周急救话题：准妈妈羊水早破怎样办？ https://wjw.beijing.gov.cn/bmfw_20143/jkzs/jzjj/202001/t202…；北京市顺义区妇幼保健院. 孕晚期在家破水怎么办？ https://www.bch-syfy.cn/Html/News/Articles/9453.html
9

Want epidural pain relief? Ask plainly — it doesn't raise cesarean risk

Grade AValue: averageMetric: timeMoney: lowTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

The epidural is one injection in the back dulling labor pain — more effective than the alternatives and no more likely to end in surgery. "A lifetime of back pain" is likewise unsupported. It now carries its own billing item, making hospitals readier.

Cost
Hundreds to 1,000-odd yuan by locality; ask the hospital and anesthesia department beforehand. The hard part: raising it yourself.
Benefit
The Cochrane review: epidural analgesia beats non-epidural methods at pain relief and satisfaction, with "no impact on cesarean risk or long-term back pain." Assisted-delivery increases vanished in post-2005 studies. From 2024, the NHSA's obstetrics pricing guideline itemizes "labor analgesia," "doula delivery," and "family-accompanied delivery" — precisely because the missing standalone item had suppressed hospitals' willingness
Note
The two widest-circulated claims — lifetime back pain and forced surgery — lack support; Cochrane finds no effect on cesarean risk or long-term back pain. Real side effects: low blood pressure, fever, weak legs, urinary retention, longer first and second stages, more oxytocin use. Your call — but don't decline on rumor. Availability depends on round-the-clock anesthesia staff; ask at prenatal visits.
Sources (2 references)
Anim-Somuah M, Smyth RMD, Cyna AM, Cuthbert A (2018). Epidural versus non-epidural or no analgesia for pain management in labour. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, (5), CD000331. https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD000331.pub4；国家医疗保障局 (2024). 重构产科服务价格项目 助力构建生育友好型社会. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202406/content_6957553.htm
10

No medical indication: don't request cesarean, and never book a "lucky date"

Grade AValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

WHO: past 10% cesarean share in a population, maternal and newborn deaths stop falling. Medically needed cesareans save lives; date-picking and pain-fearing ones are major abdominal surgery for nothing.

Cost
Free. The hard part: withstanding family opinion.
Benefit
WHO's 2015 statement: as cesarean rates rise toward about 10%, maternal and neonatal deaths fall; beyond 10%, no evidence of further mortality improvement — while stressing every effort to provide cesarean for women who need it, never to chase a specific rate
Note
When medicine demands it, cesarean is life-saving — take it, never tough it out. What to avoid is surgery without need: pain fear, auspicious timing, school-age arithmetic. Cesarean is major abdominal surgery with slower recovery and higher next-pregnancy risks of placenta previa, placenta accreta, and uterine rupture — directly relevant to wanting a second child.
Sources (1 references)
World Health Organization (2015). WHO Statement on Caesarean Section Rates（WHO/RHR/15.02）. https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/WHO-RHR-15.02
11

Before pregnancy: confirm maternity-insurance enrollment — an unemployed spouse also bills maternity medical costs

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Employer-paid maternity insurance covers delivery medical costs and leave allowances from the fund; an unemployed spouse's medical costs also bill it. Whether months-enrolled suffice and whether out-of-town delivery needs pre-filing — ask ahead, unpatchable afterward.

Cost
Free. One call to social-insurance or medical-insurance lines.
Benefit
Social Insurance Law Article 54: where employers paid maternity insurance, employees enjoy the benefits, and "unemployed spouses enjoy maternity medical-cost benefits per state provisions, funded from the maternity insurance fund." Benefits split into maternity medical costs (the delivery's own bills) and the maternity allowance (the leave payment). Article 56 lists three allowance situations: maternity leave, family-planning-surgery leave, and other statutory cases, computed "on the employer's prior-year average monthly employee wage" — the workplace average, not your own
Note
Two things to ask in advance, unpatchable after: whether continuous-enrollment months meet the local minimum, and whether non-local delivery needs cross-region filing — unfilled, you front the costs and may never reclaim. Leave days and allowance math: Section 18, item 2.
Sources (1 references)
全国人大常委会 (2010). 中华人民共和国社会保险法（第五十四、五十六条）. https://guangdong.chinatax.gov.cn/gdsw/qysw_gkwj/2020-02/12…（国家税务总局广东省税务局转载）
12

Before discharge: file the birth medical certificate — settle the name and check every character

Grade AValue: highMetric: timeMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

The certificate precedes hukou registration, enrollment, and schooling, and only the delivering institution issues the first copy. Post-discharge replacement runs another procedure with extra materials. Confirm the characters exist in the household system.

Cost
Free, handled alongside discharge paperwork.
Benefit
Maternal-Infant Health Care Law Article 23: medical institutions and home-birth attendants issue the uniform birth medical certificate. It precedes everything: hukou, insurance enrollment, cards, kindergarten, school. First issuance belongs to the delivering institution alone; later replacement is another process with added proofs
Note
Verify parents' names, ID numbers, and the child's name character by character; rare characters breed lifelong friction. Name and certificate changes run reissue, far clumsier than on-the-spot checks. Store it like the household register and IDs.
Sources (1 references)
全国人大常委会 (1994, 2017 修正). 中华人民共和国母婴保健法（第二十三条）. https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647619.htm
13

Never refuse the newborn heel-prick and hearing screens

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

One heel-prick and one hearing test catch hypothyroidism, PKU, and hearing loss while the baby looks perfectly normal. By symptoms, the intellectual damage is already permanent.

Cost
Free in most regions or tens of yuan; some extended panels self-paid. One heel prick after birth.
Benefit
The screening rules, Article 3: "national newborn screening covers congenital hypothyroidism, phenylketonuria, and other inherited metabolic diseases, and hearing impairment." Both classes share one feature: invisible early, irreversible intellectual damage by symptom-time — while early detection and intervention work well: thyroid hormone, special formula, hearing aids or cochlear implants. Article 10: positive results trigger guardian notification for confirmation
Note
Article 11 requires truthful pre-screening disclosure — items, conditions, methods, sensitivity, costs — with signed consent: read which panels are statutory and which are paid add-ons. A positive screen isn't diagnosis — most clear on retest; don't collapse at this step. Failed hearing screens attend the scheduled retest; never self-judge "the child hears fine."
Sources (1 references)
卫生部 (2009). 新生儿疾病筛查管理办法（卫生部令第 64 号，第三、十、十一条）. http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2009/content_1371363.htm
14

Birth certificate in hand: enroll the child in resident insurance without waiting for hukou

Grade AValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: lowTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

The certificate alone supports online enrollment — no hukou needed. Enrolled, discharge-day hospitalization bills settle on the spot; newborn stays run expensive, and enrolled versus not differs enormously.

Cost
One yearly resident premium, a few hundred yuan.
Benefit
The government's 2024 briefing: "newborns may enroll online with the birth medical certificate alone," no prior hukou, and "reimburse medical costs directly at discharge" — replacing the old front-then-reclaim routine. Average enrollment processing fell from 28.7 working days early in the year to 6.4
Note
Prematurity, phototherapy jaundice, and neonatal pneumonia commonly hospitalize newborns at four-figure costs — enrollment matters. "How many days post-birth enrollment covers from day one" varies locally; the local insurance office governs. One call to 12393 before discharge is cheapest.
Sources (1 references)
中国政府网 (2024). 健全基本医疗保险参保长效机制国务院政策例行吹风会. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202409/content_6973567.htm
15

Within one month of birth: register the birth at the police station

Grade AValue: averageMetric: freedomMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: small

The law allows one month, not "whenever." Registration gates vaccination, kindergarten, school, and ID cards; delay multiplies the backfill.

Cost
Free. One trip to the household window.
Benefit
Article 7: "within one month of birth, the household head, relatives, supporter, or neighbor reports the birth registration at the infant's habitual-residence authority" — statutory, not advisory. Registration precedes vaccination, enrollment, schooling, and IDs; delay multiplies required materials
Note
Bring: the birth certificate, both parents' IDs and household registers, and the marriage certificate. Registering under father or mother is your choice, with differing local policy touching school districts and insurance enrollment — decide before going; changes are clumsy. Children born unmarried register equally.
Sources (1 references)
国务院 (1958). 中华人民共和国户口登记条例（第七条）. http://www.gd.gov.cn/zwgk/wjk/zcfgk/content/post_2531969.html（广东省人民政府转载）
16

Don't skip the 42-day postpartum check — it doubles as the depression screen

Grade AValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

The check is free, covering blood work, discharge testing, and a postpartum-depression screen. Serious complications run a full year postpartum — the confinement month's passing is not safety.

Cost
Free under basic public health; half a day. The hard part: moving fresh out of confinement.
Benefit
The national standards schedule one postpartum visit and one 42-day check; local lists include labs (blood and discharge) and a postpartum-depression screening. Severe complications arise up to a year out; item 7's "hospital now" list — "thoughts of harming self or child," "postpartum bleeding or abnormal discharge," "one limb severely swollen and painful" — all count postpartum
Note
Postpartum depression isn't fragility, and "look on the bright side" fixes nothing — it has screening instruments, treatment, and recovery. Suicidal thoughts: Section 1. A truly unraisable child's lawful exit: Section 9, item 20. The check also reviews wound healing, uterine recovery, and pelvic-floor function, and settles contraception: no period doesn't mean no pregnancy.
Sources (2 references)
国家卫生计生委 (2017). 国家基本公共卫生服务规范（第三版）. https://www.nhc.gov.cn/ewebeditor/uploadfile/2017/04/201704…；靖江市人民政府. 国家基本公共卫生服务项目——孕产妇健康管理服务（地方服务清单公开）. https://www.jingjiang.gov.cn/xxgk/zdlyxxgk/wsjk/art/2023/ar…
17

Pregnant: no need to rehome the cat — hand litter duty to someone else daily; cook meat through; glove for soil

Grade BValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Toxoplasma is a parasite; first infection in pregnancy can miscarry or blind and brain-damage the child. Cat ownership doesn't raise infection — the cat stays. Undercooked meat and ungloved soil are the threats; daily litter duty passes to someone else.

Cost
Free. Litter to a household member daily; solo means disposable gloves. The hard part: no more medium-rare steak or lamb.
Benefit
The CDC: infection shortly before or during pregnancy transmits to the fetus — most infected children asymptomatic at birth, later risking blindness or intellectual disability; a few with severe eye or brain damage at birth. The NHS: pregnancy infection can cause miscarriage. A Lyon reference center tracked 603 infected pregnancies, mostly treated: overall fetal transmission 29% (95% CI 25 to 33); infection at 13 weeks, about 6% transmitted; at 36 weeks, about 72% — earlier infection, likelier symptomatic children, with 24–30 weeks' infection running about 10% early symptoms. Six European cities compared newly infected and uninfected pregnancies: household cat OR 1.0 (95% CI 0.7 to 1.5) — no difference; cleaning one's own litter OR 1.3 (0.8 to 2.1) — possibly chance; undercooked lamb OR 3.13 (1.4 to 7.2) — three times; soil contact OR 1.81 (1.2 to 2.7) — up about 80%. Across cities, 30%–63% of infections attributed to undercooked or cured meats, 6%–17% to soil. The CDC's pregnancy advice: let someone else change litter; alone, wear disposable gloves and wash with soap and water; change litter daily — oocysts need 1–5 days to become infectious; no new cats, no strays especially kittens; keep cats indoors on cooked or commercial food, never raw meat. China's CDC concurs — fathers-to-be should shoulder litter duty; with precautions the cat stays. The NHS: touching or keeping cats doesn't transmit
Note
Cats shed mostly for weeks after first infection; previously infected adults rarely re-shed, and indoor cooked-food cats rarely infect. Catless households still catch it — undercooked meat, unwashed produce, cat-fouled soil, untreated water. So: meat fully cooked, knives-boards-hands washed; produce rinsed under running water; gloves for gardening with handwashing after. The NHS adds: no salami or Parma ham, no unpasteurized goat milk. The European study didn't detail salads and unwashed vegetables, and 14%–49% of infections found no source. Whether to test antibodies: ask the prenatal doctor. Grade B because cat-and-meat risks rest on one recall-based study; the practices are official guidance without measured infection reductions. Benefit "medium" by judgment, reasoning in the verification record. The gain lands on you and the child.
Sources (6 references)
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Toxoplasmosis: Risk Factors. https://www.cdc.gov/toxoplasmosis/risk-factors/index.html；Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Preventing Toxoplasmosis. https://www.cdc.gov/toxoplasmosis/prevention/index.html；NHS. Toxoplasmosis. https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/toxoplasmosis/；中国疾病预防控制中心 (2025). 孕期弓形虫感染，都是「吸猫」惹的祸吗？ https://www.chinacdc.cn/jkkp/crb/qtcr/202501/t20250103_3036…；Cook AJ, Gilbert RE, Buffolano W, et al. (2000). Sources of toxoplasma infection in pregnant women: European multicentre case-control study. BMJ, 321(7254), 142-147. https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.321.7254.142；Dunn D, Wallon M, Peyron F, Petersen E, Peckham C, Gilbert R (1999). Mother-to-child transmission of toxoplasmosis: risk estimates for clinical counselling. Lancet, 353(9167), 1829-1833. https://doi.org/10.1016/s0140-6736(98)08220-8

28. Don't wreck your body for looks

9 entries

This section covers ways of "doing things to the body to change appearance": starving, pills, injections, surgery. These decisions are usually made by comparison with others, while the costs land entirely on you — and a good share never reverse. This section judges nobody's chosen appearance — that's each person's own. The same goal can be pursued through "prescribed, credentialed, followed-up" channels or through "online shopping, beauty salons, self-dosing" — this section only prices the difference. The accounting counts what actually happens to bodies: blindness, hospitalization, death. The two medical-aesthetics entries add criminal liability for illegal practice.

1

Never control weight by extreme dieting, fasting, or purging — cut from the exercise side

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Anorexia nervosa runs death about 5.9 times the age-matched rate — 5.1 deaths per 1,000 person-years, with one in five of the dead by suicide. Its doorway is dieting: tracking students across 44 secondary schools for three years, severely dieting girls developed eating disorders at 18 times the rate of non-dieters. Control weight by moving more, never by starving.

Cost
Free, and it saves the diet-product money.
Benefit
Pooling 36 studies: anorexia nervosa accumulated 166,642 person-years, standardized mortality ratio 5.86 — about 5.9× the age-matched rate; 5.1 deaths per 1,000 person-years; about 1 in 5 of deaths by suicide. Bulimia ran SMR 1.93 and other eating disorders 1.92 — about 1.9×. The Victorian study followed 14–15-year-olds across 44 schools for 3 years, six waves: girls' new eating disorders ran 21.8 per 1,000 person-years; severe dieters developed them at 18× non-dieters, moderate dieters 5×. Adjusting for prior dieting and psychiatric symptoms, BMI, exercise, and sex no longer predicted onset. The authors: "in adolescents, controlling weight through exercise rather than food restriction appears to carry a lower risk of eating disorder onset"
Note
"Severe dieting" here means chronically compressing intake far below need — not skipping a meal or late-night snacks. Purging, post-binge guilt, and compulsive weighing belong in psychiatry or clinical psychology. This is a treatable illness, not a willpower matter. BMI-versus-mortality sits in Section 2, item 32 — that entry covers long-term weight bands, not weight-loss methods.
Sources (2 references)
Arcelus J et al. (2011). Mortality rates in patients with anorexia nervosa and other eating disorders. A meta-analysis of 36 studies. Arch Gen Psychiatry. https://doi.org/10.1001/archgenpsychiatry.2011.74；Patton GC et al. (1999). Onset of adolescent eating disorders: population based cohort study over 3 years. BMJ. https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.318.7186.765
2

Before any injection, thread, or scalpel: check two things — the license says "medical cosmetology," and the hands belong to an attending physician

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Anything piercing skin or entering the body counts as medical care — done only in institutions licensed for "medical cosmetology" by registered physicians. Beauty salons, studios, and hotel rooms mean illegal practice: serious cases draw up to 3 years; injury, 3–10; death, 10-plus.

Cost
Free, minutes to check both. The Medical Institution Practice License hangs in the lobby; physician credentials verify in the health authorities' registry.
Benefit
The Medical Cosmetology Service Measures define it: "repair and reshaping of human appearance and body form using surgical, pharmaceutical, medical-device, and other traumatic or invasive medical techniques." Breaking skin, entering with needles, or entering the body counts as care. Articles 8 and 24 require the Practice License with the medical-cosmetology service category registered; licenses without that entry can't perform. Article 11 requires attending physicians (the hands doing the work) to hold registered physician qualifications — cosmetic surgery requiring 6-plus years of relevant clinical experience, cosmetic dentistry 5-plus, cosmetic TCM and dermatology 3-plus each. Article 20 requires written disclosure of indications, contraindications, risks, and precautions with signed consent. Criminal Law Article 336 governs illegal practice — practicing medicine without physician qualification: serious, up to 3 years plus fines; grave bodily harm, 3–10 plus fines; death, 10-plus plus fines
Note
Article 16 confines cosmetology projects to cosmetology institutions or hospitals and clinics with cosmetology departments — door-to-door injections and studio procedures are non-compliant by location alone. Article 20 requires guardian consent for minors. Facials, massage, and nail care are life cosmetology outside this regime — but anything reaching needles or blades is medical.
Sources (2 references)
卫生部 (2002). 医疗美容服务管理办法（卫生部令第 19 号，第二条、第八条、第十一条、第十六条、第二十条、第二十四条）. http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2003/content_62198.htm；全国人大 (1997). 刑法（第三百三十六条）. https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml
3

Facial filler: avoid the nasal bridge, glabella, and forehead — and never economize into unlicensed injections

Grade BValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

Among filler-induced blindness cases, over half involved the nose, then glabella, forehead, and nasolabial folds — over 80% hyaluronic acid. Of the blinded, two in ten fully recovered, one-sixth partially, and nearly one in five suffered brain injury. No rescue reliably works — avoidance is the only strategy.

Cost
Free. A different injection site, or none.
Benefit
Pooling world-literature cases: January 2015–September 2018 added 48 cases of partial or complete vision loss after filler injection. Leading sites: nose 56.3%; glabella 27.1%; forehead 18.8%; nasolabial folds 14.6%. 81.3% involved hyaluronic acid. 43.8% showed skin changes; 18.8% central-nervous-system complications. 10 cases (20.8%) fully recovered vision, 8 (16.7%) partially, the rest not. The authors: management varied widely, with no treatment proven consistently effective
Note
These numbers count published cases — numerators without denominators, so "the odds of blindness per injection" is uncomputable; only which sites fail and that rescue mostly fails. Grade B for that reason. Legitimate practice reduces risk by routine: mapping vessels, blunt cannulas over sharp needles, retrograde low-volume injection, hyaluronidase on standby — every step requiring a trained physician, itself a reason to shun informal channels. Verify per item 2 beforehand.
Sources (1 references)
Beleznay K et al. (2019). Update on Avoiding and Treating Blindness From Fillers: A Recent Review of the World Literature. Aesthet Surg J. https://doi.org/10.1093/asj/sjz053
4

Never buy diet pills, slimming coffee, weight-loss candy, or "enzyme plums" promising fast loss

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

The commonest undeclared additive is sibutramine, a withdrawn diet drug. In overweight people with heart disease or diabetes taking it over three years, nonfatal heart attacks rose about 30% and strokes about 36% — for 1.7 extra kilograms lost. By sampling time, you've already swallowed it.

Cost
Free, saving the product money. The hard part: accepting that "kilos a week" doesn't exist.
Benefit
The SCOUT trial enrolled 9,804 subjects — all 55-plus, overweight or obese, with cardiovascular disease or type 2 diabetes — randomized to drug or not, average 3.4 years. The composite endpoint (nonfatal infarction, nonfatal stroke, resuscitated cardiac arrest, cardiovascular death) ran 11.4% vs 10.0%: HR 1.16 (95% CI 1.03–1.31, P=0.02), about 16% higher, the true value between 3% and 31% higher. Nonfatal infarction 4.1% vs 3.2%, HR 1.28 (1.04–1.57), about 30% higher. Nonfatal stroke 2.6% vs 1.9%, HR 1.36 (1.04–1.77), about 36%. Cardiovascular and all-cause death didn't rise. Post-randomization, the sibutramine arm averaged 1.7 kg extra loss. The former food-and-drug regulator judged "risk outweighs benefit," halting sibutramine production, sale, and use in October 2010. Sibutramine and phenolphthalein are banned food additives, health foods included
Note
SCOUT enrolled high-risk cardiac and diabetic patients; it doesn't prove healthy young users suffer identically — but since high-risk can't be sorted out, the regulator withdrew it outright. The other common adulterant, phenolphthalein, is a laxative disturbing electrolytes and provoking arrhythmia in chronic excess. How to tell: legitimate diet drugs are prescription items with verifiable approval numbers at pharmacies and hospitals. "Coffee," "candy," "plums," and "meal replacements" promising weekly kilos shouldn't be pharmacologically active by definition — activity means adulteration. The original 2010 notice page returns 412 locally; the provincial reprint carries both quoted sentences verbatim-checkable.
Sources (2 references)
James WPT et al. (2010). Effect of sibutramine on cardiovascular outcomes in overweight and obese subjects. NEJM. https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1003114；天津市市场监督管理委员会. 警惕部分食品中违法添加「盐酸西布曲明」和「酚酞」. https://scjg.tj.gov.cn/tjsscjdglwyh_52651/hdpt/cjwtyxfts/20…
5

Never use anabolic steroids ("muscle shots," "oral gear") to build muscle

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Men caught by gym doping tests ran 3× the age-matched death rate and over double the yearly clinic visits. Acne, gynecomastia, and erectile dysfunction each struck over one in ten users. The drugs are prescription-only in China — anyone selling them to you is already breaking the law.

Cost
Free, saving the drug money. The hard part: accepting slow muscle.
Benefit
Danish registry work matched each user with age-peers: 545 men testing positive for androgenic steroids at gym doping controls (2006-01-03 to 2018-03-01) against 5,450 controls, plus 644 refusers and 6,440 controls for replication. Users died at 3× controls (HR 3.0, 95% CI 1.3–7.0) — the true multiple somewhere between 1.3 and 7. Median yearly hospitalizations or visits: 0.81 vs 0.36 (P<0.0001). Acne, gynecomastia, and erectile dysfunction each affected over 10% of users — at least one in ten — all significantly above controls (P<0.0001). The replication agreed. The Anti-Doping Regulations, Article 7: strict state management of listed banned substances, no unit or individual producing, selling, importing, or exporting illegally; protein-anabolic agents and peptide hormones are prescription-managed — available only on prescription, "protein-anabolic agents" being the regulatory name for this class
Note
Contested: cohort, not randomized — users may be risk-takers generally, so the 3× can't book entirely to the drug, and the interval 1.3–7.0 runs wide. But acne, gynecomastia, and erectile dysfunction striking one-plus in ten are visible effects less vulnerable to that bias. The class appears in regulations as "protein-anabolic agents" — that phrase means exactly this. Ordinary protein powder and creatine sit outside this entry. The trouble: "miracle muscle" products may adulterate — same test as item 4: legitimate drugs are prescription items with approval numbers; "muscle powders" and "nutrition products" promising weeks mean adulteration if they work.
Sources (2 references)
Horwitz H et al. (2019). Health consequences of androgenic anabolic steroid use. J Intern Med. https://doi.org/10.1111/joim.12850；国务院 (2004). 反兴奋剂条例（国务院令第 398 号，第七条、第九条）. http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2004/content_63129.htm
6

Wanting weight-loss medication: get it prescribed at a hospital — never from a no-prescription online shop

Grade BValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Prescription drugs sell only on prescription, online included, with genuine prescriptions and real names. No consultation, no prescription, ship-on-order means either the product isn't what it claims or the shop breaks the law — and when things go wrong, nobody answers for your dose and contraindications. One registration buys a physician standing guard.

Cost
One registration and a trip — tens of yuan, half a day.
Benefit
The drug management measures require retailers to observe the prescription/non-prescription classification; prescriptions retained no fewer than five years; pharmacists' absence flagged, prescription drugs unreviewed unsold; prescription drugs never open-shelf. The online sales measures, Article 9: prescription sales to individuals online require genuine, reliable prescription sources with real-name registration; Article 10: prominent risk warnings on every product page, no package inserts or purchase before prescription review — the buy button itself shouldn't exist pre-review; Article 8: specially controlled drugs — vaccines, blood products, narcotics, psychotropics, medical toxics, radiopharmaceuticals, and precursor chemicals — never sell online
Note
The statutes verify verbatim, but "how many harms prescription-filling prevents" has no quantified study — Grade B for unquantifiability. Items 5 and 7's steroids and sex hormones run the same rules. At genuinely drug-warranted weight levels, the physician first reads BMI, comorbidity, and contraindications — a judgment you cannot buy.
Sources (2 references)
国家市场监督管理总局 (2023). 药品经营和使用质量监督管理办法（总局令第 84 号）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2023/issue_10846/202311/content_…；国家市场监督管理总局 (2022). 药品网络销售监督管理办法（总局令第 58 号，第八条至第十条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2022/content_5717002.htm
7

Sex-hormone drugs: only on prescription with scheduled follow-up — never online, never self-titrated

Grade AValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

This entry doesn't debate whether to use, only how. Transgender women on estrogen developed blood clots clearly above age-peers — about 4 extra per 1,000 over two years, 17 over eight. Such risk needs scheduled monitoring; online purchases and self-adjustment leave nobody watching.

Cost
Regular registrations and blood-work follow-up — hundreds yearly, several half-days.
Benefit
Kaiser Permanente records followed 2,842 transgender women and 2,118 transgender men, averaged 4.0 and 3.6 years, each matched to roughly ten cisgender controls by birth year, race, site, and enrollment — 48,686 cisgender men and 48,775 cisgender women. Transgender women's venous thromboembolism exceeded controls: versus cisgender men, 4.1 per 1,000 over 2 years (95% CI 1.6–6.7) and 16.7 over 8 (6.4–27.5); versus cisgender women, 3.4 (1.1–5.6) and 13.7 (4.1–22.7). Ischemic stroke and infarction ran near-parity overall, but differences sharpened among those starting hormones during follow-up. Transgender men: evidence insufficient. The authors: "the findings suggest the need for continued vigilance for the vascular effects of estrogen in transgender hormone therapy"
Note
The authors themselves flag the study's weakness: system-external self-purchasing is invisible, so the "on hormones" line was never cleanly drawn — strengthening the case for formal follow-up. The study answers only vascular events, never whether hormone therapy is worthwhile — a different evidence base. Every sex-hormone use shares this: contraceptives, menopausal therapy, testosterone. Self-purchasing, forum-guided titration, and never-checked clot and liver panels place the risk exactly in the unwatched stretch, regardless of purpose. Domestically: endocrinology or the relevant specialty at proper institutions — assessment, prescription, follow-up.
Sources (2 references)
Getahun D et al. (2018). Cross-sex Hormones and Acute Cardiovascular Events in Transgender Persons: A Cohort Study. Ann Intern Med. https://doi.org/10.7326/M17-2785；国家市场监督管理总局 (2022). 药品网络销售监督管理办法（总局令第 58 号，第九条）. https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2022/content_5717002.htm
8

If "feeling ugly" has reached mirror-checking and fixating on the next fix: get a body-image assessment before any surgery

Grade BValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: medium

About 15% of cosmetic-surgery patients carry body dysmorphic disorder — magnifying flaws others barely see into life-disrupting preoccupation — and about 13% of dermatology aesthetics seekers, both majorities women. Fixing one spot, they fixate on the next; surgery doesn't resolve it. One registration to check, then decide.

Cost
One psychiatry or clinical-psychology registration, tens of yuan. The hard part: going before booking surgery.
Benefit
Pooling 33 studies systematically: plastic-surgery patients' body-dysmorphic-disorder prevalence 15.04% (studies spanning 2.21%–56.67%) — about 15 per 100 seekers, ranging 2 to 57 by study; mean age 34.54±12.41, 74.38% female. Dermatology aesthetics patients: 12.65% (4.52%–35.16%), mean age 27.79±9.03, 76.09% female. The authors recommend active screening and multidisciplinary management for high-risk patients
Note
Study estimates run 2.21%–56.67% — questionnaires and populations differ wildly, so read "the share isn't small, screening is worth it," never 15.04% as precise — Grade B for that. The vast majority seeking aesthetics carry no disorder; this entry targets the small share with "repetitive, persistent, work- and socially-disruptive" preoccupation surgery cannot fix. Clues: long daily hours checking or concealing a body part, social and photographic avoidance, fixing one spot then fixating on the next.
Sources (1 references)
Ribeiro RVE (2017). Prevalence of Body Dysmorphic Disorder in Plastic Surgery and Dermatology Patients: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis. Aesthetic Plast Surg. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00266-017-0869-0
9

Orthodontics: an orthodontically credentialed doctor examining in person, with scheduled visits — never mail-order aligners at home

Grade CValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: small

Clear aligners are class-2 medical devices domestically, their labeling requiring credentialed orthodontic supervision and scheduled review. The US FDA has authorized no aligners sold directly to consumers without dentist prescription and supervision. Unexamined use risks uneven bite, unintended tooth movement, pain, even tooth loss.

Cost
Registration and follow-up above the mail-order price, with periodic clinic trips over a one-to-two-year course. The hard part: sustaining visits.
Benefit
The NMPA device-review center's 2022 guidance classifies bracketless aligners "category II," requiring labeling to state "wearing during treatment requires the guidance of a physician with orthodontic professional qualifications" plus "eating, brushing, and periodic follow-up requirements," and "product names should not contain vacuous or hypothetical conceptual terms such as 'invisible.'" The FDA: "The FDA has not authorized clear aligners that are sold directly to consumers without a prescription and supervision by a dentist or orthodontist," and "In-person examination by a dentist or orthodontist can help lower the risks of uneven bite, unintended tooth movement, pain, and tooth loss" — scheduled in-person visits confirm teeth moving safely as planned. Both are regulatory documents without incident rates
Note
Benefit "small" because incident rates weren't found — judgment by consequence. Domestic regulator warnings on "mail-order at-home aligners" weren't found, so this entry rests on registration requirements and the FDA. Orthodontics is medical care: aesthetic tooth-straightening institutions need the corresponding license entry and credentialed operators — verify per item 2. The four-department 2023 notice targets unlicensed dental operations and non-health-technical staffing. Orthodontics stays unreimbursed — Section 24, item 12.
Sources (3 references)
国家药品监督管理局医疗器械技术审评中心 (2022). 无托槽矫治器注册审查指导原则（2022 年第 41 号）. https://www.cmde.org.cn/flfg/zdyz/zdyzwbk/20230103095116100…；国家卫生健康委办公厅等 (2023). 关于进一步推进口腔医疗服务和保障管理工作的通知（国卫办医政发〔2023〕11 号，第五条）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202309/content_6903786…；U.S. Food and Drug Administration (2026). Clear Dental Aligners（页面 2026 年 9 月 9 日更新）. https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/dental-devices/clear-de…

29. After a major blow

13 entries

A loved one dies, a grave diagnosis lands, a job disappears, a marriage ends. In research these share one feature: it isn't only mood that breaks — the body does too, with risk peaking in the first weeks to the first year. This section isn't about "moving on"; it covers what must be watched during this stretch, which decisions must wait, and when to register at a clinic. Most entries count death probability. Four money-and-benefits entries count money: grief counseling (item 9), 12356 and psych clinics (item 11), deferring irreversible decisions (item 12), death as debt repayment (item 13) — the two kinds never convert. For those with no kin and no friends, item 6 grounds "have someone watch you." Procedures, the body, and collectible money at a death: Section 25. Elders' guardianship and wills: Section 17. Unemployment benefits: Section 7. Exercise and light for low mood: Sections 3 and 22. Suicidal thoughts — 12356 first: Section 1, item 25; timescales: item 32; aftermath of rescue: item 33. None repeated here.

1

In the days right after a death: don't stay alone; those with heart disease, hypertension, or diabetes keep medication; crushing chest pain means 120

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

The day after losing a loved one, heart-attack risk runs 21.1× baseline, declining daily after. Bereaved partners 60–89 ran about doubled heart attacks and strokes within 30 days, normalizing after a month. The cardiovascularly ill never stop medication these days; crushing pain, breathlessness, one-sided weakness: 120 now.

Cost
Free. Company, medication as usual.
Benefit
1,985 acute-infarction patients compared within themselves across periods: 270 (13.6%) lost a significant person within 6 months pre-infarction, 19 within 1 day. Within 24 hours of the death, infarction incidence rose 21.1× (95% CI 13.1–34.1, the true multiple roughly 13–34), declining day by day. In absolute terms: among those with a 10-year infarction risk of 5%, one extra per 1,394 newly bereaved; at 20% risk, one per 320. The UK study matched 30,447 bereaved partners 60–89 against 83,588 comparable controls: 30-day infarction or stroke — bereaved 50 (0.16%) versus controls 67 (0.08%); IRR 2.20 (1.52–3.15), about 2.2×, infarction 2.14 (1.20–3.81), stroke 2.40 (1.22–4.71), weakening past 30 days. Ninety days added non-infarction acute coronary syndromes, IRR 2.20 (1.12–4.29), and pulmonary embolism, IRR 2.37 (1.18–4.75)
Note
Hand the pill box to someone else. No long drives. No drinking through — alcohol's account sits in Section 2. Recognizing infarction and stroke: Section 13. Both studies are retrospective, inseparable from background incidence — but both agree on direction and window. Those with nobody to hold the box and unavoidable solitude: item 6.
Sources (2 references)
Mostofsky E, et al. (2012). Risk of acute myocardial infarction after the death of a significant person in one's life: the Determinants of Myocardial Infarction Onset Study. Circulation. https://doi.org/10.1161/CIRCULATIONAHA.111.061770；Carey IM, et al. (2014). Increased risk of acute cardiovascular events after partner bereavement: a matched cohort study. JAMA Internal Medicine. https://doi.org/10.1001/jamainternmed.2013.14558
2

The week a grave diagnosis lands: never collect the report alone; non-treatment decisions wait

Grade AValue: very highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: large

In the first week after a cancer diagnosis, suicide risk runs 12.6× and cardiovascular death 5.6× the undiagnosed. By year one, suicide falls to 3.1× — the harder the cancer, the sharper the rise. So bring someone that day, don't go home alone, and leave resignation and home sales to the next clinic visit.

Cost
Free. Bring someone to the report; postpone major non-treatment decisions a few days.
Benefit
Swedish registers followed 6,073,240 people, 1991–2006. Versus the undiagnosed: first-week suicide RR 12.6 (95% CI 8.6–17.8) — the true multiple roughly 8.6–17.8 — at 2.50 per 1,000 person-years; by one year, 3.1 (2.7–3.5; 0.60 per 1,000 person-years). Cardiovascular death: first week 5.6 (5.2–5.9; 116.80 per 1,000 person-years); first 4 weeks 3.3 (3.1–3.4; 65.81). Risk falls steeply within the first year and rises most for the least survivable cancers. Within-patient self-comparison agreed
Note
Cancer data — other grave diagnoses lack equal-weight originals. Events are genuinely rare: 2.50 per 1,000 person-years in week one — stated not to frighten but to explain why someone should sit beside you those first days. Long-term management, reimbursement, follow-up: Sections 16 and 24. No one to bring: item 6 swaps that person for neighbors and community lists.
Sources (1 references)
Fang F, et al. (2012). Suicide and cardiovascular death after a cancer diagnosis. New England Journal of Medicine. https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1110307
3

After job loss: fix sleep, insurance, and a job-search rhythm — no idling at home

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

The unemployed run about 60% higher all-cause mortality than the employed — men and the early-career most, the first decade highest. Removing smoking and drinking trims about a quarter of the excess — the part you can govern. File first; while claiming, unemployment insurance covers your medical premiums.

Cost
Free. File unemployment registration, claim benefits, schedule the search like a workday. The hard part: rising on time with nobody pushing.
Benefit
Pooling 42 studies, 235 mortality estimates, over 20 million people: after age-adjustment, unemployment's all-cause mortality averaged HR 1.63 — about 60% above the employed; men above women; early- and mid-career above late; the first decade highest, declining after. Studies including health behaviors ran 24% lower HR — about a quarter of the excess trimmed
Note
Retrospective, causal direction unsortable — the already-ill lose jobs more. But "lifestyle adjustment removes 24%" marks the actionable share. Benefits and insurance continuation: Section 7; severance and never signing voluntary resignation: Section 19.
Sources (1 references)
Roelfs DJ, et al. (2011). Losing life and livelihood: a systematic review and meta-analysis of unemployment and all-cause mortality. Social Science & Medicine. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.socscimed.2011.01.005
4

A loved one lost to suicide, accident, or homicide: don't count on toughing it out — seek professional help actively

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Those widowed by suicide ran about 80% higher (men) and 70% (women) five-year rates of newly diagnosed mental disorder than the general population — and 70%–100% above those widowed by other causes. Such bereavement feeds isolation and shame — precisely the reason to seek help before you "feel better."

Cost
12356 is free; psych clinics bill ordinary registration. The hard part: speaking up.
Benefit
Danish registers followed 6.7 million adults, 1980–2014, over 136 million person-years. Spousal suicide bereavement: new mental-disorder diagnosis within 5 years — IRR men 1.8 (95% CI 1.6–2.0), women 1.7 (1.6–1.8) against the general population; against other-cause widowed, men 1.7 (1.5–1.9), women 2.0 (1.9–2.2). These bereaved also ran more suicidal behavior, death, and municipal assistance, plus liver cirrhosis and sleep disorders. A 57-study review links suicide bereavement to: partners' elevated suicide risk; parents' psychiatric admission after a child's suicide; mothers' suicide risk after adult children's; and children's depression after parental suicide. Suicide-bereaved report more stigma and abandonment than other violent-loss bereaved
Note
Sudden violent deaths — accidents, homicide, disaster — run higher PTSD, depression, and stuck grief than illness deaths, and slower recovery. Your own suicidal thoughts: Section 1, item 25.
Sources (3 references)
Erlangsen A, et al. (2017). Association Between Spousal Suicide and Mental, Physical, and Social Health Outcomes: A Longitudinal and Nationwide Register-Based Study. JAMA Psychiatry. https://doi.org/10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2017.0226；Pitman A, et al. (2014). Effects of suicide bereavement on mental health and suicide risk. The Lancet Psychiatry. https://doi.org/10.1016/S2215-0366(14)70224-X；Kristensen P et al. (2012). Bereavement and mental health after sudden and violent losses: a review. Psychiatry. https://doi.org/10.1521/psyc.2012.75.1.76（备注里那份综述）
5

The first half-year of widowhood: hand meals, sleep, chronic medication, and follow-up to one fixed person

Grade AValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Under 6 months bereaved, mortality runs about 40% above the non-bereaved, falling to about 15% after; men about 23%, women a gap small enough to be chance. This isn't outlasted by attitude. Land the medication, meals, and follow-up on one named person — never on your own memory.

Cost
Free. One named person — child, sibling, friend — visiting or calling on a schedule. The hard part: entrusting it aloud.
Benefit
Pooling 15 prospective studies, 2,263,888 people: bereavement under 6 months ran death RR 1.41 (95% CI 1.26–1.57) — about 40% higher — falling to 1.14 (1.10–1.18) after 6 months. Men RR 1.23 (1.18–1.28); women 1.04 (1.00–1.08, nonsignificant — possibly chance). Under-65 versus over-65 didn't differ. Another pool of 123 papers, 1,377 estimates, 500-million-plus: adjusted HR 1.23 (1.19–1.28) overall — about 23% — men 1.27 (1.19–1.35), women 1.15 (1.08–1.22)
Note
Retrospective with unremovable confounds — couples share lifestyles and diseases. But "the first half-year far exceeds the rest" held across two independent pools, marking a care window. Men run higher risk and ask less. Households with newly widowed elders: settle accounts, guardianship, and wills per Section 17. Nobody available — solo-living, childless, child-predeceased: item 6 hands it to community and phone.
Sources (2 references)
Moon JR, et al. (2011). Widowhood and mortality: a meta-analysis. PLoS ONE. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0023465；Shor E, et al. (2012). Widowhood and mortality: a meta-analysis and meta-regression. Demography. https://doi.org/10.1007/s13524-012-0096-x
6

No kin, no friends: swap "the person watching you" for three things — a neighbor with a key, the community visit roster, and emergency contacts in the phone

Grade BValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Alone, two things matter: someone finds you if things go wrong, and medication and meals happen on time. The latter runs on lists and alarms, never memory; the former on three things: a spare key with a neighbor, the community's visit roster, and emergency contacts with the phone never off.

Cost
Free. The hard part: telling the neighbor and the residents' committee "I live alone; something just happened."
Benefit
44,573 outpatients with atherothrombotic risk or history, enrolled internationally in REACH (December 2003–December 2004), followed 4 years; 8,594 (19%) lived alone. Four-year all-cause death: solo 14.1% versus cohabiting 11.1%; cardiovascular death 8.6% versus 6.8% — both log-rank P<0.01. Gaps varied by age (interaction P=0.03): 45–65, 7.7% versus 5.7%, adjusted HR 1.24 (95% CI 1.01–1.51) — about 24% higher; 66–80, 13.2% versus 12.3%, HR 1.12 (1.01–1.26); past 80, 24.6% versus 28.4%, HR 0.92 (0.79–1.06) — no elevation. The 2022 ten-department opinion mandates visit-and-care services for solo-living, empty-nest, left-behind, disabled, severely disabled, and special family-planning elders, delivered "by regular home visits, phone and video calls, remote monitoring," with townships surveying and village committees assisting into grid management — by end-2025 "ensuring a 100% monthly visit rate for special-difficulty elders" and "no fewer than one monthly visit for disabled special-difficulty elders," while promoting smart call systems, smart water meters, health monitors, and elder-care alert devices that "alert promptly on anomalies, simultaneously notifying emergency contacts," with service staff "dialing emergency numbers first" on urgent findings
Note
How to land the three: (1) spare key or temporary door code with a neighbor or the property office plus one sentence — no friendship required, only someone who knows you're inside; (2) tell the residents' committee you live alone and ask onto the visit roster — solo-living, empty-nest, and child-predeceased elders are explicit service targets; ask about free smart pendants and meters; (3) set emergency contacts and the medical ID; no silent mode, no power-offs this week. Grade B twice: solo-living mortality is retrospective, "the frail live alone more" unremovable — the paper itself flags confirmation needed — and the visit-care document covers only elders; under-60s get the grid workers' duty to "detect family upheaval, unemployment, dropout crisis risks" (item 11). Why "someone in the room" matters: Section 13, item 1 — 79.2% of out-of-hospital arrests happen at home; with compressions, survival-to-discharge runs 16.1% versus 3.9% without. Two bonus moves: the funeral itself runs through funeral homes, community health, police, and the housing fund (Section 25) — schedule one outing daily; and the hotline takes repeat calls (item 11). Long-term solo living carries its own account — odds 1.32, up about 30% (Section 22, item 9) — outside this week's business.
Sources (2 references)
Udell JA, et al. (2012). Living alone and cardiovascular risk in outpatients at risk of or with atherothrombosis. Archives of Internal Medicine. https://doi.org/10.1001/archinternmed.2012.2782；民政部等十部门 (2022). 关于开展特殊困难老年人探访关爱服务的指导意见（民发〔2022〕73 号）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-10/13/content_571…
7

After a parent's death: tell the child the truth, let them attend the farewell, don't ship them off "for a change of scene"

Grade BValue: highMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: large

Children losing a parent before 18 ran about 50% higher early-adult mortality — about 80% after accidental or suicidal parental death, about 30% after illness. What the household controls: honest telling, farewell participation, uninterrupted schooling, no relocation to relatives.

Cost
Free. The hard part: hurting yourself while explaining clearly.
Benefit
All persons born in Denmark 1968–2008 and Sweden 1973–2006 plus 89.3% of Finland's 1987–2007 births — over 7.3 million, of whom 189,094 lost a parent before 18. Their all-cause mortality ran 50% above the non-bereaved (mortality ratio 1.50, 95% CI 1.43–1.58); parental unnatural death (accident, suicide) 1.84 (1.71–2.00), about 80%; natural death 1.33 (1.24–1.41), about 30%. Highest where the child's cause of death matched the parent's
Note
No "gone on a long trip" stories; custody lands in writing. Grade B isn't about the numbers — three whole-nation cohorts are Grade A material — but the bridge from numbers to "how to tell, whether to attend" lacks trials; the authors flag missing parent-child relationship and lifestyle data, and the elevation blends constitution with bereavement's long shadow. Guardianship and property: Section 17; support and schooling: Section 18.
Sources (1 references)
Li J, et al. (2014). Mortality after parental death in childhood: a nationwide cohort study from three Nordic countries. PLoS Medicine. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pmed.1001679
8

Grief still stuck after six months, life not running: register at psychiatry or clinical psychology

Grade AValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: lowTime: mediumWillpower: someBenefit: large

About one in ten bereaved adults gets stuck: past six months still yearning to the point of not eating, working, or parenting; numbness; life meaningless. That isn't insufficient toughness — it has diagnostic criteria and dedicated treatment: 51% response for targeted therapy versus 28% for generic, and faster.

Cost
Registration plus treatment — trials averaged 16 sessions over 19 weeks. The hard part: walking yourself to the desk.
Benefit
Pooling 14 studies of adults bereaved non-violently and not in psychiatric care: prolonged-grief-disorder prevalence 9.8% (95% CI 6.8–14.0) — about 10 per 100 — rising with age. The validation study interviewed 291 bereaved at 0–6, 6–12, and 12–24 months: the core feature is intense yearning for the deceased plus at least five of nine — emotional numbness, disbelief, meaninglessness, distrust, distress over the loss, difficulty accepting, identity confusion, avoidance, inability to move on — daily or functionally disabling, persisting past 6 months and disrupting daily life. The randomized trial, 95 patients, 16 sessions averaging 19 weeks: complicated-grief treatment 51% response versus interpersonal therapy 28% (P=0.02), faster onset; number needed to treat 4.3
Note
Don't count months rigidly — the real test is "eating, sleeping, working, parenting disrupted"; matching means register. Departments run as psychiatry, psychology, or clinical psychology at public psychiatric hospitals. Names vary — complicated grief, prolonged grief disorder — and duration thresholds run 6 or 12 months by standard. The 9.8% pools heterogeneous studies, and the authors caution against generalizing.
Sources (3 references)
Lundorff M, et al. (2017). Prevalence of prolonged grief disorder in adult bereavement: A systematic review and meta-analysis. Journal of Affective Disorders. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jad.2017.01.030；Prigerson HG, et al. (2009). Prolonged grief disorder: Psychometric validation of criteria proposed for DSM-V and ICD-11. PLoS Medicine. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pmed.1000121；Shear MK, et al. (2005). Treatment of complicated grief: a randomized controlled trial. JAMA. https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.293.21.2601
9

Don't buy grief counseling up front — first check whether your grief is actually stuck (item 8's symptoms)

Grade AValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

Counseling for every bereaved person buys little and fades — most recover on their own. For those clearly failing to adapt, treatment works as well as for other psychological problems. So match against item 8 first; spend the money only on a match.

Cost
Free, and it saves the fee.
Benefit
Pooling 61 controlled studies: universal psychological intervention for the bereaved shows small benefit at end-of-treatment, fading to nothing on re-examination — because the untreated comparison recovers with time. Interventions admitting only the clearly maladjusted work as well as psychotherapy elsewhere; unselected studies muddy exactly because controls self-heal. A 14-trial pool: treatment of the already-affected beats control at end and follow-up, effects growing; preventive intervention for the not-yet-affected doesn't work. The 205-person study from pre-loss through 6 and 18 months post-loss found five trajectories — common grief, chronic grief, chronic depression, improvement during bereavement, and resilience — with resilience the most common and common grief relatively rare
Note
"Not everyone needs it" is not "nobody should." Item 4's high-risk bereavement and item 8's stuck grief are exactly where evidence supports treatment. A Lancet review concludes likewise: grief isn't illness, most need no professional intervention — effort belongs on the high-risk and on those with complicated grief, post-bereavement depression, and stress disorders.
Sources (4 references)
Currier JM, et al. (2008). The effectiveness of psychotherapeutic interventions for bereaved persons: a comprehensive quantitative review. Psychological Bulletin. https://doi.org/10.1037/0033-2909.134.5.648；Wittouck C, et al. (2011). The prevention and treatment of complicated grief: a meta-analysis. Clinical Psychology Review. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cpr.2010.09.005；Bonanno GA, et al. (2002). Resilience to loss and chronic grief: a prospective study from preloss to 18-months postloss. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology. https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.83.5.1150；Stroebe M et al. (2007). Health outcomes of bereavement. Lancet. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(07)61816-9（备注里那份综述）
10

After separation or divorce: don't drop insurance, don't lean on alcohol

Grade AValue: averageMetric: mortalityMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

The separated and divorced die earlier than the married, men and the younger rising most — not necessarily caused by divorce itself, since the divorced differ in health and income beforehand. What you govern: keep insurance and checkups running; never prop up on tobacco and alcohol.

Cost
Free. Keep insurance; stop drinking. The hard part: the stretch invites leaning on drink.
Benefit
Pooling 32 prospective studies — over 6.5 million people, 160,000 deaths, 755,000-plus divorces, 11 countries: separated and divorced adults run significantly elevated early death versus the married, men and the younger above women and elders. Four pathways discussed: social selection (the already-different divorce more); resource interruption (income and coverage cut); health-behavior change (tobacco, alcohol, sleep); and chronic psychological stress
Note
The paper states "significantly elevated" with group contrasts and no citable multipliers — so no numbers here. Benefit "medium" by "direction known, no applicable threshold." Property, debt, and betrothal gifts at divorce: Sections 8 and 10; children's arrangements: Section 18.
Sources (1 references)
Sbarra DA, et al. (2011). Divorce and Death: A Meta-Analysis and Research Agenda for Clinical, Social, and Health Psychology. Perspectives on Psychological Science. https://doi.org/10.1177/1745691611414724
11

For someone to talk to: 12356 — minors and teens 12355 — and psych clinics register like any other

Grade BValue: highMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: noneBenefit: medium

To talk, call 12356, the free national psychological-assistance line; minors and teens have 12355, the youth service platform. For a doctor: psychiatry, psychology, or clinical-psychology outpatient registration. Grid workers and social workers are supposed to catch family upheaval, job loss, and dropout proactively.

Cost
Free. Both lines free; psych clinics bill ordinary registration.
Benefit
The 2026 twenty-five-department plan directs: improving 12356's working systems, stability, and answer rates; building provincial 12356 platforms; linking with 110; strengthening 12355 in coordination. The 2030 targets: psychological-counseling rooms or social-work stations delivering services in 80%-plus of villages and urban communities; every public psychiatric hospital and every county (district) with at least one hospital offering psychology outpatient service; provincial 12356 platforms built. Crisis teams comprise psychiatrists, psychotherapists, counselors, social workers, and volunteers — with grid workers, social-work professionals, and volunteers tasked to detect family upheaval, unemployment, and dropout risks early (national; issued March 2026)
Note
Grade B because village rooms and county clinics are 2030 targets, not current universal facts; 12356 and 12355 answer today. 12356's hours: Section 1, item 25. Counseling and psychotherapy differ — diagnosis and prescriptions belong to psychiatrists, and treatment runs inside licensed institutions; hourly "healing" and "spiritual consulting" sit outside this system.
Sources (1 references)
国家卫生健康委等 25 部门 (2026). 关于印发健全社会心理服务体系和危机干预机制实施方案的通知（国卫医政发〔2026〕8 号）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065035…
12

The first three months after the blow: every irreversible decision waits

Grade CValue: averageMetric: moneyMoney: noneTime: lowWillpower: someBenefit: medium

Your judgment about "opportunities" is at its worst now. Those claiming to reach the dead, to multiply your money, urging resignation and relocation, or recruiting you as a partner — all will call. Anything exceeding a month's income or costing dearly to reverse waits three months. Speak it first to someone with no stake; never decide the same day.

Cost
Free — waiting may cost opportunities. The hard part: the feeling that opportunity won't wait.
Benefit
What's avoided: irreversible property dispositions at your worst judgment — selling homes, resigning, lump-summing survivor payments into investments, hasty remarriage, guaranteeing others' debts. Sums typically run tens of thousands to a house — hence "medium." Official documents likewise treat "family upheaval, unemployment, dropout" as crisis risks for community detection — this state is already flagged as one needing outside hands
Note
No stake-free person nearby: speak it to 12356 (item 11), or write it down and reread after three days. "Three months" is the author's line, unsupported by literature — hence C. Common scams against the bereaved and elders: Section 17 (investment retirement, house-for-retirement) and Section 6 (fortune-telling). Guarantees and IOUs: Section 8. Some money goes the other way — collected, not deferred: housing funds, social-insurance benefits, work-death sums (Sections 25 and 19).
Sources (1 references)
作者经验，无直接文献；「家庭变故、失业、失学」作为心理危机风险的表述见国家卫生健康委等 25 部门 (2026). 健全社会心理服务体系和危机干预机制实施方案（国卫医政发〔2026〕8 号）. https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065035…
13

Death doesn't repay debts: life insurance won't pay within two years, work injury won't recognize it, and debts carve the estate first
